   lives here instead. The frame's name carries the page to open on. */

  var next = (String(to).charAt(0) === '#') ? String(to) : '#' + String(to);
  if (next === window.__hash) return;

  /* ============================================================
     SPATIAL SKIN: Lumera's house design language.
     A deep, slightly violet charcoal ground lit by soft volumetric light.
     Content sits on floating panels at distinct depths. Real glass (blur)
     is spent only where something floats over moving content, the
     sidebar, top bar, dock, menus and the Active Workspace, because that
     is where blur is seen; content panels use a lit translucent fill,
     which looks the same over the smooth ground at a fraction of the cost.
     Instrument Serif for large editorial moments, Manrope for all UI.
     Every page inherits it by repainting the tokens components read.
     ============================================================ */

function loadAssets() {
  let up = {};
  try {
    const a = JSON.parse(__LS.getItem(ASSET_KEY));
    if (a && typeof a === 'object') up = a;
  } catch (e) {}
  const out = {
    ...BRAND_ART
  };
  Object.keys(up).forEach(k => {
    if (up[k]) out[k] = up[k];
  });
  return out;
}
function useAssets() {
  const [a, setA] = useState(loadAssets);
  useEffect(() => {
    const h = e => {
      if (!e || e.key === ASSET_KEY) setA(loadAssets());
    };
    window.addEventListener('storage', h);
    let bc;
    try {
      bc = new BroadcastChannel(ASSET_KEY);
      bc.onmessage = () => setA(loadAssets());
    } catch (e) {}
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('storage', h);
      try {
        bc && bc.close();
      } catch (e) {}
    };
  }, []);
  return a;
}

function reportError(err, path) {
  if (API.mode !== 'server' || _errSent >= 5) return;
  _errSent++;
  try {
    fetch('/api/reports/error', {
      method: 'POST',
      credentials: 'same-origin',
      headers: {
        'X-Lumera': '1',
        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        message: String(err && err.message || err || 'Unknown error').slice(0, 500),
        stack: String(err && err.stack || '').slice(0, 4000),
        path: path || location.hash
      })
    }).catch(() => {});
  } catch (e) {}
}

const LA = {
  KEY: 'lumera_analytics',
  sid: null,
  read() {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(__LS.getItem(this.KEY)) || {
        sessions: [],
        events: []
      };
    } catch (e) {
      return {
        sessions: [],
        events: []
      };
    }
  },
  write(d) {
    try {
      d.events = d.events.slice(-4000);
      d.sessions = d.sessions.slice(-2000);
      __LS.setItem(this.KEY, JSON.stringify(d));
      try {
        if (!this._bc) this._bc = new BroadcastChannel('lumera_analytics');
        this._bc.postMessage(1);
      } catch (e) {}
    } catch (e) {}
  },
  start(meta) {
    const d = this.read();
    this.sid = 's' + Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6);
    d.sessions.push({
      id: this.sid,
      start: Date.now(),
      end: Date.now(),
      views: 0,
      lang: meta.lang || 'en',
      cur: meta.cur || '',
      user: meta.user || null
    });
    d.events.push({
      ts: Date.now(),
      type: 'session_start',
      lang: meta.lang,
      user: meta.user || null
    });
    this.write(d);
    if (!this._bound) {
      this._bound = true;
      window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => this.event('session_end'));
    }
  },
  event(type, extra) {
    const d = this.read();
    d.events.push({
      ts: Date.now(),
      type,
      ...(extra || {})
    });
    const s = d.sessions.find(x => x.id === this.sid);
    if (s) {
      s.end = Date.now();
      if (type === 'view') s.views++;
      if (extra && extra.lang) s.lang = extra.lang;
      if (extra && extra.cur) s.cur = extra.cur;
      if (extra && extra.user) s.user = extra.user;
    }
    this.write(d);
  }
};

const FX_SEED = {
  USD: 1,
  AED: 3.6725,
  GBP: 0.79,
  EUR: 0.92,
  INR: 83.3,
  PKR: 278,
  CAD: 1.36,
  AUD: 1.51,
  SGD: 1.34,
  SAR: 3.75
};
const RATES = {
  map: {
    ...FX_SEED
  },
  ts: 0,
  onLoad: null,
  init() {
    try {
      const c = JSON.parse(__LS.getItem('lumera_fx'));
      if (c && c.rates) {
        this.map = {
          ...FX_SEED,
          ...c.rates
        };
        this.ts = c.ts || 0;
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  },
  convert(v, from, to) {
    if (!isFinite(v)) return 0;
    from = from || 'USD';
    to = to || from;
    if (from === to) return v;
    const a = this.map[from] || 1,
      b = this.map[to] || 1;
    return v / a * b;
  },
  refresh() {
    if (Date.now() - this.ts < 6 * 3600e3) {
      if (this.onLoad) this.onLoad();
      return;
    }
    fetch('https://open.er-api.com/v6/latest/USD').then(r => r.json()).then(j => {
      if (j && j.rates) {
        this.map = {
          ...this.map,
          ...j.rates
        };
        this.ts = Date.now();
        try {
          __LS.setItem('lumera_fx', JSON.stringify({
            ts: this.ts,
            rates: this.map
          }));
        } catch (e) {}
        if (this.onLoad) this.onLoad();
      }
    }).catch(() => {});
  }
};
RATES.init();
let _setRatesTs = null;
RATES.onLoad = () => {
  if (_setRatesTs) _setRatesTs(RATES.ts);
};
function useRatesTs() {
  const [ts, set] = useState(RATES.ts);
  useEffect(() => {
    _setRatesTs = set;
    return () => {
      if (_setRatesTs === set) _setRatesTs = null;
    };
  }, []);
  return ts;
}
function useFmt(display, base) {
  const ratesTs = useRatesTs();
  return useMemo(() => {
    const c = CURRENCIES[display] || CURRENCIES.AED;
    const b = base || display;
    const fmtVal = (v, opts = {}) => {
      const s = new Intl.NumberFormat(c.locale, {
        maximumFractionDigits: opts.dp ?? 0,
        minimumFractionDigits: opts.dp ?? 0,
        notation: opts.compact ? 'compact' : 'standard'
      }).format(Math.abs(v));
      const sign = v < 0 ? '−' : '';
      return c.suffix ? `${sign}${s} ${c.code}` : `${sign}${c.symbol}${s}`;
    };
    const money = (n, opts = {}) => fmtVal(RATES.convert(isFinite(n) ? n : 0, b, display), opts);
    const compact = n => fmtVal(RATES.convert(n || 0, b, display), {
      compact: true,
      dp: 1
    });
    const toBase = n => RATES.convert(Number(n) || 0, display, b);
    const toDisplay = n => RATES.convert(Number(n) || 0, b, display);
    return {
      money,
      compact,
      toBase,
      toDisplay,
      c,
      base: b,
      display
    };
  }, [display, base, ratesTs]);
}
function WsRing({
  value = 0,
  size = 118
}) {
  const v = useCountUp(value, 1400, [value]);
  const r = size / 2 - 10,
    c = 2 * Math.PI * r;
  const [on, setOn] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setTimeout(() => setOn(true), 60);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, []);
  return React.createElement("div", {
    className: "relative shrink-0 ws-ring",
    style: {
      width: size,
      height: size
    }
  }, React.createElement("svg", {
    width: size,
    height: size,
    className: "-rotate-90",
    "aria-hidden": "true"
  }, React.createElement("defs", null, React.createElement("linearGradient", {
    id: "wsg",
    x1: "0",
    x2: "1"
  }, React.createElement("stop", {
    offset: "0",
    stopColor: "#8E7BFF"
  }), React.createElement("stop", {
    offset: "1",
    stopColor: "#DDD3FF"
  }))), React.createElement("circle", {
    cx: size / 2,
    cy: size / 2,
    r: r,
    fill: "none",
    stroke: "rgba(255,255,255,.10)",
    strokeWidth: "10"
  }), React.createElement("circle", {
    className: "fg",
    cx: size / 2,
    cy: size / 2,
    r: r,
    fill: "none",
    stroke: "url(#wsg)",
    strokeWidth: "10",
    strokeLinecap: "round",
    strokeDasharray: c,
    strokeDashoffset: on ? c * (1 - clamp(value, 0, 100) / 100) : c,
    style: {
      filter: 'drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(167,139,250,.55))'
    }
  })), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center text-center"
  }, React.createElement("div", null, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "font-display tnum text-[2.6rem] leading-none text-white"
  }, value ? Math.round(v) : '–'), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-[10px] text-white/75"
  }, "of 100"))));
}
function useCountUp(target, dur = 1100, deps = []) {
  const to = Number(target) || 0;
  const [v, setV] = useState(to);
  const cur = useRef(to);
  const first = useRef(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    cur.current = v;
  }, [v]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const from = first.current ? 0 : cur.current;
    first.current = false;
    const delta = Math.abs(to - from),
      scale = Math.abs(to) || 1;
    const d = delta / scale < 0.25 ? 220 : dur;
    if (delta < 0.5) {
      setV(to);
      return;
    }
    let raf, start;
    const ease = t => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);
    const step = ts => {
      if (!start) start = ts;
      const p = clamp((ts - start) / d, 0, 1);
      setV(from + (to - from) * ease(p));
      if (p < 1) raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, [to, ...deps]);
  return v;
}
function useReveal() {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    const els = ref.current ? ref.current.querySelectorAll('.reveal') : [];
    const io = new IntersectionObserver(ents => ents.forEach(e => {
      if (e.isIntersecting) {
        e.target.classList.add('in');
        io.unobserve(e.target);
      }
    }), {
      threshold: .12
    });
    els.forEach(el => io.observe(el));
    return () => io.disconnect();
  }, []);
  return ref;
}
function useHashRoute() {
  const [route, setRoute] = useState(() => window.__hash.replace('#', '') || '/');
  useEffect(() => {
    const on = () => {
      setRoute(window.__hash.replace('#', '') || '/');
      window.scrollTo({
        top: 0,
        behavior: 'instant'
      });
    };
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', on);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('hashchange', on);
  }, []);
  const nav = useCallback((to, opts) => {
    if (window.__go) window.__go(to);else if (opts && opts.replace) replaceRoute(to);else location.hash = to;
  }, []);
  return [route, nav];
}
const PREVIEW_ROUTE = (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.__hash ? window.__hash.replace('#', '') : typeof location !== 'undefined' && location.hash.replace('#', '')) || '/dashboard';
function replaceRoute(to) {
  if (window.__go) {
    window.__go(to);
    return;
  }
  const h = '#' + to;
  if (location.hash !== h) location.replace(h);
}
function goSiteHome() {
  if (window.__exitToSite) {
    window.__exitToSite();
    return;
  }
  const p = location.pathname;
  location.href = /(Lumera|_app_dev)\.html$/i.test(p) ? 'landing.html' : p.replace(/[^/]*$/, '') || '/';
}
function RootRoute() {
  const app = useApp();
  useEffect(() => {
    replaceRoute(app.user ? app.onboarded ? '/dashboard' : '/onboarding' : '/login');
  }, []);
  return null;
}
const logoHome = app => {
  if (app.user) app.nav('/dashboard');else goSiteHome();
};

const MT = {
  mem: {},
  load(l) {
    if (this.mem[l]) return this.mem[l];
    try {
      this.mem[l] = JSON.parse(__LS.getItem('lumera_mt_' + l)) || {};
    } catch (e) {
      this.mem[l] = {};
    }
    return this.mem[l];
  },
  save(l) {
    try {
      __LS.setItem('lumera_mt_' + l, JSON.stringify(this.mem[l]));
    } catch (e) {}
  },
  onProgress: null,
  fetchOne(text, l) {
    return fetch('https://translate.googleapis.com/translate_a/single?client=gtx&sl=en&tl=' + l + '&dt=t&q=' + encodeURIComponent(text)).then(r => r.json()).then(j => j && j[0] ? j[0].map(s => s[0]).join('') : null).catch(() => fetch('https://api.mymemory.translated.net/get?q=' + encodeURIComponent(text) + '&langpair=en|' + l).then(r => r.json()).then(j => {
      const tr = j && j.responseData && j.responseData.translatedText;
      return tr && j.responseStatus === 200 && !/MYMEMORY WARNING|QUERY LENGTH|INVALID/i.test(tr) ? tr : null;
    }).catch(() => null));
  },
  fetchBatch(texts, l) {
    const q = texts.map(t => '&q=' + encodeURIComponent(t)).join('');
    return fetch('https://translate.googleapis.com/translate_a/t?client=gtx&sl=en&tl=' + l + '&format=text' + q).then(r => r.json()).then(j => {
      if (!Array.isArray(j) || j.length !== texts.length) throw 0;
      return j.map(v => Array.isArray(v) ? v[0] || null : typeof v === 'string' ? v : null);
    }).catch(() => Promise.all(texts.map(t => this.fetchOne(t, l))));
  },
  ensure(l, texts) {
    const c = this.load(l);
    const todo = [...new Set(texts)].filter(t => c[t] === undefined);
    if (!todo.length) return Promise.resolve(false);
    const chunks = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < todo.length; i += 18) chunks.push(todo.slice(i, i + 18));
    let ci = 0;
    const pool = Math.min(4, chunks.length);
    const worker = async () => {
      while (ci < chunks.length) {
        const ch = chunks[ci++];
        const res = await this.fetchBatch(ch, l);
        ch.forEach((t, i) => {
          c[t] = res && res[i] || null;
        });
        this.save(l);
        if (this.onProgress) this.onProgress();
      }
    };
    return Promise.all(Array.from({
      length: pool
    }, worker)).then(() => true);
  }
};
const _trKey = new WeakMap();
let _trObs = null,
  _trT = null;
let _curLang = 'en';
let _mtRunning = false;
let _autoMT = (() => {
  try {
    return __LS.getItem('lumera_autoMT') !== 'off';
  } catch (e) {
    return true;
  }
})();
function setAutoMT(on) {
  _autoMT = on;
  try {
    __LS.setItem('lumera_autoMT', on ? 'on' : 'off');
  } catch (e) {}
  translateDOM(_curLang);
}
const _mtPrivate = {
  terms: []
};
const _mtOK = t => t.length > 1 && /[A-Za-z]/.test(t) && !/\d/.test(t) && !/@/.test(t) && !_mtPrivate.terms.some(x => t.toLowerCase().includes(x));
function translateDOM(lang) {
  const root = document.getElementById('root');
  if (!root) return;
  const idx = TR_LANGS.indexOf(lang);
  if (_trObs) _trObs.disconnect();
  const pending = [];
  try {
    const w = document.createTreeWalker(root, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, {
      acceptNode: n => !n.parentNode || /^(SCRIPT|STYLE|TEXTAREA|OPTION)$/.test(n.parentNode.nodeName) || n.parentElement && n.parentElement.closest('[translate="no"]') ? NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT : NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT
    });
    let node;
    const list = [];
    while (node = w.nextNode()) list.push(node);
    const mc = lang !== 'en' && idx >= 0 ? MT.load(lang) : null;
    list.forEach(nd => {
      const cur = nd.nodeValue;
      const lead = cur.match(/^\s*/)[0],
        trail = cur.match(/\s*$/)[0];
      const t = cur.trim();
      if (!t) return;
      const tracked = _trKey.get(nd);
      if (tracked) {
        const arr = UI_TR[tracked];
        const mt = mc && mc[tracked];
        const want = lang === 'en' || idx < 0 ? tracked : arr && arr[idx] ? arr[idx] : mt || tracked;
        const next = lead + want + trail;
        if (cur !== next) nd.nodeValue = next;
        return;
      }
      if (lang === 'en' || idx < 0) return;
      if (UI_TR[t] && UI_TR[t][idx]) {
        _trKey.set(nd, t);
        nd.nodeValue = lead + UI_TR[t][idx] + trail;
        return;
      }
      if (_autoMT && _mtOK(t)) {
        if (mc[t]) {
          _trKey.set(nd, t);
          nd.nodeValue = lead + mc[t] + trail;
        } else if (mc[t] === undefined) {
          pending.push(t);
        }
      }
    });
  } catch (e) {}
  if (_trObs) try {
    _trObs.observe(root, {
      subtree: true,
      childList: true,
      characterData: true
    });
  } catch (e) {}
  if (lang !== 'en' && idx >= 0 && _autoMT && pending.length && !_mtRunning) {
    _mtRunning = true;
    MT.onProgress = () => {
      clearTimeout(_trT);
      _trT = setTimeout(() => translateDOM(lang), 40);
    };
    MT.ensure(lang, pending).then(() => {
      _mtRunning = false;
      MT.onProgress = null;
      translateDOM(lang);
    });
  }
}
function ensureTrObserver(getLang) {
  const root = document.getElementById('root');
  if (!root || _trObs) return;
  _trObs = new MutationObserver(() => {
    clearTimeout(_trT);
    _trT = setTimeout(() => translateDOM(getLang()), 90);
  });
  _trObs.observe(root, {
    subtree: true,
    childList: true,
    characterData: true
  });
}

function benchFor(item, income, region) {
  if (item.lo == null) return null;
  let lo = item.lo,
    hi = item.hi;
  if (item.regional && REGION_FACTORS[region] && REGION_FACTORS[region][item.id]) {
    const f = REGION_FACTORS[region][item.id];
    lo *= f;
    hi *= f;
  }
  return {
    lo: income * lo,
    hi: income * hi
  };
}
function deriveMetrics(profile, exp, balances) {
  const region = profile.region;
  const income = (exp.incomeNet || 0) + (exp.incomeOther || 0) + (exp.incomeIrregular || 0);
  const inc = Math.max(income, 1);
  const byGroup = id => ITEMS.filter(i => i.g === id && i.kind !== 'income');
  const groupTotal = id => sum(byGroup(id).map(i => exp[i.id] || 0));
  const essentialsTotal = groupTotal('housing') + groupTotal('essentials');
  const lifestyleTotal = groupTotal('lifestyle');
  const obligationsTotal = groupTotal('obligations');
  const savingsTotal = (exp.savings || 0) + (exp.investments || 0) + (exp.pension || 0);
  const debtTotal = (exp.creditCards || 0) + (exp.loans || 0);
  const consumption = essentialsTotal + lifestyleTotal + obligationsTotal;
  const leftover = income - consumption - savingsTotal;
  const savingsRate = savingsTotal / inc;
  const essMonthly = essentialsTotal || 1;
  const efMonths = (balances.emergencyFund || 0) / essMonthly;
  const rows = ITEMS.filter(i => i.kind !== 'income' && i.lo != null).map(i => {
    const amt = exp[i.id] || 0;
    const b = benchFor(i, inc, region);
    let status = 'within';
    if (i.good) {
      status = amt < b.lo ? 'under' : amt > b.hi ? 'over-good' : 'within';
    } else {
      status = amt > b.hi ? 'over' : amt < b.lo ? 'under' : 'within';
    }
    const over = Math.max(0, amt - b.hi);
    return {
      ...i,
      amount: amt,
      lo: b.lo,
      hi: b.hi,
      status,
      over,
      pctOfInc: amt / inc
    };
  });
  const discRows = rows.filter(r => r.disc || r.g === 'lifestyle' || r.g === 'essentials' && r.over > 0);
  const realistic = sum(rows.filter(r => !r.good).map(r => r.over));
  const conservative = round(realistic * 0.5);
  const aggressive = round(sum(rows.filter(r => !r.good && (r.disc || r.g === 'lifestyle')).map(r => Math.max(0, r.amount - (r.lo + r.hi) / 2))) + realistic * 0.3);
  const topLeaks = rows.filter(r => !r.good && r.over > 0).sort((a, b) => b.over - a.over).slice(0, 5);
  const sc = {};
  sc.savingsRate = clamp(Math.round(savingsRate / 0.22 * 100), 0, 100);
  sc.emergencyFund = clamp(Math.round(efMonths / 6 * 100), 0, 100);
  sc.debtPressure = clamp(Math.round(100 - debtTotal / inc / 0.18 * 100), 0, 100);
  const overLeak = realistic / inc;
  sc.spendingEfficiency = clamp(Math.round(100 - overLeak / 0.18 * 100), 0, 100);
  sc.investmentReadiness = clamp(Math.round((efMonths >= 3 ? 40 : efMonths / 3 * 40) + ((exp.investments || 0) > 0 ? 25 : 0) + (savingsRate >= 0.1 ? 20 : savingsRate / 0.1 * 20) + (debtTotal / inc < 0.1 ? 15 : 5)), 0, 100);
  const stabilityMap = {
    'Very stable': 100,
    'Stable': 82,
    'Somewhat stable': 60,
    'Unstable': 35
  };
  sc.incomeStability = stabilityMap[profile.incomeStability] ?? 80;
  sc.lifestyleControl = clamp(Math.round(100 - Math.max(0, lifestyleTotal / inc - 0.18) / 0.18 * 100), 0, 100);
  const raw = sc.savingsRate * 0.22 + sc.emergencyFund * 0.18 + sc.debtPressure * 0.16 + sc.spendingEfficiency * 0.16 + sc.investmentReadiness * 0.12 + sc.incomeStability * 0.08 + sc.lifestyleControl * 0.08;
  const overall = clamp(Math.round(38 + raw * 0.62), 0, 100);
  const alloc = {
    essentials: round(essentialsTotal / inc * 100),
    lifestyle: round(lifestyleTotal / inc * 100),
    obligations: round(obligationsTotal / inc * 100),
    savings: round(savingsTotal / inc * 100),
    leftover: round(Math.max(0, leftover) / inc * 100)
  };
  const archetype = pickArchetype({
    savingsRate,
    lifestyleRatio: lifestyleTotal / inc,
    debtRatio: debtTotal / inc,
    efMonths,
    income,
    subs: (exp.subscriptions || 0) / inc,
    invest: exp.investments || 0
  });
  return {
    region,
    income,
    essentialsTotal,
    lifestyleTotal,
    obligationsTotal,
    savingsTotal,
    debtTotal,
    consumption,
    leftover,
    savingsRate,
    efMonths,
    rows,
    realistic,
    conservative,
    aggressive,
    topLeaks,
    scores: sc,
    overall,
    alloc,
    archetype,
    balances,
    expenses: exp
  };
}

function pickArchetype(m) {
  if (m.debtRatio > 0.16) return ARCHETYPES.rebuilder;
  if (m.efMonths >= 3 && m.savingsRate >= 0.15 && m.debtRatio < 0.1) return ARCHETYPES.investor;
  if (m.subs > 0.018 && m.lifestyleRatio > 0.16) return ARCHETYPES.leaker;
  if (m.income > 18000 && m.savingsRate < 0.1) return ARCHETYPES.highlow;
  if (m.lifestyleRatio > 0.22) return ARCHETYPES.lifestyle;
  if (m.savingsRate > 0.2 && m.invest < m.income * 0.05) return ARCHETYPES.saver;
  return ARCHETYPES.balanced;
}

const LEAK_TOOL = {
  subscriptions: '/subscriptions',
  creditCards: '/budget',
  rent: '/budget'

function deriveInsights(m, fmt) {
  const out = [];
  m.topLeaks.slice(0, 3).forEach((r, i) => out.push({
    type: 'leak',
    priority: i === 0 ? 'High' : 'Medium',
    title: `${r.label} is above benchmark`,
    explanation: `You spend ${fmt.money(r.amount)}, about ${fmt.money(r.over)} above the typical upper range of ${fmt.money(r.hi)} for your income and region.`,
    action: `Trim ${r.label.toLowerCase()} toward ${fmt.money(r.hi)} to reclaim roughly ${fmt.money(r.over)}/mo.`,
    impact: r.over,
    icon: r.icon,
    steps: LEAK_STEPS[r.id] || ['Look at last month’s statement for this category and find the three biggest items.', 'Set a monthly limit at the typical range and check it weekly.', 'Move what you save into savings the same day.'],
    tool: LEAK_TOOL[r.id] || '/budget'
  }));
  if (m.efMonths < 3) out.push({
    type: 'safety',
    priority: 'High',
    title: 'Emergency fund is below 3 months',
    explanation: `Your fund covers about ${m.efMonths.toFixed(1)} months of essentials. A 3-month buffer is the foundation everything else rests on.`,
    action: `Redirect part of your reclaimed savings into a separate emergency account until you reach 3 months.`,
    impact: 0,
    icon: 'shield',
    steps: [`Open a separate easy-access savings account just for emergencies.`, `Your target is about ${fmt.money(m.essentialsTotal * 3)}: three months of essentials.`, 'Send a fixed amount there on payday until you reach it.'],
    tool: '/emergency'
  });
  if (m.savingsRate < 0.15) out.push({
    type: 'growth',
    priority: 'Medium',
    title: 'Automate a higher savings rate',
    explanation: `Your current savings rate is ${(m.savingsRate * 100).toFixed(0)}%. Even a 5-point increase, automated on payday, compounds dramatically over a decade.`,
    action: `Set an automatic transfer the day after payday so saving happens before spending.`,
    impact: 0,
    icon: 'pig',
    steps: [`Aim for 15% of income: about ${fmt.money(m.income * 0.15)} a month.`, 'If that is too much now, start with 5% and add 1% every month.', 'Set the transfer for the day after payday so it happens first.'],
    tool: '/goals'
  });
  return out;
}

const rarityFromShare = pct => pct >= 50 ? 'Common' : pct >= 25 ? 'Uncommon' : pct >= 10 ? 'Rare' : pct >= 4 ? 'Epic' : pct >= 1 ? 'Legendary' : 'Mythic';
const RARITY_MIN_SAMPLE = 25;
function badgeHolderPct(id) {
  try {
    const accts = JSON.parse(__LS.getItem('lumera_accounts')) || {};
    const users = Object.values(accts).filter(Boolean);
    if (users.length < RARITY_MIN_SAMPLE) return null;
    const held = users.filter(u => u.badges && u.badges[id]).length;
    return Math.round(held / users.length * 100);
  } catch (e) {
    return null;
  }
}

function Icon({
  name,
  size = 20,
  sw = 1.7,
  className = '',
  style
}) {
  const d = P[name] || P.spark;
  return React.createElement("svg", {
    width: size,
    height: size,
    viewBox: "0 0 24 24",
    fill: "none",
    stroke: "currentColor",
    strokeWidth: sw,
    strokeLinecap: "round",
    strokeLinejoin: "round",
    className: className,
    style: style,
    "aria-hidden": "true"
  }, React.createElement("path", {
    d: d
  }));
}

  size = 40,

      height: size,
      width: 'auto',
      display: 'block',
      flexShrink: 0,
      filter: glow ? 'drop-shadow(0 2px 12px rgba(157,124,255,.35))' : undefined
    }
  });
}
function Logo({

  sub = false,
  stacked = false,

}) {

    src: assets.logoWord,
    alt: "Lumera",

      width: 'auto',

    }
  }) : React.createElement("div", {

    style: {
      fontSize: size * 0.86,
      letterSpacing: '.3em',
      lineHeight: 1
    }

  if (stacked) return React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex flex-col items-center select-none"
  }, mark, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "mt-2"
  }, word), (sub || tagline) && React.createElement("div", {
    className: cx('text-[9px] tracking-[.3em] uppercase mt-2.5 text-center', light ? 'text-cream/70' : 'text-faint')
  }, "Your financial intelligence, in one place."));
  return React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-center gap-4 select-none"
  }, mark, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "leading-none min-w-0"
  }, word, sub && React.createElement("div", {
    className: cx('text-[8.5px] tracking-[.24em] uppercase whitespace-nowrap mt-1.5', light ? 'text-cream/70' : 'text-faint')
  }, "Your financial intelligence")));
}

  };

function Btn({
  children,
  variant = 'primary',
  to,
  onClick,
  className = '',
  icon,
  iconR,
  type
}) {
  const app = useApp();
  const cls = cx('btn px-5 py-3 text-sm', variant === 'primary' && 'btn-primary', variant === 'gold' && 'btn-gold', variant === 'ghost' && 'btn-ghost', className);
  const handle = e => {
    if (onClick) onClick(e);
    if (to) app.nav(to);
  };
  return React.createElement("button", {
    type: type || 'button',
    onClick: handle,
    className: cls
  }, icon && React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: icon,
    size: 17
  }), children, iconR && React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: iconR,
    size: 17
  }));
}
function AnimatedNumber({
  value,
  money = false,
  dp = 0,
  suffix = '',
  prefix = '',
  className = ''
}) {
  const app = useApp();
  const fmt = app.fmt;
  const v = useCountUp(value, 1100, [value]);
  const text = money ? fmt.money(v, {
    dp
  }) : prefix + new Intl.NumberFormat().format(round(v, dp)) + suffix;
  return React.createElement("span", {
    className: cx('tnum', className)
  }, text);
}

function Hint({
  text,
  children
}) {
  const [pos, setPos] = useState(null);
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const show = () => {
    if (!ref.current) return;
    const r = ref.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const W = Math.min(240, window.innerWidth - 24);
    const half = W / 2;
    const x = Math.min(Math.max(r.left + r.width / 2, half + 10), window.innerWidth - half - 10);
    const up = r.bottom + 140 > window.innerHeight && r.top > 150;
    setPos({
      x,
      y: up ? r.top - 8 : r.bottom + 8,
      up,
      W
    });
  };
  const hide = () => setPos(null);
  const tip = pos && ReactDOM.createPortal(React.createElement("span", {
    className: "fixed z-[9999] anim-fadeIn pointer-events-none",
    style: {
      left: pos.x,
      top: pos.y,
      width: pos.W,
      transform: `translate(-50%, ${pos.up ? '-100%' : '0'})`
    }
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "block rounded-xl bg-charcoal text-cream text-xs leading-relaxed px-3 py-2 shadow-lift",
    style: {
      direction: 'ltr'
    }
  }, text)), document.body);
  return React.createElement("span", {
    ref: ref,
    className: "relative inline-flex",
    tabIndex: 0,
    title: typeof text === 'string' ? text : undefined,
    onMouseEnter: show,
    onFocus: show,
    onMouseLeave: hide,
    onBlur: hide,
    onClick: () => pos ? hide() : show()
  }, children, tip);
}

function ScoreRing({
  value,
  size = 180,
  stroke = 14,
  label,
  sub,
  color = COLORS.gold,
  delay = 0
}) {
  const r = (size - stroke) / 2,
    circ = 2 * Math.PI * r;
  const v = clamp(value, 0, 100);
  const off = circ - v / 100 * circ;
  const shown = Math.round(useCountUp(v, 1400, [v]));
  return React.createElement("div", {
    className: "relative inline-flex items-center justify-center",
    style: {
      width: size,
      height: size
    }
  }, React.createElement("svg", {
    width: size,
    height: size,
    className: "-rotate-90"
  }, React.createElement("circle", {
    cx: size / 2,
    cy: size / 2,
    r: r,
    fill: "none",
    stroke: "currentColor",
    className: "text-sand",
    strokeWidth: stroke
  }), React.createElement("circle", {
    cx: size / 2,
    cy: size / 2,
    r: r,
    fill: "none",
    stroke: color,
    strokeWidth: stroke,
    strokeLinecap: "round",
    strokeDasharray: circ,
    style: {
      '--circ': circ,
      '--off': off,
      animation: `ringdraw 1.5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) ${delay}s both`
    }
  }), React.createElement("circle", {
    cx: size / 2,
    cy: size / 2,
    r: r,
    fill: "none",
    stroke: "url(#shine)",
    strokeWidth: stroke,
    strokeLinecap: "round",
    strokeDasharray: circ,
    strokeDashoffset: off,
    opacity: "0.25"
  }), React.createElement("defs", null, React.createElement("linearGradient", {
    id: "shine",
    x1: "0",
    y1: "0",
    x2: "1",
    y2: "1"
  }, React.createElement("stop", {
    offset: "0",
    stopColor: "#fff"
  }), React.createElement("stop", {
    offset: "1",
    stopColor: color
  })))), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center",
    style: {
      padding: stroke + 6
    }
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "font-serif text-charcoal tnum leading-none",
    style: {
      fontSize: Math.max(18, size * 0.22)
    }
  }, shown), label && React.createElement("div", {
    className: "uppercase text-faint mt-1 leading-none",
    style: {
      fontSize: Math.max(8, size * 0.055),
      letterSpacing: size >= 140 ? '.18em' : '.08em'
    }
  }, label), sub && size >= 120 && React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-xs text-muted mt-1"
  }, sub)));
}
function Donut({
  segments,
  size = 180,
  stroke = 22,
  center
}) {
  const r = (size - stroke) / 2,
    circ = 2 * Math.PI * r;
  let acc = 0;
  const total = sum(segments.map(s => s.value)) || 1;
  return React.createElement("div", {
    className: "relative inline-flex items-center justify-center",
    style: {
      width: size,
      height: size
    }
  }, React.createElement("svg", {
    width: size,
    height: size,
    className: "-rotate-90"
  }, React.createElement("circle", {
    cx: size / 2,
    cy: size / 2,
    r: r,
    fill: "none",
    stroke: "#EDE6D9",
    strokeWidth: stroke
  }), segments.map((s, i) => {
    const frac = s.value / total;
    const len = frac * circ;
    const off = circ - acc;
    acc += len;
    return React.createElement("circle", {
      key: i,
      cx: size / 2,
      cy: size / 2,
      r: r,
      fill: "none",
      stroke: s.color,
      strokeWidth: stroke,
      strokeDasharray: `${len} ${circ - len}`,
      strokeDashoffset: off,
      style: {
        transition: 'stroke-dasharray .9s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)',
        animation: `fadeIn .8s ${i * 0.08}s both`
      }
    });
  })), center && React.createElement("div", {
    className: "absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center"
  }, center));
}

function AreaProjection({
  a,
  b,
  width = 560,
  height = 210,
  labels = ['If you change nothing', 'If you follow the plan']
}) {
  const pad = 28;
  const W = width,
    H = height;
  const max = Math.max(...a, ...b, 1) * 1.05;
  const n = a.length;
  const x = i => pad + i / (n - 1) * (W - pad * 2);
  const y = v => H - pad - v / max * (H - pad * 1.6);
  const line = arr => arr.map((v, i) => `${i ? 'L' : 'M'}${x(i)},${y(v)}`).join(' ');
  const area = arr => `${line(arr)} L${x(n - 1)},${H - pad} L${x(0)},${H - pad} Z`;
  return React.createElement("svg", {
    viewBox: `0 0 ${W} ${H}`,
    className: "w-full h-auto"
  }, React.createElement("defs", null, React.createElement("linearGradient", {
    id: "ga",
    x1: "0",
    y1: "0",
    x2: "0",
    y2: "1"
  }, React.createElement("stop", {
    offset: "0",
    stopColor: COLORS.gold,
    stopOpacity: ".28"
  }), React.createElement("stop", {
    offset: "1",
    stopColor: COLORS.gold,
    stopOpacity: "0"
  })), React.createElement("linearGradient", {
    id: "gb",
    x1: "0",
    y1: "0",
    x2: "0",
    y2: "1"
  }, React.createElement("stop", {
    offset: "0",
    stopColor: "#6E8B6A",
    stopOpacity: ".30"
  }), React.createElement("stop", {
    offset: "1",
    stopColor: "#6E8B6A",
    stopOpacity: "0"
  }))), [0, .5, 1].map((g, i) => React.createElement("line", {
    key: i,
    x1: pad,
    x2: W - pad,
    y1: pad + (H - pad * 1.6) * g,
    y2: pad + (H - pad * 1.6) * g,
    stroke: "currentColor",
    className: "text-line",
    strokeWidth: "1"
  })), React.createElement("path", {
    d: area(a),
    fill: "url(#ga)"
  }), React.createElement("path", {
    d: area(b),
    fill: "url(#gb)"
  }), React.createElement("path", {
    d: line(a),
    fill: "none",
    stroke: COLORS.gold,
    strokeWidth: "2.4",
    strokeLinecap: "round",
    style: {
      strokeDasharray: 1400,
      animation: 'none'
    }
  }), React.createElement("path", {
    d: line(b),
    fill: "none",
    stroke: "#4C6447",
    strokeWidth: "2.6",
    strokeLinecap: "round"
  }), React.createElement("circle", {
    cx: x(n - 1),
    cy: y(b[n - 1]),
    r: "4.5",
    fill: "#4C6447"
  }), React.createElement("circle", {
    cx: x(n - 1),
    cy: y(a[n - 1]),
    r: "4",
    fill: COLORS.gold
  }));
}
function LineChart({
  data,
  width = 560,
  height = 210,
  color = COLORS.sage,
  fill = true,
  fmt = null,
  labels = null
}) {
  const padL = 54,
    padR = 14,
    padT = 14,
    padB = 26;
  const W = width,
    H = height;
  const raw = Math.max(...data);
  const min = Math.min(...data, 0);
  const nice = v => {
    if (v <= 0) return 1;
    const p = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(v)));
    const r = v / p;
    const steps = [1, 1.1, 1.2, 1.25, 1.4, 1.5, 1.6, 1.75, 2, 2.25, 2.5, 3, 3.5, 4, 4.5, 5, 6, 7, 7.5, 8, 9, 10];
    return (steps.find(x => r <= x) || 10) * p;
  };
  const max = nice(raw * 1.04) || 1;
  const n = data.length;
  const x = i => padL + i / (n - 1) * (W - padL - padR);
  const y = v => H - padB - (v - min) / (max - min || 1) * (H - padB - padT);
  const ln = data.map((v, i) => `${i ? 'L' : 'M'}${x(i)},${y(v)}`).join(' ');
  const short = v => Math.abs(v) >= 1e6 ? (v / 1e6).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '') + 'M' : Math.abs(v) >= 1e3 ? Math.round(v / 1e3) + 'k' : Math.round(v);
  const ticks = [0, .25, .5, .75, 1].map(g => min + (max - min) * g);
  const gid = 'lf' + String(color).replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, '');
  return React.createElement("svg", {
    viewBox: `0 0 ${W} ${H}`,
    className: "w-full h-auto"
  }, React.createElement("defs", null, React.createElement("linearGradient", {
    id: gid,
    x1: "0",
    y1: "0",
    x2: "0",
    y2: "1"
  }, React.createElement("stop", {
    offset: "0",
    stopColor: color,
    stopOpacity: ".25"
  }), React.createElement("stop", {
    offset: "1",
    stopColor: color,
    stopOpacity: "0"
  }))), ticks.map((v, i) => React.createElement("g", {
    key: i
  }, React.createElement("line", {
    x1: padL,
    x2: W - padR,
    y1: y(v),
    y2: y(v),
    stroke: "currentColor",
    className: "text-line",
    strokeWidth: "1"
  }), React.createElement("text", {
    x: padL - 8,
    y: y(v) + 3.5,
    textAnchor: "end",
    fontSize: "10",
    fill: "currentColor",
    className: "text-faint"
  }, fmt ? fmt(v) : short(v)))), fill && React.createElement("path", {
    d: `${ln} L${x(n - 1)},${H - padB} L${x(0)},${H - padB} Z`,
    fill: `url(#${gid})`
  }), React.createElement("path", {
    d: ln,
    fill: "none",
    stroke: color,
    strokeWidth: "2.6",
    strokeLinecap: "round",
    strokeLinejoin: "round"
  }), data.map((v, i) => i % Math.ceil(n / 6) === 0 || i === n - 1 ? React.createElement("circle", {
    key: i,
    cx: x(i),
    cy: y(v),
    r: "3.2",
    fill: color
  }) : null), labels && labels.map((l, i) => l ? React.createElement("text", {
    key: i,
    x: x(i),
    y: H - 8,
    textAnchor: "middle",
    fontSize: "10",
    fill: "currentColor",
    className: "text-faint"
  }, l) : null));
}

  }, d.l))));
}
function LuxSlider({
  value,
  min = 0,
  max = 100,
  step = 1,
  onChange,
  label,
  suffix = '',
  fmt,
  bubble = false
}) {
  const p = (value - min) / (max - min) * 100;
  const [drag, setDrag] = useState(false);
  return React.createElement("div", null, label && React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-center justify-between mb-2"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-sm font-medium text-charcoal"
  }, label), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "tnum text-sm font-semibold text-goldd"
  }, fmt ? fmt(value) : value + suffix)), React.createElement("div", {
    className: cx('relative', bubble && 'pt-7')
  }, bubble && drag && React.createElement("div", {
    className: "absolute top-0 -translate-x-1/2 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-charcoal text-cream text-[11px] tnum whitespace-nowrap shadow-soft anim-fadeIn",
    style: {
      left: `${clamp(p, 5, 95)}%`
    }
  }, fmt ? fmt(value) : value + suffix, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "absolute left-1/2 -bottom-1 -translate-x-1/2 h-2 w-2 rotate-45 bg-charcoal"
  })), React.createElement("input", {
    type: "range",
    className: "lux w-full",
    min: min,
    max: max,
    step: step,
    value: value,
    onPointerDown: () => setDrag(true),
    onPointerUp: () => setDrag(false),
    onPointerCancel: () => setDrag(false),
    onBlur: () => setDrag(false),
    style: {
      '--p': p + '%'
    },
    onChange: e => onChange(Number(e.target.value))
  })));
}
function LanguageSwitcher({
  compact = false
}) {
  const app = useApp();
  const menu = useAnchoredMenu();
  const cur = LANGS.find(l => l.code === app.lang) || LANGS[0];
  return React.createElement(React.Fragment, null, React.createElement("button", {
    ref: menu.btnRef,
    onClick: menu.toggle,
    "aria-haspopup": "menu",
    "aria-expanded": menu.open,
    "aria-label": 'Language: ' + cur.native,
    className: "btn btn-ghost px-3 py-2 text-xs"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "globe",
    size: 15
  }), compact ? cur.code.toUpperCase() : cur.native, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "chevron",
    size: 13,
    className: "rotate-90 opacity-60"
  })), React.createElement(MenuPanel, {
    menu: menu,
    width: 196,
    label: "Language"
  }, LANGS.map(l => React.createElement("button", {
    key: l.code,
    role: "menuitemradio",
    "aria-checked": app.lang === l.code,
    onClick: () => {
      app.setLang(l.code);
      menu.close();

function useAnchoredMenu() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [pos, setPos] = useState(null);
  const btnRef = useRef(null);
  const panelRef = useRef(null);
  const place = useCallback(() => {
    const b = btnRef.current;
    if (!b) return;
    const r = b.getBoundingClientRect();
    const rtl = document.documentElement.dir === 'rtl';
    setPos(rtl ? {
      top: r.bottom + 10,
      left: Math.max(8, r.left)
    } : {
      top: r.bottom + 10,
      right: Math.max(8, window.innerWidth - r.right)
    });
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    place();
    const out = e => {
      const t = e.target;
      if (btnRef.current && btnRef.current.contains(t) || panelRef.current && panelRef.current.contains(t)) return;
      setOpen(false);
    };
    const key = e => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        setOpen(false);
        btnRef.current && btnRef.current.focus();
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', out, true);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', key);
    window.addEventListener('resize', place);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', place, true);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', out, true);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', key);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', place);
      window.removeEventListener('scroll', place, true);
    };
  }, [open, place]);
  return {
    open,
    setOpen,
    toggle: () => setOpen(o => !o),
    close: () => setOpen(false),
    btnRef,
    panelRef,
    pos
  };
}
function MenuPanel({
  menu,
  width = 240,
  className = '',
  label,
  children
}) {
  if (!menu.open || !menu.pos) return null;
  return ReactDOM.createPortal(React.createElement("div", {
    ref: menu.panelRef,
    role: "menu",
    "aria-label": label,
    className: cx('fixed z-[190] lg-popover rounded-xl2 border border-line bg-cream shadow-lift p-1.5 anim-scaleIn max-h-[calc(100vh-96px)] overflow-y-auto no-scrollbar', className),
    style: {
      top: menu.pos.top,
      right: menu.pos.right,
      left: menu.pos.left,
      width
    }
  }, children), document.body);
}
function useOutsideClose(open, onClose) {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const cb = useRef(onClose);
  cb.current = onClose;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const h = e => {
      const el = ref.current;
      if (el && !el.contains(e.target)) cb.current();
    };
    const k = e => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') cb.current();
    };
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', h, true);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', k);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', h, true);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', k);
    };
  }, [open]);
  return ref;
}

const LAYOUT_KEY = 'lumera_layout';
const WORLD_KEYS = ['leaf', 'atlas', 'shield', 'forge'];
function defaultLayout() {
  return {
    worlds: WORLD_KEYS.reduce((o, k) => {
      o[k] = true;
      return o;
    }, {}),
    sections: NAV.map(g => ({
      name: g.section,
      on: true,
      items: g.items.map(i => i.to)
    })),
    moved: []
  };
}
let _movedRoutes = new Set();
function setMovedRoutes(layout) {
  _movedRoutes = new Set(layout && Array.isArray(layout.moved) ? layout.moved : []);
}
function loadLayout() {
  const def = defaultLayout();
  let saved = null;
  try {
    saved = JSON.parse(__LS.getItem(LAYOUT_KEY));
  } catch (e) {}
  if (!saved || typeof saved !== 'object') return def;
  const worlds = {};
  WORLD_KEYS.forEach(k => {
    worlds[k] = saved.worlds && k in saved.worlds ? !!saved.worlds[k] : true;
  });
  const known = {};
  def.sections.forEach(sec => {
    known[sec.name] = sec;
  });
  const seenSec = {},
    seenItem = {};
  const sections = [];
  (Array.isArray(saved.sections) ? saved.sections : []).forEach(sec => {
    if (!sec || !known[sec.name] || seenSec[sec.name]) return;
    seenSec[sec.name] = 1;
    const valid = known[sec.name].items;
    const items = (Array.isArray(sec.items) ? sec.items : []).filter(r => valid.includes(r) && !seenItem[r] && (seenItem[r] = 1));
    sections.push({
      name: sec.name,
      on: sec.on !== false,
      items
    });
  });
  def.sections.forEach(sec => {
    const existing = sections.find(x => x.name === sec.name);
    const missing = sec.items.filter(r => !seenItem[r]);
    if (existing) existing.items = existing.items.concat(missing);else if (!seenSec[sec.name]) sections.push({
      name: sec.name,
      on: true,
      items: missing.length ? missing : sec.items.slice()
    });
    missing.forEach(r => {
      seenItem[r] = 1;
    });
  });
  const moved = (Array.isArray(saved.moved) ? saved.moved : []).filter(r => typeof r === 'string' && r.charAt(0) === '/');
  const launched = {};
  WORLD_KEYS.forEach(w => {
    launched[w] = !!(saved.launched && saved.launched[w]);
  });
  return {
    worlds,
    sections,
    moved,
    launched
  };
}
let _worldOfRoute = null;
function worldOfRoute(path) {
  if (_movedRoutes.has(path)) return null;
  if (!_worldOfRoute) {
    if (typeof SUBS === 'undefined') return null;
    _worldOfRoute = {};
    SUBS.forEach(sub => {
      if (sub.key !== 'lumera') sub.routes.forEach(r => {
        _worldOfRoute[r] = sub.key;
      });
    });
  }
  return _worldOfRoute[path] || null;
}
function worldOn(layout, key) {
  return !key || !layout || !layout.worlds || layout.worlds[key] !== false;
}
function routeAllowed(layout, path) {
  return worldOn(layout, worldOfRoute(path));
}
function navFrom(layout) {
  if (!layout || !Array.isArray(layout.sections)) return NAV;
  return layout.sections.filter(sec => sec.on !== false).map(sec => ({
    section: sec.name,
    items: sec.items.map(r => NAV_BY_ROUTE_LAZY(r)).filter(Boolean)
  })).filter(g => g.items.length);
}
function NAV_BY_ROUTE_LAZY(r) {
  return typeof NAV_BY_ROUTE !== 'undefined' ? NAV_BY_ROUTE[r] : null;
}

function GlobalSearch() {
  const app = useApp();
  const {
    t
  } = app;
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false),
    [q, setQ] = useState(''),
    [sel, setSel] = useState(0);
  const [listening, setListening] = useState(false),
    [voiceErr, setVoiceErr] = useState('');
  const inputRef = useRef(null);
  const recRef = useRef(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    const h = e => {
      if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') {
        e.preventDefault();
        setOpen(o => !o);
      }
      if (e.key === 'Escape') setOpen(false);
    };
    const o = () => setOpen(true);
    window.addEventListener('keydown', h);
    window.addEventListener('lumera:search', o);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', h);
      window.removeEventListener('lumera:search', o);
    };
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setQ('');
      setSel(0);
      setVoiceErr('');
      setTimeout(() => inputRef.current && inputRef.current.focus(), 40);
    }
  }, [open]);
  const items = useMemo(() => {
    const seen = {};
    const out = [];
    SUBS.forEach(s => s.routes.forEach(r => {
      const it = NAV_BY_ROUTE[r];
      if (!it || seen[r] || !flagForRoute(app.flags, r)) return;
      seen[r] = 1;
      out.push({
        to: r,
        label: t(it.k),
        desc: SUB_TOOL_DESC[r] || '',
        emoji: TOOL_EMOJI[r] || '•',
        world: s.name
      });
    }));
    ['/assistant', '/settings', '/about', '/team', '/pricing', '/privacy', '/hub'].forEach(r => {
      if (seen[r]) return;
      seen[r] = 1;
      const names = {
        '/assistant': 'AI Assistant',
        '/settings': 'Settings',
        '/about': 'About Lumera',
        '/team': 'Our Team',
        '/pricing': 'Pricing',
        '/privacy': 'Privacy',
        '/hub': 'The Lumera family'
      };
      out.push({
        to: r,
        label: names[r],
        desc: SUB_TOOL_DESC[r] || '',
        emoji: '⚙️',
        world: 'Lumera'
      });
    });
    return out;
  }, [app.flags, t]);
  const results = useMemo(() => {
    const s = q.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!s) return items.slice(0, 8);
    return items.filter(x => (x.label + ' ' + x.desc + ' ' + x.world).toLowerCase().includes(s)).slice(0, 10);
  }, [q, items]);
  const goTo = it => {
    if (!it) return;
    setOpen(false);
    app.nav(it.to);
  };
  const onKey = e => {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setSel(s => Math.min(s + 1, results.length - 1));
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setSel(s => Math.max(s - 1, 0));
    } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      goTo(results[sel]);
    }
  };
  const SR = typeof window !== 'undefined' && (window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition);
  const toggleVoice = () => {
    if (!SR) {
      setVoiceErr('Voice search is not supported in this browser.');
      return;
    }
    if (listening) {
      try {
        recRef.current && recRef.current.stop();
      } catch (e) {}
      setListening(false);
      return;
    }
    try {
      const r = new SR();
      recRef.current = r;
      r.lang = app.lang === 'ar' ? 'ar-AE' : app.lang === 'fr' ? 'fr-FR' : app.lang === 'es' ? 'es-ES' : app.lang === 'de' ? 'de-DE' : 'en-US';
      r.interimResults = true;
      r.continuous = false;
      r.onresult = ev => {
        const txt = Array.from(ev.results).map(x => x[0].transcript).join('');
        setQ(txt);
        setSel(0);
      };
      r.onerror = () => {
        setVoiceErr('Could not hear anything. Try again.');
        setListening(false);
      };
      r.onend = () => setListening(false);
      r.start();
      setListening(true);
      setVoiceErr('');
    } catch (e) {
      setVoiceErr('Voice search could not start.');
      setListening(false);
    }
  };
  return React.createElement(Fragment, null, React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: () => setOpen(true),
    "aria-label": "Search Lumera",
    title: "Search (Ctrl+K)",
    className: "lg-searchicon"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "search",
    size: 18
  }), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "lg-searchicon-text"
  }, "Search Lumera")), open && ReactDOM.createPortal(React.createElement("div", {
    className: "fixed inset-0 z-[180] flex items-start justify-center p-4 pt-[12vh]"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "absolute inset-0",
    style: {
      background: 'rgba(8,8,16,.6)',
      backdropFilter: 'blur(4px)'
    },
    onClick: () => setOpen(false)
  }), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "relative w-full max-w-xl lux-card !p-0 overflow-hidden anim-scaleIn"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 border-b border-line"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "search",
    size: 18,
    className: "text-faint shrink-0"
  }), React.createElement("input", {
    ref: inputRef,
    value: q,
    onChange: e => {
      setQ(e.target.value);
      setSel(0);
    },
    onKeyDown: onKey,
    placeholder: "Search tools, pages and features\u2026",
    className: "flex-1 bg-transparent text-base focus:outline-none text-charcoal"
  }), React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: toggleVoice,
    title: listening ? 'Stop listening' : 'Search by voice',
    className: cx('grid place-items-center h-9 w-9 rounded-lg transition shrink-0', listening ? 'bg-berry/15 text-berry' : 'text-faint hover:bg-sand')
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "mic",
    size: 17
  })), React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: () => setOpen(false),
    className: "grid place-items-center h-9 w-9 rounded-lg text-faint hover:bg-sand shrink-0"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "x",
    size: 16
  }))), listening && React.createElement("div", {
    className: "px-4 py-2 text-xs flex items-center gap-2",
    style: {
      color: '#DC2626'
    }
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-berry",
    style: {
      animation: 'pulse 1.2s infinite'
    }
  }), "Listening, speak now\u2026"), voiceErr && React.createElement("div", {
    className: "px-4 py-2 text-xs text-muted"
  }, voiceErr), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "max-h-[52vh] overflow-y-auto py-2"
  }, results.length === 0 ? React.createElement("div", {
    className: "px-4 py-8 text-center text-sm text-muted"
  }, "Nothing matches \u201C", q, "\u201D.") : results.map((it, i) => React.createElement("button", {
    key: it.to,
    onMouseEnter: () => setSel(i),
    onClick: () => goTo(it),
    className: cx('w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2.5 text-left transition', i === sel ? 'bg-sand' : 'hover:bg-sand/60')
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-xl shrink-0"
  }, it.emoji), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "min-w-0 flex-1"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "block text-sm font-medium text-charcoal truncate"
  }, it.label), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "block text-xs text-faint truncate"
  }, it.desc)), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-faint shrink-0"
  }, it.world)))), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "px-4 py-2 border-t border-line text-[11px] text-faint flex items-center gap-3"
  }, React.createElement("span", null, "\u2191\u2193 to move"), React.createElement("span", null, "\u21B5 to open"), React.createElement("span", null, "esc to close"), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "ml-auto"
  }, "Ctrl / \u2318 + K")))), document.body));
}

function ThemeToggle() {
  const app = useApp();
  const isDark = app.theme === 'dark' || app.theme === 'system' && typeof matchMedia !== 'undefined' && matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
  return React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: () => app.setTheme(isDark ? 'light' : 'dark'),
    title: isDark ? 'Switch to light' : 'Switch to dark',
    "aria-label": "Toggle theme",
    className: "grid place-items-center h-10 w-10 rounded-full hover:bg-sand text-charcoal/80 transition"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: isDark ? 'sun' : 'moon',
    size: 18
  }));
}
function SyncStatus() {
  const app = useApp();
  const st = app.sync || 'local';
  const map = {
    saved: ['', 'Saved'],
    saving: ['busy', 'Saving…'],
    offline: ['warn', 'Offline'],
    error: ['bad', 'Not saved, retrying'],
    local: ['off', 'Saved in this browser']
  };
  const long = {
    saved: 'Saved to your account',
    saving: 'Saving to your account',
    offline: 'You are offline. Changes will save when you reconnect.',
    error: 'Could not save just now. Retrying.',
    local: 'Not signed in to an account: your figures are saved in this browser only'
  };
  if (st === 'local') return null;
  const [cls, label] = map[st] || map.local;
  return React.createElement("span", {
    className: "hidden md:inline-flex lg-pill",
    role: "status",
    title: long[st] || label
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: cx('lg-orb', cls),
    "aria-hidden": "true"
  }), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "hidden 2xl:inline"
  }, label), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "2xl:hidden sr-only"
  }, long[st] || label));
}

function lumeraReport(d, m, fmt) {
  const e = v => String(v == null ? '' : v).replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    '"': '&quot;'
  })[c]);
  const money = v => e(fmt.money(Number(v) || 0));
  const name = d.account && d.account.name || d.profile && d.profile.name || 'You';
  const st = d.state || d;
  const exp = st.expenses || d.expenses || {};
  const bal = st.balances || d.balances || {};
  const goals = st.goals || d.goals || [];
  const subs = st.subs || d.subs || [];
  const rows = ITEMS.filter(i => i.kind !== 'income' && Number(exp[i.id]) > 0).map(i => [i.label, Number(exp[i.id])]).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
  const spend = rows.reduce((t, r) => t + r[1], 0),
    max = Math.max(1, ...rows.map(r => r[1]));
  const tile = (l, v, c) => `<div class="tile" style="--c:${c}"><div class="l">${e(l)}</div><div class="v">${v}</div></div>`;
  const posts = (d.posts || []).map(p => `<li><b>${e(p.tag)}</b> · ${e(new Date(p.created_at).toLocaleDateString())}<br>${e(p.body)}</li>`).join('');
  return `<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Lumera report · ${e(name)}</title><style>
*{box-sizing:border-box} body{margin:0;font-family:Manrope,system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;color:#1d1b2b;background:#f6f4fb}
.page{max-width:860px;margin:0 auto;padding:40px 28px 60px}
header{border-radius:24px;padding:28px;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#7C3AED,#4F46E5 55%,#0D9488)}
header h1{font-family:'Instrument Serif',Georgia,serif;font-weight:400;font-size:40px;margin:6px 0 4px} header p{margin:0;opacity:.85}
.kicker{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.9}
h2{font-family:'Instrument Serif',Georgia,serif;font-weight:400;font-size:26px;margin:34px 0 12px}
.tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-top:20px}
.tile{background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:14px 16px;border-top:4px solid var(--c);box-shadow:0 6px 20px -12px rgba(30,20,80,.35)}

<div class="tiles">${tile('Health score', m && m.income > 1 ? e(m.overall) + '/100' : '–', '#8B5CF6')}${tile('Monthly income', money(exp.incomeNet), '#22C55E')}${tile('Monthly spending', money(spend), '#EC4899')}${tile('Savings rate', m ? Math.round(m.savingsRate * 100) + '%' : '–', '#F59E0B')}${tile('Safety net', m ? e(m.efMonths.toFixed(1)) + ' months' : '–', '#3B82F6')}</div>
<h2>Where your money goes</h2>${rows.length ? `<table><tr><th>Category</th><th></th><th class="n">Per month</th></tr>${rows.map(([l, v]) => `<tr><td>${e(l)}</td><td style="width:40%"><div class="bar" style="width:${Math.max(4, v / max * 100)}%"></div></td><td class="n">${money(v)}</td></tr>`).join('')}</table>` : '<p class="muted">No spending figures saved yet.</p>'}
<h2>Balances</h2><table><tr><th>Account</th><th class="n">Balance</th></tr>${[['Emergency fund', bal.emergencyFund], ['Cash savings', bal.cashSavings], ['Investments', bal.investmentsBal]].map(([l, v]) => `<tr><td>${l}</td><td class="n">${money(v)}</td></tr>`).join('')}</table>
<h2>Goals</h2>${goals.length ? `<table><tr><th>Goal</th><th class="n">Saved</th><th class="n">Target</th><th class="n">By</th></tr>${goals.map(g => `<tr><td>${e(g.name)}</td><td class="n">${money(g.current)}</td><td class="n">${money(g.target)}</td><td class="n">${e(g.deadline || '')}</td></tr>`).join('')}</table>` : '<p class="muted">No goals yet.</p>'}
<h2>Subscriptions</h2>${subs.length ? `<table><tr><th>Service</th><th>Used</th><th>Decision</th><th class="n">Per month</th></tr>${subs.map(x => `<tr><td>${e(x.name)}</td><td>${e(x.freq || '')}</td><td>${e(x.verdict || '')}</td><td class="n">${money(x.cost)}</td></tr>`).join('')}</table>` : '<p class="muted">No subscriptions yet.</p>'}
${posts ? `<h2>Your community posts</h2><ul>${posts}</ul>` : ''}
<p class="muted" style="margin-top:30px">Educational guidance only, not financial advice. To save as a PDF, use your browser’s Print option.</p>
<details><summary>Complete data (machine-readable)</summary><pre>${e(JSON.stringify(d, null, 2))}</pre></details>
</div></body></html>`;
}

function PageHead({
  eyebrow,
  title,
  desc,
  action
}) {
  const words = typeof title === 'string' ? title.trim().split(' ') : null;
  const head = words && words.length > 2 ? React.createElement(React.Fragment, null, words.slice(0, -2).join(' '), " ", React.createElement("span", {
    className: "gold-text"
  }, words.slice(-2).join(' '))) : title;
  return React.createElement("div", {
    className: "page-head mb-10"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-4"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "min-w-0 max-w-2xl"
  }, eyebrow && React.createElement(Eyebrow, {
    className: "mb-3"
  }, eyebrow), React.createElement("h1", {
    className: "font-serif text-[2rem] sm:text-[2.6rem] text-charcoal leading-[1.06]"
  }, head), desc && React.createElement("p", {
    className: "lede text-muted mt-3 leading-relaxed"
  }, desc)), action && React.createElement("div", {
    className: "w-full min-w-0 sm:w-auto sm:shrink-0"
  }, action)));
}

    name: icon,
    size: 28
  })), React.createElement("h3", {
    className: "font-serif text-xl text-charcoal"
  }, title), desc && React.createElement("p", {
    className: "text-muted mt-1 max-w-sm mx-auto text-sm"
  }, desc), action && React.createElement("div", {
    className: "mt-4"
  }, action));
}

function QuizBar({
  onBack,
  onSkip,
  onNext,
  nextLabel,
  nextDisabled,
  note
}) {
  return React.createElement("div", {
    className: "quiz-bar",
    role: "group",
    "aria-label": "Questionnaire navigation"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "quiz-bar-inner"
  }, React.createElement("button", {
    type: "button",
    onClick: onBack,
    disabled: !onBack,
    className: "btn btn-ghost px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "chevL",
    size: 16
  }), "Back"), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "flex-1 min-w-0 text-center text-xs text-faint truncate",
    "aria-live": "polite"
  }, note), onSkip && React.createElement("button", {
    type: "button",
    onClick: onSkip,
    className: "btn btn-ghost px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm"
  }, "Skip"), React.createElement("button", {
    type: "button",
    onClick: onNext,
    disabled: nextDisabled,
    "aria-disabled": nextDisabled,

  }, nextLabel, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "arrowR",
    size: 16
  }))));
}
function Onboarding() {
  const app = useApp();
  const {
    t
  } = app;
  const [step, setStep] = useState(0);
  const P = app.profile;
  const [d, setD] = useState({
    goal: P.goal || '',
    region: P.region || '',
    currency: P.currency || (REGIONS[P.region] || {}).currency || 'GBP',
    ageBracket: P.ageBracket || '',
    householdSize: P.householdSize || 1,
    dependents: P.dependents || 0,
    status: P.status || '',
    housing: P.housing || '',
    knowledge: P.knowledge || '',
    risk: P.risk || 'Balanced',
    savingsGoal: P.savingsGoal || '',
    motivations: Array.isArray(P.motivations) ? P.motivations : [],
    heardFrom: Array.isArray(P.heardFrom) ? P.heardFrom : [],
    city: P.city || ''
  });
  const set = (k, v) => setD(s => ({
    ...s,
    [k]: v
  }));
  const Q = [{
    k: 'region',
    q: 'Where are you based?',
    why: 'So we compare your spending against the right region, and set your currency.',
    kind: 'region'
  }, {
    k: 'ageBracket',
    q: 'Your age range?',
    why: 'Benchmarks and priorities differ by life stage. Lumera is built for every age, including students.',
    opts: ['Under 16', '16-17', '18-24', '25-27', '28-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
  }, {
    k: 'motivations',
    q: 'What brings you to Lumera?',
    why: 'We surface the tools that match your goals first. Pick as many as you like.',
    kind: 'multi',
    other: true,
    opts: ['Get on top of my spending', 'Start saving properly', 'Learn how money works', 'Start investing', 'Pay off debt', 'Build my credit', 'Plan my career', 'Find side income', 'Choose a university or subjects', 'Prepare for retirement']
  }, {
    k: 'status',
    q: 'Your employment status?',
    why: 'Income stability affects your recommended buffer.',
    opts: ['Employed full-time', 'Self-employed', 'Part-time', 'Student', 'Between jobs']
  }, {
    k: 'housing',
    q: 'Your housing situation?',
    why: 'Housing is usually the largest line, we benchmark it carefully.',
    opts: ['Renting', 'Mortgage', 'Live with family', 'Own outright']
  }, {
    k: 'knowledge',
    q: 'How would you rate your financial knowledge?',
    why: 'We tune explanations to your level, never condescending.',
    opts: ['Just starting', 'Beginner+', 'Comfortable', 'Advanced']
  }, {
    k: 'heardFrom',
    q: 'How did you hear about us?',
    why: 'Optional, and it helps us know where our community is coming from.',
    kind: 'multi',
    other: true,
    opts: ['A friend or family member', 'Instagram', 'TikTok', 'LinkedIn', 'YouTube', 'X (Twitter)', 'Search engine', 'School or university', 'A podcast', 'An event']
  }];
  const ccyPicked = useRef(false);
  const lastCcy = useRef(app.profile.currency);
  useEffect(() => {
    const c = app.profile.currency;
    if (c && c !== lastCcy.current) {
      lastCcy.current = c;
      ccyPicked.current = true;
      setD(s => ({
        ...s,
        currency: c
      }));
    }
  }, [app.profile.currency]);
  const total = Q.length;
  const cur = Q[step];
  const progress = Math.round(step / total * 100);
  const answered = cur.kind === 'multi' || cur.kind === 'text' || !!d[cur.k];
  const next = () => {
    if (!answered) return;
    if (step < total - 1) setStep(step + 1);else finish();
  };
  const finish = () => {
    const R = REGIONS[d.region];
    const ccy = d.currency || R && R.currency || 'GBP';
    const asList = v => Array.isArray(v) ? v : v ? [v] : [];
    const mo = asList(d.motivations);
    const goal = mo.some(x => /university|subjects/i.test(x)) ? 'A big purchase' : mo.some(x => /retirement/i.test(x)) ? 'Retirement' : mo.some(x => /investing/i.test(x)) ? 'Investing' : mo.some(x => /debt/i.test(x)) ? 'Emergency fund' : 'Emergency fund';
    app.updateProfile({
      ...d,
      motivations: mo,
      heardFrom: asList(d.heardFrom),
      region: d.region,
      currency: ccy,
      baseCurrency: ccy,
      city: d.city || '',
      savingsGoal: d.savingsGoal || goal
    });
    app.nav('/review');
  };
  return React.createElement("div", {
    className: "min-h-screen flex flex-col"
  }, React.createElement("header", {
    className: "px-4 sm:px-6 h-16 flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-line glass sticky top-0 z-20"
  }, React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: () => logoHome(app),
    "aria-label": "Lumera home"
  }, React.createElement(Logo, {
    size: 18
  })), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex-1"
  }), React.createElement(LanguageSwitcher, {
    compact: true
  }), React.createElement(CurrencySwitcher, null), !app.onboarded && React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: () => {
      app.completeOnboarding();
      app.nav('/dashboard');
    },
    className: "text-sm text-muted hover:text-charcoal"
  }, t('skip'), " \u2192")), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "h-1 bg-sand"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-gold to-goldd transition-all duration-500",
    style: {
      width: progress + '%'
    }
  })), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex-1 flex justify-center px-4 pt-8 sm:pt-14 quiz-body"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "w-full max-w-xl"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-xs tracking-[.2em] uppercase text-faint mb-3"
  }, "Step ", step + 1, " of ", total), React.createElement("div", {
    key: step,
    className: "anim-fadeUp"
  }, React.createElement("h1", {
    className: "font-serif text-3xl sm:text-4xl text-charcoal leading-tight"
  }, cur.q), React.createElement("p", {
    className: "text-muted mt-2 flex items-center gap-2"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "info",
    size: 15,
    className: "text-goldd"
  }), cur.why), cur.term && React.createElement("p", {
    className: "mt-1 text-sm"
  }, React.createElement(Term, {
    k: cur.term
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-goldd font-medium"
  }, "What does \u201C", cur.term.toLowerCase(), "\u201D mean?"))), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "mt-7"
  }, cur.opts && cur.kind !== 'multi' && React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3"
  }, cur.opts.map(o => React.createElement("button", {
    key: o,
    onClick: () => {
      set(cur.k, o);
    },
    className: cx('text-left rounded-xl2 border px-4 py-3.5 transition-all duration-300', d[cur.k] === o ? 'border-gold bg-gold/10 shadow-soft' : 'border-line bg-cream hover:border-taupe hover:bg-sand/60')
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "flex items-center justify-between"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "font-medium text-charcoal"
  }, o), d[cur.k] === o && React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "check",
    size: 18,
    className: "text-goldd"
  }))))), cur.kind === 'multi' && React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5"
  }, cur.opts.map(o => {
    const arr = Array.isArray(d[cur.k]) ? d[cur.k] : [];
    const on = arr.includes(o);
    return React.createElement("button", {
      key: o,
      onClick: () => set(cur.k, on ? arr.filter(x => x !== o) : [...arr, o]),
      className: cx('text-left rounded-xl2 border px-4 py-3.5 transition-all duration-300', on ? 'border-gold bg-gold/10 shadow-soft' : 'border-line bg-cream hover:border-taupe hover:bg-sand/60')
    }, React.createElement("span", {
      className: "flex items-center justify-between gap-2"
    }, React.createElement("span", {
      className: "font-medium text-charcoal"
    }, o), React.createElement("span", {
      className: cx('grid place-items-center h-5 w-5 rounded-md border shrink-0', on ? 'bg-goldd border-goldd text-white' : 'border-taupe')
    }, on && React.createElement(Icon, {
      name: "check",
      size: 13
    }))));
  }), cur.other && (() => {
    const arr = Array.isArray(d[cur.k]) ? d[cur.k] : [];
    const otherVal = arr.find(x => String(x).startsWith('Other: ')) || '';
    return React.createElement("input", _extends({}, NO_AUTOFILL, {
      name: 'lm-other-' + cur.k,
      "aria-label": "Other, in your own words",
      value: otherVal.replace('Other: ', ''),
      onChange: e => {
        const rest = arr.filter(x => !String(x).startsWith('Other: '));
        set(cur.k, e.target.value.trim() ? [...rest, 'Other: ' + e.target.value] : rest);
      },
      placeholder: "Other (tell us)",
      className: "sm:col-span-2 w-full rounded-xl2 border border-line bg-cream px-4 py-3 focus:border-gold focus:outline-none"
    }));
  })()), cur.kind === 'region' && React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid gap-3"
  }, Object.entries(REGIONS).map(([k, r]) => React.createElement("button", {
    key: k,
    onClick: () => setD(s => ({
      ...s,
      region: k,
      currency: ccyPicked.current ? s.currency : (REGIONS[k] || {}).currency || s.currency
    })),
    className: cx('flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl2 border px-4 py-3.5 transition', d.region === k ? 'border-gold bg-gold/10' : 'border-line bg-cream hover:bg-sand/60')
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-2xl"
  }, r.flag), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "flex-1 text-left font-medium text-charcoal"
  }, r.name), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-sm text-faint"
  }, r.currency), d.region === k && React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "check",
    className: "text-goldd"
  })))), cur.kind === 'currency' && React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto no-scrollbar"
  }, Object.values(CURRENCIES).map(c => React.createElement("button", {
    key: c.code,
    onClick: () => {
      ccyPicked.current = true;
      set('currency', c.code);
      app.updateProfile({
        currency: c.code
      });
    },
    className: cx('flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl2 border px-4 py-3 transition', d.currency === c.code ? 'border-gold bg-gold/10' : 'border-line bg-cream hover:bg-sand/60')
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-2xl"
  }, c.flag), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "flex-1 text-left"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "font-medium text-charcoal"
  }, c.code), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-xs text-faint block"
  }, c.name)), d.currency === c.code && React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "check",
    className: "text-goldd"
  })))), cur.kind === 'text' && React.createElement("input", _extends({}, NO_AUTOFILL, {
    name: 'lm-' + cur.k,
    "aria-label": cur.q,
    value: d[cur.k],
    onChange: e => set(cur.k, e.target.value),
    placeholder: cur.placeholder,
    className: "w-full rounded-xl2 border border-line bg-cream px-4 py-3.5 text-lg focus:border-gold focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-gold/10"
  })), cur.kind === 'stepper' && React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-center gap-4"
  }, React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: () => set(cur.k, clamp(d[cur.k] - 1, cur.min, cur.max)),
    className: "grid place-items-center h-14 w-14 rounded-2xl border border-line bg-cream hover:bg-sand text-2xl"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "minus"
  })), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "font-serif text-5xl text-charcoal w-16 text-center tnum"
  }, d[cur.k]), React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: () => set(cur.k, clamp(d[cur.k] + 1, cur.min, cur.max)),
    className: "grid place-items-center h-14 w-14 rounded-2xl border border-line bg-cream hover:bg-sand text-2xl"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "plus"
  }))))))), React.createElement(QuizBar, {
    onBack: step > 0 ? () => setStep(step - 1) : null,
    onSkip: cur.kind === 'text' || cur.kind === 'multi' ? () => {
      if (step < total - 1) setStep(step + 1);else finish();
    } : null,
    onNext: next,
    nextDisabled: !answered,
    nextLabel: step < total - 1 ? t('continue') : t('finish'),
    note: answered ? `Question ${step + 1} of ${total}` : 'Choose an answer to continue'
  }));
}
function NumberField({
  id,
  label,
  value,
  onChange,
  icon,
  income = false
}) {
  const app = useApp();
  const f = app.fmt;
  const conv = f.display !== f.base;
  const cur = CURRENCIES[app.profile.currency] || CURRENCIES.AED;
  const right = cur.suffix;
  const shown = value === '' || value == null || isNaN(value) || Number(value) === 0 ? '' : conv ? Math.round(f.toDisplay(value)) : value;
  const onIn = raw => onChange(id, raw === '' ? 0 : conv ? Math.round(f.toBase(Number(raw))) : Number(raw));
  return React.createElement("label", {
    className: "block"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-charcoal/85 mb-1.5"
  }, icon && React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-muted"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: icon,
    size: 15
  })), label), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "relative flex items-center"
  }, !right && React.createElement("span", {
    className: "absolute left-3 text-sm text-faint"
  }, cur.symbol), React.createElement("input", _extends({}, NO_AUTOFILL, {
    name: 'lm-' + id,
    type: "number",
    inputMode: "decimal",
    placeholder: "0",
    value: shown,
    onChange: e => onIn(e.target.value),
    className: cx('w-full rounded-xl border border-line bg-cream py-2.5 focus:border-gold focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-gold/10 tnum', right ? 'pl-3 pr-12' : 'pl-7 pr-3')
  })), right && React.createElement("span", {
    className: "absolute right-3 text-xs text-faint"
  }, cur.code)));
}
function Review() {

  });
  const [bal, setBal] = useState({
    ...app.balances
  });
  const [step, setStep] = useState(0);
  const set = (id, v) => setDraft(s => ({
    ...s,
    [id]: v
  }));
  const setB = (id, v) => setBal(s => ({
    ...s,
    [id]: v
  }));
  const groups = GROUPS.filter(g => g.id !== 'savings');
  const [extra, setExtra] = useState(() => {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(__LS.getItem('lumera_budget_custom')) || [];
    } catch (e) {
      return [];
    }
  });
  const [nx, setNx] = useState({
    name: '',
    amount: 0,
    bucket: 'Wants'
  });
  const addExtra = () => {
    if (!nx.name || !Number(nx.amount)) return;
    const n = [...extra, {
      id: 'c' + Date.now(),
      name: nx.name,
      amount: Number(nx.amount),
      bucket: nx.bucket
    }];
    setExtra(n);
    saveSynced('lumera_budget_custom', n);
    setNx({
      name: '',
      amount: 0,
      bucket: 'Wants'
    });
  };
  const delExtra = id => {
    const n = extra.filter(x => x.id !== id);

    type: 'intro'

function fvYearly(monthly, years, rate, start = 0) {
  const r = rate / 12;
  let bal = start;
  const out = [start];
  for (let y = 1; y <= years; y++) {
    for (let m = 0; m < 12; m++) bal = bal * (1 + r) + monthly;
    out.push(bal);
  }
  return out;
}

function readAdminNews() {
  try {
    return (JSON.parse(__LS.getItem('lumera_news')) || []).filter(a => a && a.title).map(a => ({
      cat: a.cat || 'Markets',
      title: a.title,
      summary: a.summary || a.body || '',
      source: a.source || 'Lumera',
      date: a.date || '',
      url: /^https?:\/\//i.test(a.url || '') ? a.url : ''
    }));
  } catch (e) {
    return [];
  }
}
function HeadlinesPanel() {
  const app = useApp();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [, bump] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const h = e => {
      if (!e || !e.key || e.key === 'lumera_news') bump(x => x + 1);
    };
    window.addEventListener('storage', h);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('storage', h);
  }, []);
  const published = readAdminNews();
  const example = !published.length && !!(app.user && app.user.demo);
  const news = published.length ? published : example ? NEWS_LIVE : [];
  if (!news.length) return null;
  return React.createElement("div", {
    className: "mb-4 rounded-xl2 border border-line bg-cream/60 overflow-hidden"
  }, React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: () => setOpen(o => !o),
    "aria-expanded": open,
    className: "w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 hover:bg-sand/50 transition"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "grid place-items-center h-8 w-8 rounded-lg bg-charcoal text-gold shrink-0"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "globe",
    size: 16
  })), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex-1 text-left min-w-0"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-sm font-semibold text-charcoal flex items-center gap-2"
  }, "Financial headlines", example && React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-[9.5px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md",
    style: {
      background: 'rgba(245,199,122,.18)',
      color: '#F5C77A'
    }
  }, "Example \xB7 ", NEWS_LIVE[0].date)), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-xs text-faint truncate"
  }, news[0].title)), React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "chevron",
    size: 16,
    className: cx('text-faint transition shrink-0', open ? 'rotate-[270deg]' : 'rotate-90')
  })), open && React.createElement("div", {
    className: "border-t border-line anim-fadeIn"
  }, news.slice(0, 5).map((n, i) => {
    const body = React.createElement(React.Fragment, null, React.createElement("div", {
      className: "flex items-center gap-2 mb-0.5"

    }, n.cat), React.createElement("span", {

    }, n.title), n.summary && React.createElement("div", {

    return n.url ? React.createElement("a", {

    }, body) : React.createElement("div", {

  })));

const levelFromXp = xp => Math.floor(Math.sqrt((xp || 0) / 40)) + 1;
const xpForLevel = lvl => 40 * Math.pow(lvl - 1, 2);
function XPBurst({
  fire
}) {
  const [bits, setBits] = useState([]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!fire) return;
    const cols = ['#8B5CF6', '#3B82F6', '#A78BFA', '#6366F1', '#22D3EE'];
    setBits(Array.from({
      length: 24
    }, (_, i) => ({
      id: i + '-' + fire,
      left: Math.random() * 100,
      bg: cols[i % cols.length],
      delay: Math.random() * .2
    })));
    const t = setTimeout(() => setBits([]), 1150);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [fire]);
  return bits.map(b => React.createElement("span", {
    key: b.id,
    className: "conf",
    style: {
      left: b.left + 'vw',
      background: b.bg,
      animationDelay: b.delay + 's'
    }
  }));
}
