const ROUTE_PRODUCT = {
  '/lumera': 'lumera',
  '/leaf': 'leaf',
  '/atlas': 'atlas',
  '/shield': 'shield',
  '/forge': 'forge'
};
SUBS.forEach(s => s.routes.forEach(r => {
  if (s.key !== 'lumera') ROUTE_PRODUCT[r] = s.key;
}));
const SHARED_ROUTES = new Set(['/assistant', '/settings', '/badges', '/chats', '/updates', '/about', '/team', '/privacy', '/pricing', '/community']);
let _lastProduct = 'lumera';
try {
  _lastProduct = __SS.getItem('lumera_world') || 'lumera';
} catch (e) {}
function productOf(path) {
  if (_movedRoutes.has(path)) {
    _lastProduct = 'lumera';
    return 'lumera';
  }
  const own = ROUTE_PRODUCT[path];
  if (own) {
    _lastProduct = own;
    try {
      __SS.setItem('lumera_world', own);
    } catch (e) {}
    return own;
  }
  if (SHARED_ROUTES.has(path)) return _lastProduct;
  _lastProduct = 'lumera';
  try {
    __SS.setItem('lumera_world', 'lumera');
  } catch (e) {}
  return 'lumera';
}

function gatedWorld(layout, path) {
  if (_movedRoutes.has(path)) return null;
  const w = WORLD_HOME[path] || WORLD_EXTRA_ROUTES[path] || (ROUTE_PRODUCT[path] !== 'lumera' ? ROUTE_PRODUCT[path] : null);
  if (path === '/hub') return 'all';
  return w && !worldLaunched(layout, w) ? w : null;
}

function Mascot({
  kind = 'lumera',
  color = '#8B5CF6',
  size = 58,
  float = true
}) {
  const assets = useAssets();
  const art = assets['mascot_' + kind] || assets.mascot_lumera;
  return React.createElement("span", {
    className: cx('inline-flex items-end justify-center', float && 'mascot'),
    style: {
      width: size,
      height: Math.round(size * 1.375),
      lineHeight: 0,
      '--mg': hexToRgbList(color)
    }
  }, React.createElement("img", {
    src: art,
    alt: "",
    "aria-hidden": "true",
    draggable: "false",
    className: "mascot-glow",
    style: {
      maxWidth: '100%',
      maxHeight: '100%',
      width: 'auto',
      height: 'auto',
      display: 'block'
    }
  }));
}
function MascotAvatar({
  kind = 'lumera',
  color = '#8B5CF6',
  size = 32
}) {
  const assets = useAssets();
  const art = assets['mascot_' + kind] || assets.mascot_lumera;
  return React.createElement("span", {
    className: "inline-grid shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-full place-items-start justify-center",
    style: {
      width: size,
      height: size,
      background: `radial-gradient(circle at 50% 75%, ${color}55, ${color}18 70%)`,
      boxShadow: `inset 0 0 0 1px ${color}44`
    }
  }, React.createElement("img", {
    src: art,
    alt: "",
    "aria-hidden": "true",
    draggable: "false",
    style: kind === 'forge' ? {
      width: size * 1.25,
      maxWidth: 'none',
      height: 'auto',
      marginTop: -size * 0.68,
      display: 'block'
    } : {
      width: size * 0.92,
      height: 'auto',
      marginTop: size * 0.08,
      display: 'block'
    }
  }));
}
function hexToRgbList(hex) {
  const h = String(hex || '').replace('#', '');
  if (h.length !== 6) return '139,92,246';
  return [0, 2, 4].map(i => parseInt(h.slice(i, i + 2), 16)).join(',');
}
const GUIDE_CHAT_KEY = 'lumera_guide_chat';
const guideGreeting = g => `${g.lines[0]} Ask me anything, I\u2019m ${g.name}. \uD83D\uDCAC`;
const GREETING_RE = /Ask me anything, I\u2019m /;
function stripGreetings(list) {
  return (Array.isArray(list) ? list : []).filter(m => !(m && m.role === 'bot' && (m.intro || GREETING_RE.test(m.text || ''))));
}
const POPUP_ORDER = ['guide', 'wotd', 'whatsnew'];
const popupQueue = {
  want: {},
  active: null,
  subs: new Set(),
  sub(fn) {
    this.subs.add(fn);
    return () => this.subs.delete(fn);
  },
  settle() {
    const next = POPUP_ORDER.find(k => this.want[k]) || null;
    if (next === this.active) return;
    this.active = next;
    this.subs.forEach(f => f());
  },
  request(id) {
    if (this.want[id]) return;
    this.want[id] = 1;
    this.settle();
  },
  release(id) {
    if (!this.want[id]) return;
    delete this.want[id];
    this.settle();
  }
};
function usePopupSlot(id, wanted) {
  const [, bump] = useReducer(x => x + 1, 0);
  useEffect(() => popupQueue.sub(bump), []);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (wanted) popupQueue.request(id);else popupQueue.release(id);
    return () => popupQueue.release(id);
  }, [id, wanted]);
  return popupQueue.active === id;
}

  const sk = 'lumera_guide_' + p;
  const [showTut, setShowTut] = useState(false);
  const [ti, setTi] = useState(0);
  const [intro, setIntro] = useState(false);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  const [txt, setTxt] = useState('');
  const scroller = useRef(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    setTi(0);
    let seen = false,
      anyTut = false;
    try {
      seen = __LS.getItem(sk);
      anyTut = __LS.getItem('lumera_guide_tut_done');
    } catch (e) {}
    setShowTut(!seen && !anyTut);
    setIntro(!seen && !!anyTut);
    setOpen(false);
    let prior = [];
    try {
      prior = JSON.parse(__LS.getItem(GUIDE_CHAT_KEY)) || [];
    } catch (e) {}
    setMsgs(stripGreetings(prior));
  }, [p]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!msgs.length) return;
    try {
      __LS.setItem(GUIDE_CHAT_KEY, JSON.stringify(stripGreetings(msgs).slice(-60)));
    } catch (e) {}
  }, [msgs]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (scroller.current) scroller.current.scrollTop = scroller.current.scrollHeight;
  }, [msgs, typing, open]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const h = () => setOpen(o => !o);
    window.addEventListener('lumera:guide', h);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('lumera:guide', h);
  }, []);
  const tutTurn = usePopupSlot('guide', showTut);
  if (app.mode !== 'spark') return null;
  const finishTut = () => {
    setShowTut(false);
    setIntro(false);
    try {
      __LS.setItem(sk, '1');
      __LS.setItem('lumera_guide_tut_done', '1');
    } catch (e) {}
  };
  const tutNext = () => {
    if (ti < g.lines.length - 1) setTi(ti + 1);else finishTut();
  };
  const close = () => {
    setOpen(false);

    } catch (e) {}
  };

        r = botReply(t, app.metrics, app.fmt, app);
      } catch (e) {
        r = null;
      }

function WorldComingSoon({
  k
}) {
  const app = useApp();
  const worlds = k === 'all' ? SUBS.filter(s => s.key !== 'lumera') : SUBS.filter(s => s.key === k);
  const one = worlds.length === 1 ? worlds[0] : null;
  return React.createElement(AppShell, null, one ? React.createElement("section", {
    className: "relative overflow-hidden rounded-[28px] p-6 sm:p-9 mb-5 text-white",
    style: {
      background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${one.accent}, ${one.accent}AA 55%, rgba(20,16,40,.9))`,
      boxShadow: `0 30px 60px -30px ${one.accent}`

  }), React.createElement("div", {

      }

function Benchmarks() {
  const app = useApp();
  const fmt = app.fmt;
  const m = app.metrics;
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('All');

function Recommendations() {
  const app = useApp();
  const fmt = app.fmt;
  const m = app.metrics;
  const insights = useMemo(() => deriveInsights(m, fmt), [m, fmt]);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(null);
  const reclaim = sum(insights.map(i => i.impact || 0));
  return React.createElement(AppShell, null, React.createElement(PageHead, {
    eyebrow: "AI recommendations",
    title: "What to do next, and why.",
    desc: "Short, ranked actions from your own numbers. Tap How for the steps."

    className: "lg-pill tint"

      onClick: () => app.nav(ins.tool),

    })), (ins.explanation || ins.steps) && React.createElement("button", {
      onClick: () => setOpen(isOpen ? null : i),
      "aria-expanded": isOpen,
      className: "ml-auto text-xs font-semibold text-goldd flex items-center gap-1"
    }, isOpen ? 'Hide' : 'How', React.createElement(Icon, {
      name: "chevron",

      className: isOpen ? '-rotate-90' : 'rotate-90'
    }))), isOpen && React.createElement("div", {

    }, ins.steps ? React.createElement("ol", {
      className: "space-y-1.5"
    }, ins.steps.slice(0, 3).map((st, k) => React.createElement("li", {
      key: k,

  }, React.createElement(Disclaimer, {

  })));

function HabitsStrip() {
  const KEY = 'lumera_leaf_habits';
  const habits = [['track', '📒', 'Log spending'], ['noimpulse', '🛑', 'No impulse buys'], ['save', '🪙', 'Move to savings'], ['learn', '📚', 'Learn one idea'], ['cook', '🍳', 'Eat in'], ['check', '👀', 'Check a subscription']];
  const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const [state, setState] = useState(() => {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(__LS.getItem(KEY)) || {};
    } catch (e) {
      return {};
    }
  });
  const day = state[today] || {};
  const toggle = id => setState(s => {
    const d = {
      ...(s[today] || {})
    };
    d[id] = !d[id];
    const ns = {
      ...s,
      [today]: d
    };
    try {
      __LS.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(ns));
    } catch (e) {}
    return ns;
  });
  const doneN = habits.filter(h => day[h[0]]).length;
  let streak = 0;
  for (let k = 0; k < 60; k++) {
    const d = new Date(Date.now() - k * 864e5).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const v = state[d];
    if (v && Object.values(v).some(Boolean)) streak++;else if (k > 0) break;
  }
  return React.createElement(Card, {
    hover: false,
    className: "mb-4"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-center justify-between mb-3 flex-wrap gap-2"
  }, React.createElement(Eyebrow, null, "Today\u2019s money habits"), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-sm text-muted"
  }, doneN, "/", habits.length, " done \xB7 ", React.createElement("b", {
    className: "text-goldd"
  }, streak, " day streak \uD83D\uDD25"))), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-2"
  }, habits.map(([id, e, label]) => {
    const on = !!day[id];
    return React.createElement("button", {
      key: id,
      onClick: () => toggle(id),
      className: cx('rounded-xl2 border p-3 text-center transition', on ? 'border-sage/50 bg-sage/10' : 'border-line hover:border-taupe')
    }, React.createElement("div", {
      className: "text-2xl"
    }, e), React.createElement("div", {
      className: cx('text-[11px] mt-1 leading-tight', on ? 'text-saged font-medium' : 'text-muted')
    }, label));
  })));
}

function twinFindings(m, fmt) {
  const inc = Math.max(m.income, 1);
  const strengths = [],
    watch = [];
  const pct = x => Math.round(x * 100);
  const sr = m.savingsRate;
  if (sr >= 0.15) strengths.push({
    t: 'You save a real share of what you earn',
    val: pct(sr) + '%',
    good: '15%+',
    bar: [pct(sr), 15, 35],
    why: `Saving ${pct(sr)}% puts you ahead of most people your age, and it is the single strongest predictor of where you end up.`,
    act: 'Protect it as your income grows. Send the whole of your next raise to savings before you feel it.',
    impact: `At ${pct(sr)}% you are setting aside about ${fmt.money(m.savingsTotal)} a month.`
  });else watch.push({
    t: 'Your savings rate is below where it needs to be',
    val: pct(sr) + '%',
    good: '15%+',
    sev: sr < 0.05 ? 'high' : 'medium',
    bar: [pct(sr), 15, 35],
    why: `At ${pct(sr)}% the gap between what you earn and what you keep is doing most of the damage. Everything else on this page matters less than this number.`,
    act: `Automate a transfer on payday rather than saving what is left at month end. Start at ${fmt.money(Math.max(m.conservative, 200))}.`,
    impact: `Reaching 15% would mean about ${fmt.money(inc * 0.15 - m.savingsTotal)} more set aside every month.`
  });
  if (m.efMonths >= 3) strengths.push({
    t: 'You have a real safety buffer',
    val: m.efMonths.toFixed(1) + ' months',
    good: '3–6 months',
    bar: [Math.min(100, m.efMonths / 6 * 100), 50, 100],
    why: 'A buffer is what stops a bad month becoming debt. Yours already covers a genuine shock.',
    act: m.efMonths >= 6 ? 'You are covered. Anything beyond six months is better invested than held as cash.' : 'Push toward six months, then stop and invest the rest.',
    impact: `Covers roughly ${m.efMonths.toFixed(1)} months of essentials at ${fmt.money(m.essentialsTotal || 0)} a month.`
  });else watch.push({
    t: 'Your emergency fund is thin',
    val: m.efMonths.toFixed(1) + ' months',
    good: '3–6 months',
    sev: m.efMonths < 1 ? 'high' : 'medium',
    bar: [Math.min(100, m.efMonths / 6 * 100), 50, 100],
    why: 'Without a buffer, an unexpected bill becomes credit-card debt, and that is how most people start going backwards.',
    act: `Open a separate high-yield account and automate ${fmt.money(Math.max(m.conservative, 200))} a month into it. Do not link a card to it.`,
    impact: `You need roughly ${fmt.money(Math.max(0, (m.essentialsTotal || 0) * 3 - (m.balances && m.balances.emergencyFund || 0)))} more to reach three months.`
  });
  const dr = (m.debtTotal || 0) / inc;
  if (dr < 0.10) strengths.push({
    t: 'Debt is not eating your income',
    val: pct(dr) + '% of income',
    good: 'under 10%',
    bar: [Math.min(100, dr * 400), 40, 100],
    why: 'Low debt service means your money is working for you rather than for a lender.',
    act: 'Keep it there. Treat any new borrowing as a decision, not a default.',
    impact: `Debt costs you about ${fmt.money(m.debtTotal || 0)} a month.`
  });else watch.push({
    t: 'Debt is taking too much of your income',
    val: pct(dr) + '% of income',
    good: 'under 10%',
    sev: dr > 0.2 ? 'high' : 'medium',
    bar: [Math.min(100, dr * 400), 40, 100],
    why: 'Every penny of interest is a guaranteed loss. Clearing high-interest debt beats almost any investment return available to you.',
    act: 'Attack the highest interest rate first, not the smallest balance. The maths favours the avalanche method.',
    impact: `You are paying about ${fmt.money(m.debtTotal || 0)} a month before you save anything.`
  });
  const inv = m.expenses && m.expenses.investments || 0;
  if (inv > 0) strengths.push({
    t: 'You already invest, not just save',
    val: fmt.money(inv) + '/mo',
    good: 'anything consistent',
    bar: [Math.min(100, inv / inc * 500), 40, 100],
    why: 'Cash loses to inflation slowly and quietly. Investing consistently is what turns saving into wealth.',
    act: 'Consistency beats size. Keep the standing order running through bad months, that is when it matters.',
    impact: `Around ${fmt.money(inv * 12)} a year going into long-term growth.`
  });else if (m.efMonths >= 3) watch.push({
    t: 'Your buffer is set but nothing is invested',
    val: '0/mo',
    good: 'start small',
    sev: 'medium',
    bar: [0, 40, 100],
    why: 'You have done the hard part. Cash beyond six months of essentials is losing value to inflation every year it sits still.',
    act: 'Start with a small automatic amount into a broad index fund. The habit matters more than the sum.',
    impact: 'Even a modest monthly amount compounds over the decades you have ahead of you.'
  });
  const lr = (m.lifestyleTotal || 0) / inc;
  if (lr <= 0.18) strengths.push({
    t: 'Lifestyle spending is under control',
    val: pct(lr) + '% of income',
    good: 'under 18%',
    bar: [Math.min(100, lr * 400), 72, 100],
    why: 'Discretionary spend is where most income quietly disappears. Yours is not the problem.',
    act: 'Keep an eye on it as you earn more. Lifestyle creep is gradual and rarely noticed until it is fixed.',
    impact: `About ${fmt.money(m.lifestyleTotal || 0)} a month on discretionary categories.`
  });else watch.push({
    t: 'Lifestyle spending is above benchmark',
    val: pct(lr) + '% of income',
    good: 'under 18%',
    sev: lr > 0.28 ? 'high' : 'medium',
    bar: [Math.min(100, lr * 400), 72, 100],
    why: 'Not about denying yourself, but this is the category with the most give in it, and it is capping how fast everything else grows.',
    act: 'Pick the two lines you would miss least and cut those only. Blanket austerity fails within a month.',
    impact: `Bringing it to 18% would free about ${fmt.money(Math.max(0, (m.lifestyleTotal || 0) - inc * 0.18))} a month.`
  });
  (m.topLeaks || []).slice(0, 3).forEach(r => {
    watch.push({
      t: `${r.label} is over its benchmark`,
      val: fmt.money(r.amount),
      good: `${fmt.money(r.lo)}–${fmt.money(r.hi)}`,
      sev: 'low',
      bar: [Math.min(100, r.amount / (r.hi || 1) * 60), 60, 100],
      why: `For your income and region, this category usually lands between ${fmt.money(r.lo)} and ${fmt.money(r.hi)}. You are ${fmt.money(r.over)} above the top of that range.`,
      act: `Set a hard monthly cap at ${fmt.money(r.hi)} and check it weekly rather than at month end.`,
      impact: `Reclaiming this alone is about ${fmt.money(r.over * 12)} a year.`
    });
  });
  return {
    strengths,
    watch
  };
}
function TwinCharts({
  m,
  fmt,
  target,
  start = 0
}) {
  const segs = [{
    label: 'Essentials',
    value: m.essentialsTotal,
    color: '#7CB4FF'
  }, {
    label: 'Lifestyle',
    value: Math.max(0, m.lifestyleTotal),
    color: '#F08BC4'
  }, {
    label: 'Obligations',
    value: m.obligationsTotal,
    color: '#FFC98A'
  }, {
    label: 'Saving',
    value: m.savingsTotal,
    color: '#5EE6D0'
  }, {
    label: 'Left over',
    value: Math.max(0, m.leftover),
    color: '#B9A6FF'
  }].filter(x => x.value > 0);
  const tot = sum(segs.map(x => x.value)) || 1;
  const pillars = [['Savings rate', m.scores.savingsRate], ['Emergency fund', m.scores.emergencyFund], ['Debt pressure', m.scores.debtPressure], ['Spending', m.scores.spendingEfficiency], ['Invest readiness', m.scores.investmentReadiness], ['Income stability', m.scores.incomeStability]];
  const now = fvYearly(m.savingsTotal, 10, 0.05, start),
    better = fvYearly(m.savingsTotal + target, 10, 0.05, start);
  const max = Math.max(1, ...better),
    W = 320,
    H = 140;
  const pts = arr => arr.map((v, i) => `${(i / 10 * W).toFixed(1)},${(H - 6 - v / max * (H - 16)).toFixed(1)}`).join(' ');
  return React.createElement("div", {

  }, segs.map(x => React.createElement("li", {
    key: x.label,
    className: "flex items-center gap-2"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full shrink-0",
    style: {
      background: x.color
    }
  }), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "flex-1 truncate text-charcoal/85"
  }, x.label), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "tnum text-muted"
  }, round(x.value / tot * 100), "%")))))), React.createElement(Card, {
    hover: false
  }, React.createElement(Eyebrow, {
    className: "mb-3"
  }, "What your score is made of"), React.createElement("ul", {

    key: l

    style: {

      background: v >= 70 ? 'linear-gradient(90deg,#5EE6D0,#7CB4FF)' : v >= 45 ? 'linear-gradient(90deg,#FFC98A,#F08BC4)' : 'linear-gradient(90deg,#F87171,#F08BC4)'

function FinancialTwin() {
  const app = useApp();
  const fmt = app.fmt;
  const m = app.metrics;
  const a = m.archetype;
  const tone = COLORS[a.color] || a.color || '#9D7CFF';
  const target = m.realistic > 0 ? m.realistic : m.conservative;
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('twin');
  const f = useMemo(() => twinFindings(m, fmt), [m, fmt]);
  const TABS = [['twin', 'Your twin'], ['read', 'The full read'], ['futures', 'Three futures']];
  const Finding = ({
    d,
    tint
  }) => {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const sev = d.sev === 'high' ? '#F87171' : d.sev === 'medium' ? '#FBBF24' : tint;
    return React.createElement("div", {
      className: "rounded-2xl overflow-hidden transition-all",
      style: {
        background: 'rgba(255,255,255,.055)',
        boxShadow: `inset 0 0 0 1px ${open ? sev + '66' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.09)'}`
      }
    }, React.createElement("button", {
      onClick: () => setOpen(o => !o),
      "aria-expanded": open,
      className: "w-full text-left p-4 hover:bg-white/[.04] transition"
    }, React.createElement("div", {
      className: "flex items-start justify-between gap-3"
    }, React.createElement("div", {
      className: "min-w-0 flex-1"
    }, React.createElement("div", {
      className: "text-sm font-semibold text-charcoal leading-snug"
    }, d.t), React.createElement("div", {
      className: "text-[11.5px] text-muted mt-0.5"
    }, "Benchmark ", d.good)), React.createElement("div", {
      className: "text-right shrink-0"
    }, React.createElement("div", {
      className: "font-display text-[1.5rem] leading-none tnum",

        color: sev
      }
    }, d.val), d.sev && React.createElement("div", {

      className: "absolute h-4 w-1 rounded -top-1",

      }
    }))), open && React.createElement("div", {
      className: "px-4 pb-4 anim-fadeUp space-y-3"
    }, React.createElement("p", {
      className: "text-[13px] text-charcoal/90 leading-relaxed border-t border-white/10 pt-3"

      name: "chart",

      className: "mt-0.5 shrink-0",

      }

  };
  return React.createElement(AppShell, null, React.createElement(PageHead, {
    eyebrow: "AI Financial Twin",
    title: "Meet the version of you your money describes.",
    desc: "A profile built from your own figures: your strengths, your blind spots, and your single best next move."
  }), React.createElement("section", {
    "aria-labelledby": "twin-name",

function TwinFutures({
  app,
  fmt,
  m
}) {
  const [yrs, setYrs] = useState(10);
  const rate = 0.06;
  const start = app.balances.investmentsBal || 0;
  const base = Math.max(0, m.savingsTotal);
  const drift = Math.max(0, base - m.realistic * 0.6);
  const optimise = base + Math.max(m.realistic, 300);
  const fv = monthly => fvYearly(monthly, yrs, rate, start)[yrs];
  const futures = [{
    key: 'Drift',
    tone: '#C0714F',
    emoji: '😴',
    monthly: drift,
    sub: 'If discipline slips and lifestyle creeps up',
    val: fv(drift)
  }, {
    key: 'Current path',
    tone: '#BFA06A',
    emoji: '🚶',
    monthly: base,
    sub: 'Your habits exactly as they are today',
    val: fv(base)
  }, {
    key: 'Optimised',
    tone: '#6E8B6A',
    emoji: '🚀',
    monthly: optimise,
    sub: 'If you capture your reclaimable savings',
    val: fv(optimise)
  }];
  const maxV = Math.max(...futures.map(f => f.val), 1);
  const traits = [['Saver', Math.round(clamp(m.savingsRate / 0.3, 0, 1) * 100), '#6E8B6A'], ['Spender', Math.round(clamp((m.topLeaks.length ? sum(m.topLeaks.map(l => l.over)) / m.income : 0) / 0.3, 0, 1) * 100), '#C0714F'], ['Planner', Math.round(clamp(m.efMonths / 6, 0, 1) * 100), '#6E86A0'], ['Investor', Math.round(clamp(start / (m.income * 12 || 1), 0, 1) * 100), '#BFA06A']];
  return React.createElement("div", {
    className: "mb-4"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "mb-3"
  }, React.createElement(Eyebrow, null, "Meet your future self"), React.createElement("h3", {
    className: "font-serif text-2xl text-charcoal mt-1"
  }, "Three futures, one decision away."), React.createElement("p", {
    className: "text-sm text-muted"
  }, "Drag the years to see how today\u2019s habits compound. Same you, very different outcomes.")), React.createElement(Card, {
    hover: false,
    className: "mb-4"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-center justify-between mb-2"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-sm text-charcoal/85"
  }, "Project forward"), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "font-serif text-xl",
    style: {
      color: '#9E7E45'
    }
  }, yrs, " years")), React.createElement("input", {
    type: "range",
    min: "1",
    max: "30",
    value: yrs,
    onChange: e => setYrs(+e.target.value),
    className: "lux w-full",
    style: {
      '--p': (yrs - 1) / 29 * 100 + '%'
    }
  }), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3 mt-4"
  }, futures.map(f => React.createElement("div", {
    key: f.key,
    className: "rounded-2xl p-4",
    style: {
      background: 'rgba(255,255,255,.055)',
      boxShadow: `inset 0 3px 0 ${f.tone}, inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.08)`
    }
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-center justify-between"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-2xl"
  }, f.emoji), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-[11px] font-semibold rounded-full px-2 py-0.5",
    style: {
      background: f.tone + '1A',
      color: f.tone
    }
  }, fmt.money(f.monthly), "/mo")), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "font-serif text-lg text-charcoal mt-2"
  }, f.key), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-xs text-muted leading-snug mt-0.5"
  }, f.sub), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "font-display text-[2rem] leading-none tnum mt-2",
    style: {
      color: f.tone
    }
  }, fmt.money(Math.round(f.val))), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "h-1.5 rounded-full bg-sand mt-2 overflow-hidden"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all duration-500",
    style: {
      width: f.val / maxV * 100 + '%',
      background: f.tone
    }
  }))))), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "mt-3 rounded-xl bg-sage/8 border border-sage/20 px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-charcoal/85"
  }, React.createElement("b", null, "The gap:"), " choosing the optimised path over drifting is worth about ", React.createElement("b", {
    className: "text-saged"
  }, fmt.money(Math.round(fv(optimise) - fv(drift)))), " over ", yrs, " years, from decisions you make once and automate.")), React.createElement(Card, {
    hover: false
  }, React.createElement(Eyebrow, {
    className: "mb-3"
  }, "Your behaviour profile"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-x-6 gap-y-3"
  }, traits.map(([name, val, color]) => React.createElement("div", {
    key: name
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-center justify-between text-sm mb-1"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-charcoal/85"
  }, name), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "tnum text-muted"
  }, val)), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "h-2 rounded-full bg-sand overflow-hidden"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-700",
    style: {
      width: val + '%',
      background: color
    }
  }))))), React.createElement("p", {
    className: "text-xs text-faint mt-3"
  }, "Traits are inferred from your entered behaviour, they shift as your habits do.")));
}
function WealthSimulator() {
  const app = useApp();
  const fmt = app.fmt;
  const m = app.metrics;
  const [s, setS] = useState({
    eatingOut: 0,
    subscriptions: 0,
    shopping: 0,
    addSave: 0,
    addInvest: 0,
    addIncome: 0
  });
  const [scen, setScen] = useState('balanced');
  const rate = {
    conservative: 0.03,
    balanced: 0.06,
    growth: 0.085
  }[scen];
  const set = (k, v) => setS(x => ({
    ...x,
    [k]: v
  }));
  const cut = k => Math.min(s[k], app.expenses[k] || Infinity);
  const monthlyFreed = cut('eatingOut') + cut('subscriptions') + cut('shopping') + s.addSave + s.addInvest + s.addIncome;
  const newMonthly = m.savingsTotal + monthlyFreed;
  const base = fvYearly(m.savingsTotal, 10, rate, app.balances.investmentsBal);
  const proj = fvYearly(newMonthly, 10, rate, app.balances.investmentsBal);
  const sliders = [{
    k: 'eatingOut',
    label: 'Reduce eating out (per month)',
    max: Math.max(app.expenses.eatingOut, 400),
    icon: 'fork'
  }, {
    k: 'subscriptions',
    label: 'Reduce subscriptions (per month)',
    max: Math.max(app.expenses.subscriptions, 200),
    icon: 'tv'
  }, {
    k: 'shopping',
    label: 'Reduce shopping (per month)',
    max: Math.max(app.expenses.shopping, 500),
    icon: 'bag'
  }, {
    k: 'addSave',
    label: 'Increase monthly savings',
    max: 3000,
    icon: 'pig'
  }, {
    k: 'addInvest',
    label: 'Increase monthly investing',
    max: 3000,
    icon: 'chart'
  }, {
    k: 'addIncome',
    label: 'Increase monthly income',
    max: 5000,
    icon: 'wallet'
  }];
  const W = 560,
    H = 240,
    padL = 58,
    padR = 14,
    padT = 14,
    padB = 34;
  const n = 11;
  const niceMax = v => {
    if (v <= 0) return 1;
    const p = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(v)));
    const r = v / p;
    const steps = [1, 1.1, 1.2, 1.25, 1.4, 1.5, 1.6, 1.75, 2, 2.25, 2.5, 3, 3.5, 4, 4.5, 5, 6, 7, 7.5, 8, 9, 10];
    return (steps.find(x => r <= x) || 10) * p;
  };
  const maxY = niceMax(Math.max(base[10], proj[10], 1) * 1.04);
  const yMin = Math.max(0, Math.min(base[0], base[10]) * 0.5);
  const Y = v => H - padB - (v - yMin) / (maxY - yMin || 1) * (H - padB - padT);
  const X = i => padL + i / (n - 1) * (W - padL - padR);
  const ln = arr => arr.map((v, i) => `${i ? 'L' : 'M'}${X(i)},${Y(v)}`).join(' ');
  const ar = arr => `${ln(arr)} L${X(n - 1)},${H - padB} L${X(0)},${H - padB} Z`;
  const yticks = [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1].map(f => yMin + (maxY - yMin) * f);
  return React.createElement(AppShell, null, React.createElement(PageHead, {
    eyebrow: "Wealth simulator",
    title: "Drag a habit. Watch your future move.",
    desc: `Each change is invested at the ${scen} assumption and projected over 10 years, compounded monthly. Illustrative, not a guarantee.`,
    action: React.createElement("div", {
      className: "flex gap-1 rounded-full bg-sand p-1"
    }, ['conservative', 'balanced', 'growth'].map(x => React.createElement("button", {
      key: x,
      onClick: () => setScen(x),
      className: cx('rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium capitalize transition', scen === x ? 'bg-card shadow-soft text-charcoal' : 'text-muted')
    }, x)))
  }), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid lg:grid-cols-5 gap-4"
  }, React.createElement(Card, {
    className: "lg:col-span-2"
  }, React.createElement(Eyebrow, {
    className: "mb-4"
  }, "Adjust your habits"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "space-y-5"
  }, sliders.map(sl => React.createElement(LuxSlider, {
    key: sl.k,
    label: sl.label,
    value: s[sl.k],
    min: 0,
    max: sl.max,
    step: 10,
    onChange: v => set(sl.k, v),
    fmt: v => fmt.money(v)
  }))), React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: () => setS({
      eatingOut: 0,
      subscriptions: 0,
      shopping: 0,
      addSave: 0,
      addInvest: 0,
      addIncome: 0
    }),
    className: "mt-5 text-sm text-muted hover:text-charcoal flex items-center gap-1.5"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "refresh",
    size: 14
  }), "Reset all")), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "lg:col-span-3 space-y-4"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3"
  }, [['Freed / month', monthlyFreed], ['Added / year', monthlyFreed * 12], ['Extra in 5 yrs', proj[5] - base[5]], ['Extra in 10 yrs', proj[10] - base[10]]].map(([l, v]) => React.createElement(Card, {
    key: l,
    hover: false,
    className: "!p-4"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-xs text-muted"
  }, l), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "font-serif text-xl text-saged mt-0.5"
  }, React.createElement(AnimatedNumber, {
    value: v,
    money: true
  }))))), React.createElement(Card, null, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-center justify-between mb-2"
  }, React.createElement(Eyebrow, null, "Projected wealth (10 years)"), React.createElement(Pill, {
    tone: "neutral"
  }, scen, " \xB7 ", round(rate * 100), "%/yr assumed")), React.createElement("svg", {
    viewBox: `0 0 ${W} ${H}`,
    className: "w-full h-auto"
  }, React.createElement("defs", null, React.createElement("linearGradient", {
    id: "simG",
    x1: "0",
    y1: "0",
    x2: "0",
    y2: "1"
  }, React.createElement("stop", {
    offset: "0",
    stopColor: COLORS.gold,
    stopOpacity: ".22"
  }), React.createElement("stop", {

  }, React.createElement(Disclaimer, null)));
}
function Investment() {
  const app = useApp();
  const fmt = app.fmt;
  const m = app.metrics;
  const [q, setQ] = useState({
    risk: app.profile.risk,
    timeline: '5+ years',
    goal: 'Build wealth',
    monthly: 1000,
    knowledge: app.profile.knowledge,
    drop: 'Hold steady',
    style: 'Hands-off'
  });
  const [info, setInfo] = useState(null);
  const set = (k, v) => setQ(x => ({
    ...x,
    [k]: v
  }));
  const riskScore = (q.risk === 'Aggressive' ? 3 : q.risk === 'Growth-seeking' ? 2 : q.risk === 'Balanced' ? 1 : 0) + (q.drop === 'Buy more' ? 2 : q.drop === 'Hold steady' ? 1 : 0) + (q.timeline === '10+ years' ? 2 : q.timeline === '5+ years' ? 1 : 0);
  const readyToInvest = m.efMonths >= 3 && m.debtTotal / m.income < 0.12;
  const RISK_MODELS = {
    'Very cautious': {
      key: 'Conservative',
      mix: [['Cash & HYSA', 25, COLORS.gold], ['Bonds', 45, COLORS.sky], ['Index funds', 25, COLORS.sage], ['Growth', 5, COLORS.clay]],
      ret: [3, 5],
      vol: 'Low',
      hz: '1–3 yrs',
      score: 3,
      etfs: ['BND', 'VOO', 'VXUS'],
      desc: 'Capital preservation comes first. Most of your money sits in cash and bonds, with a small slice in index funds for gentle growth.',
      warn: 'Main risk: inflation slowly outpacing low returns.'
    },
    'Balanced': {
      key: 'Balanced',
      mix: [['Cash & HYSA', 10, COLORS.gold], ['Bonds', 30, COLORS.sky], ['Index funds', 45, COLORS.sage], ['Growth', 15, COLORS.clay]],
      ret: [5, 7],
      vol: 'Moderate',
      hz: '3–7 yrs',
      score: 5,
      etfs: ['VOO', 'VXUS', 'BND'],
      desc: 'A steady blend of growth and stability. Low-cost index funds do the heavy lifting while bonds smooth the ride.',
      warn: 'Expect occasional double-digit dips, staying invested is the strategy.'
    },
    'Growth-seeking': {
      key: 'Growth',
      mix: [['Cash & HYSA', 5, COLORS.gold], ['Bonds', 15, COLORS.sky], ['Index funds', 55, COLORS.sage], ['Growth', 25, COLORS.clay]],
      ret: [6, 9],
      vol: 'High',
      hz: '7–10 yrs',
      score: 7,
      etfs: ['VOO', 'QQQ', 'VXUS'],
      desc: 'Tilted toward long-term growth, mostly equities with a modest bond cushion for rough patches.',
      warn: 'Larger swings are normal; use only money you won’t need for years.'
    },
    'Aggressive': {
      key: 'Aggressive',
      mix: [['Cash & HYSA', 2, COLORS.gold], ['Bonds', 8, COLORS.sky], ['Index funds', 50, COLORS.sage], ['Growth', 40, COLORS.clay]],
      ret: [7, 11],
      vol: 'Very high',
      hz: '10+ yrs',
      score: 9,
      etfs: ['QQQ', 'VTI', 'SCHD'],
      desc: 'Maximised long-horizon growth. Almost entirely equities and growth, high potential paired with high volatility.',
      warn: 'Can fall sharply in downturns. Never hold your emergency fund here.'

  };
  const ETF_INFO = {
    VOO: 'Vanguard S&P 500, 500 large US companies, ultra-low fee',
    VTI: 'Vanguard Total US Market, the whole US stock market',
    IVV: 'iShares S&P 500, same index as VOO',
    SCHD: 'Schwab US Dividend, quality US dividend payers',
    QQQ: 'Invesco Nasdaq-100, 100 big tech-heavy names',
    VXUS: 'Vanguard Total International, stocks outside the US',
    BND: 'Vanguard Total Bond, broad US bonds for stability'
  };
  const PATH_EX = {
    'Growth Stocks': ['NVDA', 'AAPL', 'MSFT'],
    'Dividend Stocks': ['JNJ', 'JPM', 'SCHD'],
    'Index Funds': ['VOO', 'VTI', 'IVV'],
    'ETFs': ['VOO', 'QQQ', 'VXUS'],
    'Diversified Portfolio': ['VOO', 'BND', 'VXUS']
  };
  const model = RISK_MODELS[q.risk] || RISK_MODELS['Balanced'];
  const projYears = q.timeline === '10+ years' ? 10 : q.timeline === '5+ years' ? 7 : q.timeline === '3–5 years' ? 4 : 2;
  const projVal = fvYearly(q.monthly, projYears, (model.ret[0] + model.ret[1]) / 200, 0)[projYears];
  const RET = {
    'Emergency Fund First': '~0–1%',
    'Cash Savings / HYSA': '~3–5%',
    'Government Bonds': '~3–5% (hist. ~4%)',
    'Index Funds': '~6–10% (hist. avg ~7%)',
    'ETFs': '~5–10%',
    'Dividend Stocks': '~4–8%',
    'Growth Stocks': '~8–15% (volatile)',
    'Diversified Portfolio': '~5–8%',
    'Dollar-Cost Averaging': 'tracks what you buy'
  };
  const rankLabels = ['#1 Best fit', '#2 Good fit', '#3 Alternative'];
  const riskN = q.risk === 'Aggressive' ? 3 : q.risk === 'Growth-seeking' ? 2 : q.risk === 'Balanced' ? 1 : 0;
  const horizonN = q.timeline === '10+ years' ? 3 : q.timeline === '5+ years' ? 2 : q.timeline === '3–5 years' ? 1 : 0;
  const RISKFIT = {
    'Emergency Fund First': 0,

  };
  const pscore = p => {
    let s = 0;
    s -= Math.abs((RISKFIT[p.name] != null ? RISKFIT[p.name] : 1.5) - riskN) * 3;
    if (/Growth Stocks/.test(p.name)) s += horizonN * 2 - 2;
    if (/Bonds|Cash|Emergency/.test(p.name)) s += (3 - horizonN) * 1.5;
    if (/Index|ETF|Diversified|Dollar/.test(p.name)) s += horizonN;
    if (!readyToInvest) {
      if (/Emergency Fund First/.test(p.name)) s += 14;
      if (/Cash Savings/.test(p.name)) s += 3;
    } else if (/Emergency Fund First/.test(p.name)) s -= 12;
    if (q.monthly >= 1000 && /Index|Diversified|ETF/.test(p.name)) s += 2;
    if (q.monthly < 300 && /Cash|Emergency|Dollar/.test(p.name)) s += 2;
    if (q.goal === 'Passive income' && /Dividend|Bonds/.test(p.name)) s += 4;
    if (q.goal === 'Preserve cash' && /Cash|Bonds|Emergency/.test(p.name)) s += 4;
    if (q.goal === 'Retirement' && /Index|Diversified|Dollar/.test(p.name)) s += 3;
    return s;

'A foundational step before market investing, given your current buffer.' : p.name === 'Growth Stocks' ? `Matches your ${q.risk.toLowerCase()} appetite and ${q.timeline} horizon, only with money you won’t need soon.` : p.name === 'Government Bonds' ? 'Blends growth and stability to match your balanced risk tolerance.' : 'A disciplined way to invest your monthly amount without timing the market.';
  const recommend = p => {

    if (p.name === 'Government Bonds') return riskScore <= 2;

    if (p.name === 'Diversified Portfolio') return readyToInvest && riskScore >= 2;
    return false;
  };
  const questions = [{

    opts: ['Sell', 'Hold steady', 'Buy more']
  }, {
    k: 'style',
    label: 'Your style',
    opts: ['Hands-off', 'Active learning']
  }];
  return React.createElement(AppShell, null, React.createElement(PageHead, {
    eyebrow: "Investment guidance",

  }), React.createElement("div", {

    className: "mb-4"
  }, "Your investing profile"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "space-y-4"
  }, questions.map(qq => React.createElement("div", {
    key: qq.k
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-sm font-medium text-charcoal mb-2"
  }, qq.label), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex flex-wrap gap-2"

    className: cx('rounded-full px-3.5 py-1.5 text-sm border transition', q[qq.k] === o ? 'border-gold bg-gold/10 text-goldd' : 'border-line bg-cream hover:bg-sand')
  }, o))))), React.createElement("div", null, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-sm font-medium text-charcoal mb-1"

function Spark({
  seed,
  up
}) {
  const pts = useMemo(() => {
    let v = 50;
    const a = [];
    let x = seed * 9973;
    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
      x = x * 16807 % 2147483647;
      v += (x / 2147483647 - 0.45) * 10;
      a.push(clamp(v, 10, 90));
    }
    if (up) a[a.length - 1] = Math.max(a[a.length - 1], a[0] + 6);else a[a.length - 1] = Math.min(a[a.length - 1], a[0] - 6);
    return a;
  }, [seed, up]);
  const d = pts.map((p, i) => `${i ? 'L' : 'M'}${i / 19 * 100},${40 - p / 100 * 36}`).join(' ');
  return React.createElement("svg", {
    viewBox: "0 0 100 40",
    className: "w-full h-9"
  }, React.createElement("path", {
    d: d,
    fill: "none",
    stroke: up ? COLORS.sage : COLORS.clay,
    strokeWidth: "2",
    strokeLinecap: "round",
    strokeLinejoin: "round"
  }));
}

    return React.createElement("div", {

    }, React.createElement("div", null, React.createElement("div", {

      className: "tnum font-bold text-lg text-charcoal"
    }, st.ticker), React.createElement("span", {
      className: cx('text-xs tnum', st.chg >= 0 ? 'text-saged' : 'text-clayd')
    }, st.chg >= 0 ? '▲' : '▼', " ", Math.abs(st.chg), "%")), React.createElement("div", {

'text-saged' : 'text-charcoal'), cell('Sentiment', st.sentiment), cell('Sector', st.sector), cell('Rating', rt[0], ratingTone(rt[0]) === 'sage' ? 'text-saged' : ratingTone(rt[0]) === 'clay' ? 'text-clayd' : 'text-charcoal')), React.createElement(MBlock, {

    }, n.beginner), React.createElement("a", {

    }, "Read the story ", React.createElement(Icon, {
      name: "arrowR",
      size: 13,
      className: "-rotate-45"
    }))));

}
function botReply(text, m, fmt, app) {
  const q = text.toLowerCase();
  const leak = m.topLeaks[0];
  const region = (REGIONS[m.region] || {}).name || 'general';
  const name = app.profile.name;
  const ref = `Your figures, income ${fmt.money(m.income)}/mo · savings rate ${round(m.savingsRate * 100)}% · emergency fund ${m.efMonths.toFixed(1)} months · debt ${round(m.debtTotal / m.income * 100)}% of income · health score ${m.overall}/100.`;
  if (/^\s*(hi|hey+|hello|yo|hiya|howdy|sup|good (morning|afternoon|evening)|greetings|hola)\b/.test(q) || /^\s*(hi|hey|hello)\s*$/.test(q)) return {
    text: `Hey ${name} 👋, good to see you. Here’s your snapshot right now:\n\n• Health score: ${m.overall}/100\n• Saving ${round(m.savingsRate * 100)}% of income · emergency fund ${m.efMonths.toFixed(1)} months\n• Biggest opportunity: about ${fmt.money(m.realistic)}/mo you’re over benchmark${leak ? `, led by ${leak.label.toLowerCase()}` : ''}\n\nWhat would you like to dig into? You can tap a suggestion below, or ask me things like “Where am I overspending?”, “Should I pay debt or invest?”, or “What’s an ETF?”`,
    reasoning: `You opened with a greeting, so I led with your live snapshot and offered concrete next questions. ${ref}`
  };
  if (/^\s*(thanks|thank you|thx|ty|cheers|appreciate|nice|great|awesome|perfect|cool)\b/.test(q)) return {
    text: `Anytime, ${name}. 🙌 Want to keep going? I can turn any of this into a step-by-step plan, or dig into your spending, debt, investing or the markets, just say the word.`,
    reasoning: `You expressed thanks, so I acknowledged and offered clear next steps.`
  };
  if (/who are you|what are you|what can you do|help|what.*ask|how.*work/.test(q)) return {
    text: `I’m your Lumera Assistant, ${name}, an educational money guide that uses *your* actual numbers. I can help with:\n\n• Spending & where it leaks\n• Saving more and building a plan\n• Debt payoff (avalanche vs snowball)\n• Investing, credit, insurance, retirement, net worth\n• Plain-English answers on the markets and finance terms\n\nTry: “Why is my score ${m.overall}?”, “How do I save ${fmt.money(500)}/mo?”, or “Am I ready to invest?”`,
    reasoning: `You asked what I can do, so I listed my areas and gave example prompts. ${ref}`
  };
  if (/overspend|leak|too much|where.*spend/.test(q)) return {
    text: `Let’s find where your money is quietly leaking, ${name}.\n\nYour biggest categories above benchmark:\n• ${m.topLeaks.slice(0, 3).map(l => `${l.label}, ${fmt.money(l.over)} over (you: ${fmt.money(l.amount)} vs typical ${fmt.money(l.hi)})`).join('\n• ')}\n\nTogether that’s ~${fmt.money(sum(m.topLeaks.slice(0, 3).map(l => l.over)))}/month (${fmt.money(sum(m.topLeaks.slice(0, 3).map(l => l.over)) * 12)}/year). The fastest win is ${leak ? leak.label.toLowerCase() : 'your top category'}, set a soft cap instead of cutting it out, so the change actually sticks.\n\nWould you like me to turn this into a 4-week plan?`,
    reasoning: `I compared every category you entered against benchmark bands scaled to your income (${region} benchmarks), ranked by amount over the upper band. ${ref}`
  };
  if (/save.*\d|how.*save|cut|save more/.test(q)) return {
    text: `Here’s how you could realistically free up money, ${name}:\n\n1. Trim your top 3 leaks toward benchmark → about ${fmt.money(m.realistic)}/month back, without a joyless budget.\n2. Automate it: move that amount to a separate savings account the day after payday, so it’s saved before it’s spent.\n3. Cancel/▾ any “review” subscriptions before they renew.\n\nThat lifts your savings rate from ${round(m.savingsRate * 100)}% toward ${round((m.savingsTotal + m.realistic) / m.income * 100)}%. A leaner month could reach ${fmt.money(m.aggressive)}. Want a step-by-step plan?`,
    reasoning: `Realistic = sum of each category above its benchmark upper band; aggressive trims toward the midpoint. ${ref}`
  };
  if (/etf|index fund/.test(q)) return {
    text: `An ETF (exchange-traded fund) is a single fund that holds many investments at once, buy one share and you own a slice of everything inside it.\n\n• Example: an S&P 500 ETF spreads your money across 500 large US companies in one go.\n• Why beginners like it: instant diversification, very low fees, and it trades like a normal stock.\n• Watch-out: niche/“thematic” ETFs concentrate risk, start with a broad-market one.\n\nGiven your ${app.profile.risk.toLowerCase()} risk setting, a low-cost broad index ETF is the textbook starting point. Want me to open the Investing page to see a matched allocation?`,
    reasoning: `Educational definition, tailored to your stated risk tolerance. Not a recommendation to buy any specific fund.`
  };
  if (/ready.*invest|should i invest|can i invest/.test(q)) {
    const ready = m.efMonths >= 3 && m.debtTotal / m.income < 0.12;
    return {
      text: `${ready ? `Good news, ${name}, you look investment-ready. ✅` : `Almost, ${name}, let’s get the foundations solid first.`}\n\nThe three checks educators use:\n• Emergency fund ≥ 3 months: ${m.efMonths >= 3 ? '✅' : '⛔'} (yours covers ${m.efMonths.toFixed(1)} months)\n• High-interest debt under control: ${m.debtTotal / m.income < 0.12 ? '✅' : '⛔'} (debt is ${round(m.debtTotal / m.income * 100)}% of income)\n• Consistent monthly surplus: ${m.savingsRate >= 0.1 ? '✅' : '⛔'} (saving ${round(m.savingsRate * 100)}%)\n\n${ready ? 'A sensible next step is dollar-cost averaging a fixed amount into a diversified index fund each month.' : 'Focus on the ⛔ items first, then start small and steady.'}`,
      reasoning: `Checked the three standard pre-investing foundations against your inputs. ${ref}`
    };
  }
  if (/debt|pay off|first|avalanche|snowball/.test(q)) return {
    text: `The common “order of operations”, applied to your numbers:\n\n1. Small starter emergency fund (1 month).\n2. Clear high-interest debt, credit cards first (the avalanche method saves the most interest).\n3. Build a fuller 3–6 month emergency fund.\n4. Then invest for the long term.\n\nPaying off a 20%+ card is effectively a guaranteed 20% return, hard to beat. Your debt is currently ${round(m.debtTotal / m.income * 100)}% of income. Want me to open the Debt planner to compare avalanche vs snowball?`,
    reasoning: `Standard framework applied to your entered balances. Educational only.`
  };
  if (/credit|score/.test(q)) return {
    text: `To lift your credit score, focus on the two biggest factors first:\n\n1. Credit utilisation, keep balances under 30% of your limits (paying before the statement date helps fast).\n2. Payment history, never miss a payment; automate at least the minimum on every account.\n\nThen: keep old accounts open (length of history helps) and space out new applications (each hard inquiry can shave a few points). The Credit page lets you model your exact numbers.`,
    reasoning: `Weighted toward the factors that move scores most. Educational, not a credit-reporting service.`
  };
  if (/net worth|assets|liabilit/.test(q)) return {
    text: `Net worth = everything you own (assets) minus everything you owe (liabilities). It’s the single number that ties your whole financial life together.\n\nThe Net Worth tracker asks for cash, savings, investments, property, vehicle and other assets, then your loans, cards and mortgage, you can enter estimates where you’re unsure. Growing the gap month over month is the goal.`,
    reasoning: `Definition plus a pointer to the detailed questionnaire.`
  };
  if (/market|news|stock/.test(q)) return {
    text: `Today’s quick read: equities are broadly higher, led by technology on AI-chip demand; energy is softer on rising inventories.\n\nFor a long-term plan, single sessions are noise, consistency beats timing. The Stock Market page gives each name an educational rating (Strong Buy → Sell) with a “why it matters”. Shall I open it?`,
    reasoning: `Summarised from the clearly-labelled simulated market feed.`
  };
  if (/plan|action|month|goal/.test(q)) return {
    text: `Here’s a simple month tailored to you, ${name}:\n\n• Week 1, set soft caps on your top 3 leaks.\n• Week 2, focus on ${leak ? leak.label.toLowerCase() : 'your biggest category'}, your largest single overage.\n• Week 3, automate a ${fmt.money(Math.max(m.conservative, 200))} transfer the day after payday.\n• Week 4, re-enter your month and watch your score move up.\n\nReclaiming ${fmt.money(m.realistic)}/mo is very achievable from where you are.`,
    reasoning: `Built from your benchmark gaps and savings opportunity. ${ref}`
  };
  {
    const hit = Object.keys(GLOSSARY).find(k => q.includes(k.toLowerCase()));
    if (hit && /what|explain|mean|define|is a|is an|how does/.test(q)) return {
      text: `${hit}, ${GLOSSARY[hit]}\n\nWant an example using your own numbers, or how it applies to your plan?`,
      reasoning: `Pulled the plain-English definition from Lumera’s glossary and offered to personalise it.`
    };
  }
  if (/retire|retirement|pension/.test(q)) return {
    text: `Retirement comes down to three levers, ${name}: how much you invest each month, for how long, and the return. Starting early matters most, compounding does the heavy lifting. At your ${round(m.savingsRate * 100)}% savings rate, automating investments into a low-cost diversified fund is the highest-impact move. Want me to model it in the Wealth Simulator?`,
    reasoning: `Retirement framing applied to your savings rate. Educational only. ${ref}`
  };
  if (/house|mortgage|home loan|deposit|down ?payment|property/.test(q)) return {
    text: `For a home deposit, treat it as a medium-term goal: keep it in cash/HYSA (not stocks) if you’ll buy within ~3 years, and automate a monthly transfer. Lenders also weigh your debt-to-income ratio, yours is about ${round(m.debtTotal / m.income * 100)}%. Add it as a savings goal and I’ll work out the monthly amount.`,
    reasoning: `Standard home-saving guidance + your debt ratio. ${ref}`
  };
  if (/\brich\b|wealth|wealthy|millionaire|financial freedom|independ/.test(q)) return {
    text: `No trick to it, ${name}, wealth is mostly: spend less than you earn, automate the gap into low-cost diversified investments, avoid high-interest debt, and let time compound. Your biggest lever right now is the ${fmt.money(m.realistic)}/mo you’re over benchmark, capture and invest that consistently and it compounds into a serious sum.`,
    reasoning: `Evidence-based fundamentals applied to your numbers. ${ref}`
  };
  if (/\btax/.test(q)) return {
    text: `Educational, not tax advice: the basics are, use any tax-advantaged accounts your country offers first, hold investments longer where that lowers capital-gains tax, and keep clean records. Once your investments grow, a qualified tax professional usually pays for themselves.`,
    reasoning: `General and educational, tax rules vary by country.`
  };
  if (/how am i doing|my (rate|score)|am i ok|financial health/.test(q)) return {
    text: `Snapshot, ${name}: you’re saving ${round(m.savingsRate * 100)}% of income, your emergency fund covers ${m.efMonths.toFixed(1)} months, and your health score is ${m.overall}/100, ${m.overall >= 68 ? 'a strong position.' : 'a solid base with clear room to grow.'} The single fastest win is the ${fmt.money(m.realistic)}/mo you’re above benchmark. Want a plan to capture it?`,
    reasoning: `Computed from your inputs. ${ref}`
  };
  if (/^(yes|yep|yeah|yup|sure|ok|okay|please|go ahead|do it|sounds good|yes please|let'?s do it|absolutely)\b/.test(q.trim()) || /\b(4|four)[ -]?week|action plan|step[ -]?by[ -]?step|make .*plan|give me a plan|the plan\b/.test(q)) return {
    text: `Love it, ${name}, here’s your 4-week action plan:\n\nWeek 1 · See it clearly\n• Pull last month’s statement and confirm your top categories over benchmark${leak ? ` (start with ${leak.label.toLowerCase()})` : ''}.\n• Set a soft cap on each, together aim to free about ${fmt.money(m.realistic)}/mo.\n\nWeek 2 · Automate the win\n• The day after payday, auto-move ${fmt.money(Math.max(50, Math.round(m.realistic)))} into a separate savings account.\n• Cancel or downgrade one subscription you’d forgotten about.\n\nWeek 3 · Build the buffer\n• Top up your emergency fund, you’re at ${m.efMonths.toFixed(1)} months; aim for 3.\n• Carrying high-interest debt? Throw any spare at the smallest balance.\n\nWeek 4 · Grow it\n• With the buffer healthier, start or increase a small automatic investment.\n• Re-check your score, it should be climbing from ${m.overall}.\n\nWant me to go deeper on any single week?`,
    reasoning: `You confirmed you wanted the plan, so I sequenced your ${fmt.money(m.realistic)}/mo savings opportunity and your ${m.efMonths.toFixed(1)}-month emergency fund into four weekly steps. ${ref}`
  };
  return {
    text: `Good question, ${name}, ask me anything in your own words and I’ll use your actual numbers. I can dig into spending, saving, debt, investing, credit, insurance, retirement, net worth or the markets.\n\nFor example: “Why is my score ${m.overall}?”, “Should I pay debt or invest?”, or “How do I save ${fmt.money(500)} a month?”`,
    reasoning: `No specific intent matched, so I invited a free-form question and gave tailored examples. ${ref}`
  };
}
const CHAT_KEY = 'lumera_chats';
function ChatHistory() {
  const app = useApp();
  const [chats, setChats] = useState(() => {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(__LS.getItem(CHAT_KEY)) || [];
    } catch (e) {
      return [];
    }
  });
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(null);
  const del = id => {
    const n = chats.filter(c => c.id !== id);
    setChats(n);
    try {
      __LS.setItem(CHAT_KEY, JSON.stringify(n));
    } catch (e) {}
    if (open && open.id === id) setOpen(null);
  };
  const clearAll = () => {
    if (!confirm('Delete every saved conversation?')) return;
    setChats([]);
    try {
      __LS.removeItem(CHAT_KEY);
    } catch (e) {}
    setOpen(null);
  };
  return React.createElement(AppShell, null, React.createElement(PageHead, {
    eyebrow: "Chat history",
    title: "Everything you have asked Lumi.",
    desc: "Your past conversations, saved in this browser. Open one to read it back or start a fresh chat.",
    action: chats.length ? React.createElement("button", {
      onClick: clearAll,
      className: "btn btn-ghost px-3 py-2 text-sm"
    }, React.createElement(Icon, {
      name: "x",
      size: 14
    }), "Clear all") : null
  }), chats.length === 0 ? React.createElement(Card, {
    hover: false,
    className: "text-center py-10"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-4xl mb-2"
  }, "\uD83D\uDCAC"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "font-serif text-xl text-charcoal"
  }, "No conversations yet"), React.createElement("p", {
    className: "text-sm text-muted mt-1"
  }, "Ask Lumi anything and it will show up here."), React.createElement(Btn, {
    variant: "primary",
    className: "mt-4",
    iconR: "arrowR",
    onClick: () => app.nav('/assistant')
  }, "Open the assistant")) : React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "space-y-2.5"
  }, chats.map(c => React.createElement(Card, {
    key: c.id,
    onClick: () => setOpen(c),
    className: cx('cursor-pointer', open && open.id === c.id && 'ring-1 ring-gold/40')
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-start justify-between gap-2"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "min-w-0"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-sm font-medium text-charcoal truncate"
  }, c.title), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-[11px] text-faint mt-0.5"
  }, new Date(c.at).toLocaleString(), " \xB7 ", c.msgs.length, " messages")), React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: e => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      del(c.id);
    },
    className: "grid place-items-center h-7 w-7 rounded-lg text-faint hover:text-berry hover:bg-sand shrink-0"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "x",
    size: 13
  })))))), React.createElement(Card, {
    hover: false,
    className: "lg:col-span-2"
  }, !open ? React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-sm text-muted text-center py-10"
  }, "Pick a conversation to read it.") : React.createElement(Fragment, null, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-center justify-between mb-3"
  }, React.createElement(Eyebrow, null, new Date(open.at).toLocaleDateString()), React.createElement(Btn, {
    variant: "ghost",
    onClick: () => app.nav('/assistant')
  }, "New chat")), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "space-y-3 max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto pr-1"
  }, open.msgs.map((mm, i) => React.createElement("div", {
    key: i,
    className: cx('flex', mm.role === 'user' ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start')
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: cx('max-w-[85%] rounded-xl2 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed', mm.role === 'user' ? 'bg-charcoal text-cream' : 'border border-line bg-cream/60 text-charcoal')
  }, mm.text))))))));
}
const CHAT_SID = 'c' + Date.now();
function AIAssistant() {
  const app = useApp();
  const fmt = app.fmt;
  const m = app.metrics;
  const [msgs, setMsgs] = useState([{
    role: 'bot',
    text: `Hi ${app.profile.name}. I’ve read your latest month. Ask me anything, where you’re overspending, whether you’re ready to invest, or how an ETF works. I keep it simple and honest.`
  }]);
  const [typing, setTyping] = useState(false);
  const [input, setInput] = useState('');
  const endRef = useRef(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (msgs.length < 2) return;
    try {
      const all = JSON.parse(__LS.getItem(CHAT_KEY)) || [];
      const first = msgs.find(x => x.role === 'user');
      if (!first) return;
      const entry = {
        id: CHAT_SID,
        title: first.text.slice(0, 70),
        at: Date.now(),
        msgs: msgs.map(x => ({
          role: x.role,
          text: x.text
        }))
      };
      const idx = all.findIndex(c => c.id === CHAT_SID);
      if (idx >= 0) all[idx] = entry;else all.unshift(entry);
      __LS.setItem(CHAT_KEY, JSON.stringify(all.slice(0, 50)));
    } catch (e) {}
  }, [msgs]);
  const prompts = ['Where am I overspending?', 'How can I save AED 500/month?', 'What is an ETF?', 'Am I ready to invest?', 'Should I save, invest, or pay debt first?', 'Build me a monthly action plan'];
  useEffect(() => {
    endRef.current && endRef.current.scrollIntoView({
      behavior: 'smooth'
    });
  }, [msgs, typing]);
  const send = text => {
    const t = (text || input).trim();
    if (!t) return;
    setInput('');
    setMsgs(x => [...x, {
      role: 'user',
      text: t
    }]);
    setTyping(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      const r = botReply(t, m, fmt, app);
      setTyping(false);
      setMsgs(x => [...x, {
        role: 'bot',
        ...r
      }]);
    }, 950 + Math.random() * 500);
  };
  return React.createElement(AppShell, null, React.createElement(PageHead, {
    eyebrow: "AI Financial Assistant",
    title: "Ask your money anything.",
    desc: "Answers built from your own figures, calm, clear, and always educational."
  }), React.createElement("p", {
    className: "-mt-3 mb-4 text-xs text-faint flex items-start gap-1.5"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "info",
    size: 13,
    className: "mt-0.5 shrink-0"
  }), "How it works: Lumi answers using Lumera\u2019s built-in money rules applied to the figures you entered. It is educational, not financial advice, and your questions are not sent to any outside AI service."), React.createElement(Card, {
    className: "!p-0 overflow-hidden flex flex-col",
    style: {
      height: 'min(70vh,640px)'
    }
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-center gap-3 px-5 py-3.5 border-b border-line bg-cream/60"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "grid place-items-center h-9 w-9 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-gold to-goldd text-cream"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "spark",
    size: 18
  })), React.createElement("div", null, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "font-serif text-charcoal leading-none"
  }, "Lumera Assistant"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-[11px] text-saged flex items-center gap-1"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-sage"
  }), "Educational \xB7 uses your figures"))), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 sm:px-5 py-5 space-y-4"
  }, msgs.map((msg, i) => React.createElement("div", {
    key: i,
    className: cx('flex', msg.role === 'user' ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start')
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: cx('max-w-[85%] sm:max-w-[75%]', msg.role === 'user' ? 'order-2' : '')
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: cx('rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 text-sm leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-line anim-fadeUp', msg.role === 'user' ? 'bg-charcoal text-cream rounded-br-md' : 'bg-cream border border-line text-charcoal rounded-bl-md')
  }, msg.text), msg.reasoning && React.createElement("details", {
    className: "mt-1.5 group"
  }, React.createElement("summary", {
    className: "list-none cursor-pointer text-[11px] text-goldd flex items-center gap-1"
  }, "Show reasoning ", React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "chevron",
    size: 11,
    className: "rotate-90 group-open:rotate-[270deg] transition"
  })), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "mt-1 text-[11px] text-muted bg-sand/60 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 leading-relaxed"
  }, msg.reasoning))))), typing && React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex justify-start"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "bg-cream border border-line rounded-2xl rounded-bl-md px-4 py-3.5"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "dot"
  }), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "dot ml-1"
  }), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "dot ml-1"
  }))), React.createElement("div", {
    ref: endRef
  })), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "px-4 sm:px-5 pt-2 border-t border-line bg-cream/40"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar pb-2.5 pt-2"
  }, prompts.map(p => React.createElement("button", {
    key: p,
    onClick: () => send(p),
    className: "shrink-0 rounded-full border border-line bg-card px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-charcoal/80 hover:border-gold hover:text-goldd transition whitespace-nowrap"
  }, p))), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-center gap-2 pb-3"
  }, React.createElement("input", {
    value: input,
    onChange: e => setInput(e.target.value),
    onKeyDown: e => e.key === 'Enter' && send(),
    placeholder: "Ask about your money\u2026",
    className: "flex-1 rounded-full border border-line bg-card px-4 py-3 text-sm focus:border-gold focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-gold/10"
  }), React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: () => send(),
    className: "btn btn-gold h-11 w-11 !p-0 rounded-full"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "send",
    size: 18
  }))))), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "mt-3"
  }, React.createElement(Disclaimer, {
    compact: true
  })));
}
function Budget() {
  const app = useApp();
  const fmt = app.fmt;
  const m = app.metrics;
  const [tpl, setTpl] = useState(BUDGET_TEMPLATES[0]);
  const [custom, setCustom] = useState(() => {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(__LS.getItem('lumera_budget_custom')) || [];
    } catch (e) {
      return [];
    }
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      __LS.setItem('lumera_budget_custom', JSON.stringify(custom));
    } catch (e) {}
  }, [custom]);
  const [showC, setShowC] = useState(false);
  const [nc, setNc] = useState({
    name: '',
    amount: 0,
    bucket: 'Wants'
  });
  const addCustom = () => {
    if (!nc.name || !Number(nc.amount)) return;
    setCustom(c => [...c, {
      id: 'c' + Date.now(),
      name: nc.name,
      amount: Number(nc.amount),
      bucket: nc.bucket
    }]);
    setNc({
      name: '',
      amount: 0,
      bucket: 'Wants'
    });
    setShowC(false);
  };
  const customByBucket = {
    Needs: 0,
    Wants: 0,
    Savings: 0,
    Debt: 0
  };
  custom.forEach(c => {
    customByBucket[c.bucket] = (customByBucket[c.bucket] || 0) + (Number(c.amount) || 0);
  });
  const actuals = {
    Needs: m.essentialsTotal + customByBucket.Needs,
    Wants: m.lifestyleTotal + customByBucket.Wants,
    Savings: m.savingsTotal + customByBucket.Savings,
    Debt: m.obligationsTotal + customByBucket.Debt
  };
  const buckets = Object.entries(tpl.split).map(([k, pct]) => ({
    name: k,
    pct,
    limit: m.income * pct / 100,
    actual: actuals[k] || 0
  }));
  const segColors = {
    Needs: COLORS.charcoal,
    Wants: COLORS.clay,
    Savings: COLORS.sage,
    Debt: COLORS.sky
  };
  return React.createElement(AppShell, null, React.createElement(PageHead, {
    eyebrow: "Budget planner",
    title: "A plan your month can actually keep.",
    desc: "Pick a framework, see your real spending against it, and adjust. Budgets fail when they\u2019re too strict, these are realistic."
  }), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-4"
  }, React.createElement(Card, {
    className: "lg:col-span-2"
  }, React.createElement(Eyebrow, {
    className: "mb-3"
  }, "Choose a template"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5"
  }, BUDGET_TEMPLATES.map(b => React.createElement("button", {
    key: b.id,
    onClick: () => setTpl(b),
    className: cx('text-left rounded-xl2 border p-3.5 transition', tpl.id === b.id ? 'border-gold bg-gold/8' : 'border-line bg-cream hover:bg-sand')
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-center justify-between"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "font-medium text-charcoal"
  }, b.name), tpl.id === b.id && React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "check",
    size: 16,
    className: "text-goldd"
  })), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-xs text-muted mt-0.5"
  }, b.desc), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex gap-1.5 mt-2"
  }, Object.entries(b.split).map(([k, v]) => React.createElement(Pill, {
    key: k,
    tone: "neutral",
    className: "!py-0.5"
  }, k, " ", v, "%"))))))), React.createElement(Card, null, React.createElement(Eyebrow, {
    className: "mb-3"
  }, "Recommended split"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid place-items-center"
  }, React.createElement(Donut, {
    size: 150,
    stroke: 20,
    segments: buckets.map(b => ({
      value: b.pct,
      color: segColors[b.name]
    })),
    center: React.createElement("div", {
      className: "text-center"
    }, React.createElement("div", {
      className: "text-[10px] text-faint uppercase"
    }, "Income"), React.createElement("div", {
      className: "font-serif text-base tnum"
    }, fmt.compact(m.income)))
  })), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "mt-3 space-y-1.5"
  }, buckets.map(b => React.createElement("div", {
    key: b.name,
    className: "flex items-center gap-2 text-sm"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full",
    style: {
      background: segColors[b.name]
    }
  }), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "flex-1 text-charcoal/80"
  }, b.name), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "tnum text-muted"
  }, fmt.money(b.limit))))))), React.createElement(Card, null, React.createElement(Eyebrow, {
    className: "mb-4"
  }, "This month vs your plan"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "space-y-5"
  }, buckets.map(b => {
    const isSave = b.name === 'Savings';
    const bad = isSave ? b.actual < b.limit : b.actual > b.limit;
    const pct = clamp(b.actual / b.limit * 100, 0, 140);
    const barC = bad ? COLORS.clay : COLORS.sage;
    return React.createElement("div", {
      key: b.name
    }, React.createElement("div", {
      className: "flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5"
    }, React.createElement("span", {
      className: "text-sm font-medium text-charcoal flex items-center gap-1.5"
    }, b.name, !bad && React.createElement(Icon, {
      name: "check",
      size: 13,
      className: "text-saged"
    })), React.createElement("span", {
      className: "text-sm tnum"
    }, React.createElement("span", {
      className: cx('font-semibold', bad ? 'text-clayd' : 'text-saged')
    }, fmt.money(b.actual)), React.createElement("span", {
      className: "text-faint"
    }, " / ", fmt.money(b.limit)))), React.createElement("div", {
      className: "h-2.5 rounded-full bg-sand overflow-hidden"
    }, React.createElement("div", {
      className: "h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-700",
      style: {
        width: Math.min(100, pct) + '%',
        background: barC
      }
    })), React.createElement("div", {
      className: "min-h-[18px] mt-1"
    }, bad && React.createElement("div", {
      className: "text-[11px] text-clayd"
    }, isSave ? `${fmt.money(b.limit - b.actual)} below your savings target` : `${fmt.money(b.actual - b.limit)} over your ${b.name.toLowerCase()} limit`), !bad && isSave && React.createElement("div", {
      className: "text-[11px] text-saged"
    }, "Saving at or above target, excellent.")));
  })), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "mt-5 rounded-xl bg-charcoal text-cream text-sm px-4 py-3 flex items-start gap-2"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "spark",
    size: 16,
    className: "text-gold mt-0.5"
  }), buckets.some(b => b.name === 'Savings' ? b.actual < b.limit : b.actual > b.limit) ? `Attention on ${buckets.filter(b => b.name === 'Savings' ? b.actual < b.limit : b.actual > b.limit).map(b => b.name).join(' & ')}. ${buckets.some(b => b.name === 'Savings' && b.actual < b.limit) ? 'Your savings are below target, redirect overspending to close the gap.' : 'Trim the over-budget buckets to grow savings faster.'}` : `Every bucket is on track this month. Consider nudging your savings target up by 2–3%.`)));
}
function monthsUntil(ym) {
  const [y, m] = ym.split('-').map(Number);
  const d = new Date(y, m - 1, 1);
  const now = new Date(2026, 4, 31);
  return Math.max(1, Math.round((d - now) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24 * 30)));
}
const GOAL_KINDS = [['emergency', /emergency|safety|rainy|buffer|cushion|insur/], ['car', /\bcar\b|vehicle|motor|bike|scooter|driv/], ['education', /univers|college|tuition|education|school|degree|master|course|study|exam|student/], ['travel', /travel|trip|holiday|vacation|japan|flight|abroad|gap year|europe|backpack/], ['home', /home|house|flat|apartment|deposit|mortgage|rent|move/], ['wedding', /wedding|ring|engage|honeymoon/], ['tech', /laptop|phone|iphone|computer|pc|console|camera|tech|gadget/], ['business', /business|startup|shop|side hustle|company|freelanc/], ['investing', /invest|portfolio|stock|wealth|isa|shares|crypto|retire|pension/], ['debt', /debt|loan|credit card|overdraft|pay off|bnpl/], ['health', /health|gym|fitness|dental|medical|therapy/], ['family', /baby|family|kid|child|parent|pet|dog|cat/]];
function goalKind(g) {
  const n = String(g && g.name || '').toLowerCase();
  const hit = GOAL_KINDS.find(([, rx]) => rx.test(n));
  return hit ? hit[0] : 'other';
}
