function GoalArt({
  goal
}) {
  if (goal.img) return React.createElement("img", {
    src: goal.img,
    alt: "",
    className: "absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover",
    loading: "lazy"
  });
  const kind = goalKind(goal);
  const sc = GOAL_SCENES[kind] || GOAL_SCENES.other;
  const gid = 'gs-' + String(goal.id || kind).replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, '');
  return React.createElement("svg", {
    className: "absolute inset-0 h-full w-full",
    viewBox: "0 0 320 128",
    preserveAspectRatio: "xMaxYMid meet",
    role: "img",
    "aria-label": sc.label
  }, React.createElement("defs", null, React.createElement("linearGradient", {
    id: gid,
    gradientUnits: "userSpaceOnUse",
    x1: "-260",
    y1: "0",
    x2: "320",
    y2: "128"
  }, React.createElement("stop", {
    offset: "0",
    stopColor: sc.a
  }), React.createElement("stop", {
    offset: "1",
    stopColor: sc.b
  })), React.createElement("radialGradient", {
    id: gid + 'h',
    gradientUnits: "userSpaceOnUse",
    cx: "-120",
    cy: "-40",
    r: "380"
  }, React.createElement("stop", {
    offset: "0",
    stopColor: "#fff",
    stopOpacity: ".35"
  }), React.createElement("stop", {
    offset: "1",
    stopColor: "#fff",
    stopOpacity: "0"
  }))), React.createElement("rect", {
    x: "-2000",
    y: "-200",
    width: "4320",
    height: "528",
    fill: 'url(#' + gid + ')'
  }), React.createElement("rect", {
    x: "-2000",
    y: "-200",
    width: "4320",
    height: "528",
    fill: 'url(#' + gid + 'h)'
  }), sc.art);
}
function Goals() {
  const app = useApp();
  const fmt = app.fmt;
  const m = app.metrics;
  const [goals, setGoals] = useState(() => {
    const saved = lsRead('lumera_goals');
    if (Array.isArray(saved) && saved.length) return saved;
    if (isDemo(app)) return SEED_GOALS;
    const ef = Math.max(Math.round(m.essentialsTotal * 3), 5000);
    const list = [{
      id: 'gEF',
      name: 'Emergency fund',
      target: ef,
      current: app.balances.emergencyFund || 0,
      deadline: '2026-12',
      priority: 'High',
      icon: 'shield'
    }];
    const map = {
      'Home deposit': {
        name: 'Home deposit',
        target: 150000,
        icon: 'home'
      },
      'A big purchase': {
        name: 'Big purchase',
        target: 20000,
        icon: 'bag'
      },
      'Travel': {
        name: 'Travel fund',
        target: 12000,
        icon: 'plane'
      },
      'Investing': {
        name: 'Investment starter',
        target: 20000,
        icon: 'chart'
      },
      'Retirement': {
        name: 'Retirement boost',
        target: 50000,
        icon: 'umbrella'
      }
    };
    const g = app.profile.savingsGoal;
    if (g && g !== 'Emergency fund' && map[g]) list.push({
      id: 'gP',
      ...map[g],
      current: 0,
      deadline: '2028-06',
      priority: 'Medium'
    });
    return list;
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    saveSynced('lumera_goals', goals);
  }, [goals]);
  const [show, setShow] = useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState({
    name: '',
    target: 10000,
    current: 0,
    deadline: '2027-06',
    priority: 'Medium',
    icon: 'target'
  });
  const add = () => {
    if (!draft.name) return;
    setGoals(g => [...g, {
      ...draft,
      id: 'g' + Date.now()
    }]);
    setShow(false);
    setDraft({
      name: '',
      target: 10000,
      current: 0,
      deadline: '2027-06',
      priority: 'Medium',
      icon: 'target'
    });
  };
  return React.createElement(AppShell, null, React.createElement(PageHead, {
    eyebrow: "Savings goals",
    title: "Give your money a destination.",
    desc: "Named goals you can feel progress toward. Lumera works out exactly what to set aside each month.",
    action: React.createElement(Btn, {
      variant: "gold",
      icon: "plus",
      onClick: () => setShow(s => !s)
    }, "New goal")
  }), show && React.createElement(Card, {
    className: "mb-4 anim-fadeUp"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4"
  }, React.createElement("label", {
    className: "block"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-sm text-charcoal/85 mb-1.5 block"
  }, "Goal name"), React.createElement("input", {
    value: draft.name,
    onChange: e => setDraft(d => ({
      ...d,
      name: e.target.value
    })),
    placeholder: "e.g. New laptop",
    className: "w-full rounded-xl border border-line bg-cream px-3 py-2.5 focus:border-gold focus:outline-none"
  })), React.createElement(NumberField, {
    id: "target",
    label: "Target amount",
    value: draft.target,
    onChange: (k, v) => setDraft(d => ({
      ...d,
      target: v
    }))
  }), React.createElement(NumberField, {
    id: "current",
    label: "Already saved",
    value: draft.current,
    onChange: (k, v) => setDraft(d => ({
      ...d,
      current: v
    }))
  }), React.createElement("label", {
    className: "block"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-sm text-charcoal/85 mb-1.5 block"
  }, "Target date"), React.createElement("input", {
    type: "month",
    value: draft.deadline,
    onChange: e => setDraft(d => ({
      ...d,
      deadline: e.target.value
    })),
    className: "w-full rounded-xl border border-line bg-cream px-3 py-2.5 focus:border-gold focus:outline-none"
  }))), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex gap-2 mt-4"
  }, React.createElement(Btn, {
    variant: "gold",
    onClick: add
  }, "Add goal"), React.createElement(Btn, {
    variant: "ghost",
    onClick: () => setShow(false)
  }, "Cancel"))), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4"
  }, goals.map(g => {
    const pct = clamp(g.current / g.target * 100, 0, 100);
    const mo = monthsUntil(g.deadline);
    const need = Math.max(0, (g.target - g.current) / mo);
    const done = pct >= 100;
    return React.createElement(Card, {
      key: g.id,
      hover: true,
      className: "relative overflow-hidden !p-0"
    }, React.createElement("div", {
      className: "relative h-32 overflow-hidden"
    }, React.createElement(GoalArt, {
      goal: g
    }), React.createElement("div", {
      className: "absolute inset-0",
      style: {
        background: 'linear-gradient(to top, rgba(14,13,20,.82) 0%, rgba(14,13,20,.2) 55%, transparent 100%)'
      }
    }), React.createElement("span", {
      className: "absolute top-2 left-2 grid place-items-center h-8 w-8 rounded-lg bg-cream/85 text-goldd backdrop-blur"
    }, React.createElement(Icon, {
      name: done ? 'trophy' : g.icon,
      size: 16
    })), React.createElement("label", {
      className: "absolute top-2 right-2 grid place-items-center h-8 w-8 rounded-lg bg-cream/85 text-charcoal cursor-pointer hover:bg-cream backdrop-blur focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-gold",
      title: "Use your own image"
    }, React.createElement(Icon, {
      name: "plus",
      size: 15
    }), React.createElement("input", {
      type: "file",
      accept: "image/*",
      className: "sr-only",
      "aria-label": `Use your own image for ${g.name}`,
      onChange: e => {
        const f = e.target.files && e.target.files[0];
        if (!f) return;
        shrinkImage(f).then(url => setGoals(gs => gs.map(x => x.id === g.id ? {
          ...x,
          img: url
        } : x))).catch(() => {});
      }
    })), React.createElement("div", {
      className: "absolute bottom-2.5 left-3 right-24 flex flex-col items-start gap-1.5"
    }, React.createElement(Pill, {
      tone: g.priority === 'High' ? 'clay' : 'neutral'
    }, g.priority), React.createElement("h3", {
      className: "font-display text-[1.45rem] text-cream leading-tight truncate max-w-full",
      style: {
        textShadow: '0 1px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.55)'
      }
    }, g.name))), React.createElement("div", {
      className: "p-5 pt-4"
    }, React.createElement("div", {
      className: "text-sm text-muted tnum"
    }, fmt.money(g.current), " ", React.createElement("span", {
      className: "text-faint"
    }, "of ", fmt.money(g.target))), React.createElement("div", {
      className: "mt-3"
    }, React.createElement("div", {
      className: "flex justify-between text-xs text-faint mb-1"
    }, React.createElement("span", {
      className: "tnum"
    }, round(pct), "%"), React.createElement("span", null, mo, " months left")), React.createElement(ProgressBar, {
      value: pct,
      tone: done ? 'sage' : 'gold',
      height: 9
    })), React.createElement("div", {
      className: "mt-3 rounded-lg bg-sand/60 px-3 py-2 text-sm flex items-center justify-between"
    }, React.createElement("span", {
      className: "text-muted"
    }, "Set aside / month"), React.createElement("span", {
      className: "font-semibold text-charcoal tnum"
    }, done ? 'Complete 🎉' : fmt.money(need))), React.createElement("div", {
      className: "mt-2 text-[11px] text-goldd flex items-start gap-1.5"
    }, React.createElement(Icon, {
      name: "spark",
      size: 12,
      className: "mt-0.5"
    }), done ? 'Goal reached, roll it into investing.' : need > app.metrics.realistic ? `Tight on timeline, extend the date or redirect part of your ${fmt.money(app.metrics.realistic)} savings opportunity.` : `Achievable within your current savings opportunity.`)));
  })));
}
function Emergency() {
  const app = useApp();
  const fmt = app.fmt;
  const m = app.metrics;
  const [ess, setEss] = useState(Math.round(m.essentialsTotal));
  const [stability, setStability] = useState('Stable');
  const [deps, setDeps] = useState(app.profile.dependents);
  const [debt, setDebt] = useState(m.debtTotal / m.income > 0.12 ? 'High' : 'Low');
  const recMonths = useMemo(() => {
    let mo = 3;
    if (stability === 'Unstable') mo += 3;else if (stability === 'Somewhat stable') mo += 1.5;
    if (deps > 0) mo += Math.min(3, deps * 1.5);
    if (debt === 'High') mo += 1.5;
    return clamp(Math.round(mo), 3, 12);
  }, [stability, deps, debt]);
  const [months, setMonths] = useState(recMonths);
  useEffect(() => setMonths(recMonths), [recMonths]);
  const target = ess * months;
  const current = app.balances.emergencyFund;
  const gap = Math.max(0, target - current);
  const perMonth = gap > 0 ? gap / 12 : 0;
  return React.createElement(AppShell, null, React.createElement(PageHead, {
    eyebrow: "Emergency fund calculator",
    title: "Know your true safety number.",
    desc: "An emergency fund is the foundation everything else rests on. Let\u2019s size yours for your real life."
  }), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4"
  }, React.createElement(Card, null, React.createElement(Eyebrow, {
    className: "mb-4"
  }, "Your situation"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "space-y-4"
  }, React.createElement(NumberField, {
    id: "ess",
    label: "Monthly essential expenses",
    value: ess,
    onChange: (k, v) => setEss(v),
    icon: "home"
  }), React.createElement("div", null, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-sm font-medium text-charcoal mb-2"
  }, "Job stability"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex flex-wrap gap-2"
  }, ['Very stable', 'Stable', 'Somewhat stable', 'Unstable'].map(o => React.createElement("button", {
    key: o,
    onClick: () => setStability(o),
    className: cx('rounded-full px-3.5 py-1.5 text-sm border transition', stability === o ? 'border-gold bg-gold/10 text-goldd' : 'border-line bg-cream hover:bg-sand')
  }, o)))), React.createElement("div", null, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-sm font-medium text-charcoal mb-2"
  }, "Dependents"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-center gap-3"
  }, React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: () => setDeps(d => clamp(d - 1, 0, 8)),
    className: "grid place-items-center h-10 w-10 rounded-xl border border-line bg-cream hover:bg-sand"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "minus",
    size: 16
  })), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "font-serif text-2xl w-8 text-center tnum"
  }, deps), React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: () => setDeps(d => clamp(d + 1, 0, 8)),
    className: "grid place-items-center h-10 w-10 rounded-xl border border-line bg-cream hover:bg-sand"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "plus",
    size: 16
  })))), React.createElement("div", null, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-sm font-medium text-charcoal mb-2"
  }, "Debt level"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex gap-2"
  }, ['Low', 'Moderate', 'High'].map(o => React.createElement("button", {
    key: o,
    onClick: () => setDebt(o),
    className: cx('rounded-full px-3.5 py-1.5 text-sm border transition', debt === o ? 'border-gold bg-gold/10 text-goldd' : 'border-line bg-cream hover:bg-sand')
  }, o)))))), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "space-y-4"
  }, React.createElement(Card, {
    className: "bg-gradient-to-br from-gold/8 to-transparent"
  }, React.createElement(Eyebrow, {
    className: "mb-2"
  }, "Recommended buffer"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-end gap-3"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "font-serif text-5xl text-charcoal tnum"
  }, months), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-muted mb-2"
  }, "months of essentials")), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "mt-3"
  }, React.createElement(LuxSlider, {
    value: months,
    min: 3,
    max: 12,
    step: 1,
    onChange: setMonths,
    fmt: v => v + ' mo'
  })), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex gap-2 mt-2"
  }, [3, 6, 9, 12].map(x => React.createElement("button", {
    key: x,
    onClick: () => setMonths(x),
    className: cx('flex-1 rounded-lg py-1.5 text-xs border transition', months === x ? 'border-gold bg-gold/10 text-goldd' : 'border-line text-muted hover:bg-sand')
  }, x, " mo"))), React.createElement("p", {
    className: "text-xs text-faint mt-2"
  }, "Suggested: ", recMonths, " months for your stability, dependents and debt.")), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid grid-cols-3 gap-3"
  }, React.createElement(Card, {
    hover: false,
    className: "!p-4"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-xs text-muted"
  }, "Current"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "font-serif text-xl text-charcoal tnum"
  }, React.createElement(AnimatedNumber, {
    value: current,
    money: true
  }))), React.createElement(Card, {
    hover: false,
    className: "!p-4"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-xs text-muted"
  }, "Target"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "font-serif text-xl text-goldd tnum"
  }, React.createElement(AnimatedNumber, {
    value: target,
    money: true
  }))), React.createElement(Card, {
    hover: false,
    className: "!p-4"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-xs text-muted"
  }, "Gap"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "font-serif text-xl text-clayd tnum"
  }, React.createElement(AnimatedNumber, {
    value: gap,
    money: true
  })))), React.createElement(Card, null, React.createElement(Eyebrow, {
    className: "mb-3"
  }, "Monthly plan"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-5"
  }, React.createElement(ScoreRing, {
    value: clamp(current / (target || 1) * 100, 0, 100),
    size: 112,
    stroke: 10,
    label: "funded",
    color: COLORS.sage
  }), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex-1 min-w-[190px] text-center sm:text-left"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-faint"
  }, "Set aside each month"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "font-display text-[2.8rem] text-saged tnum leading-none mt-1"
  }, fmt.money(perMonth), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-base text-muted font-sans"
  }, "/mo")), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-sm text-muted mt-1.5"
  }, gap > 0 ? 'to close the gap in 12 months' : 'Your fund is fully built.')))))));
}
const monogramOf = name => {
  const w = String(name || '').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9 ]+/g, ' ').trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  return ((w[0] || '?')[0] + ((w[1] || '')[0] || '')).toUpperCase();
};

const GENERIC_WORDS = new Set(('news gym fitness music video tv streaming storage cloud software gaming games magazine newspaper insurance phone ' + 'mobile internet broadband boutique local my the other misc subscription app premium online yoga meal kit box club course courses learning ' + 'vpn dating audio books book membership plan monthly annual family student basic standard plus pro').split(' '));
function logoDomainFor(name, domain) {
  if (domain && /^[a-z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}$/i.test(domain)) return domain.toLowerCase();
  const n = String(name || '').toLowerCase().replace(/\+/g, ' plus').replace(/[^a-z0-9 ]+/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  if (!n) return '';
  if (KNOWN_DOMAINS[n]) return KNOWN_DOMAINS[n];
  const words = n.split(' ');
  for (let k = Math.min(3, words.length); k >= 1; k--) {
    const head = words.slice(0, k).join(' ');
    if (KNOWN_DOMAINS[head]) return KNOWN_DOMAINS[head];
  }
  const core = words.filter(w => !GENERIC_WORDS.has(w) && !/^\d/.test(w));
  return core.length === 1 && words.length <= 3 && core[0].length >= 4 ? core[0] + '.com' : '';
}
function logoSources(name, domain, server) {
  const out = [];
  if (server && name) out.push(`/api/companies/logo?name=${encodeURIComponent(name)}${domain ? `&domain=${encodeURIComponent(domain)}` : ''}`);
  const d = logoDomainFor(name, domain);
  if (d) {
    out.push(`https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=${encodeURIComponent(d)}&sz=128`);
    out.push(`https://icons.duckduckgo.com/ip3/${encodeURIComponent(d)}.ico`);
  }
  return out;
}
function CompanyLogo({
  name,
  domain,
  size = 40,
  hue = '#8B5CF6',
  className = ''
}) {
  const app = useApp();
  const sources = useMemo(() => logoSources(name, domain, app.apiMode === 'server'), [name, domain, app.apiMode]);
  const [i, setI] = useState(0);
  const [ok, setOk] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    setI(0);
    setOk(false);
  }, [sources.join('|')]);
  const src = sources[i];
  const nextSource = () => {
    setOk(false);
    setI(x => x + 1);
  };
  return React.createElement("span", {
    className: cx('relative grid place-items-center overflow-hidden shrink-0', className),
    role: "img",
    "aria-label": name ? name + ' logo' : undefined,
    style: {
      width: size,
      height: size,
      borderRadius: Math.round(size * 0.28),
      background: ok ? '#fff' : `linear-gradient(150deg, ${hue}40, ${hue}14)`,
      boxShadow: `inset 0 0 0 1px ${ok ? 'rgba(0,0,0,.06)' : hue + '55'}, inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25)`
    }
  }, !ok && React.createElement("span", {
    "aria-hidden": "true",
    className: "font-bold tracking-tight",
    style: {
      fontSize: Math.round(size * 0.36),
      color: hue
    }
  }, monogramOf(name)), src && React.createElement("img", {
    key: src,
    src: src,
    alt: "",
    loading: "lazy",
    decoding: "async",
    draggable: "false",
    referrerPolicy: "no-referrer",
    onLoad: e => {
      if (e.currentTarget.naturalWidth < 24) nextSource();else setOk(true);
    },
    onError: nextSource,
    className: cx('absolute inset-0 m-auto object-contain transition-opacity duration-300', ok ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0'),
    style: {
      width: '70%',
      height: '70%'
    }
  }));
}
const SUB_ALTS = [[/netflix|disney|hulu|max\b|hbo|paramount|peacock|prime video|now tv/i, 'Keep one streaming service at a time and rotate monthly, or use the ad-supported tier'], [/spotify|apple music|youtube music|tidal|deezer/i, 'A family or student plan, or the free ad-supported tier'], [/icloud|google one|dropbox|onedrive/i, 'Clear old photos and backups and drop to a smaller storage tier'], [/adobe|creative cloud/i, 'Affinity (one-time purchase), Canva or Photopea (free)'], [/microsoft|office|365/i, 'Google Docs / Sheets (free) or LibreOffice'], [/masterclass|skillshare|coursera|udemy/i, 'Free courses on YouTube, Khan Academy or your library’s online access'], [/gym|fitness|peloton|classpass/i, 'A pay-as-you-go or council gym, or a home workout plan'], [/news|times|economist|ft\b|journal/i, 'Free article limits, newsletters or library digital access'], [/chatgpt|openai|claude|grammarly|notion/i, 'The free tier, unless you use the paid features every week'], [/xbox|playstation|ps plus|nintendo|game pass/i, 'Subscribe only in months you are actively playing'], [/prime|amazon/i, 'Pay delivery per order, or a free trial when you need it'], [/audible|kindle/i, 'Your library app (Libby) for free audiobooks and ebooks']];
function subAdvice(s, fmt) {
  const dead = s.freq === 'Never' || s.freq === 'Rarely';
  const altText = s.alt ? s.alt.name : (SUB_ALTS.find(([rx]) => rx.test(s.name || '')) || [])[1] || null;
  const save = s.alt ? Math.max(0, s.cost - s.alt.cost) : null;
  const fix = s.freq === 'Never' ? `You have not used it. Cancel it to save ${fmt.money(s.cost * 12)} a year.` : s.freq === 'Rarely' ? `You barely use it. Pause or cancel, and rejoin only when you need it.` : s.freq === 'Monthly' ? `Used about once a month. Check whether a cheaper tier covers what you use.` : `You use it often, so it is worth keeping. Check you are on the right plan.`;
  return {
    dead,
    fix,
    altText,
    save
  };
}

  }, "Remind 3 days before") : React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-xs text-goldd"
  }, "Add a date for a reminder")))), React.createElement("p", {

  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "info",
    size: 12
  }), "Renewal reminders are optional. Add a date if you\u2019d like a nudge before a \u201Creview\u201D item renews, nothing is required.")), React.createElement(Card, {
    className: "mt-4"
  }, React.createElement(Eyebrow, {
    className: "mb-3"
  }, "General money-saving tactics"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3"
  }, [['Rotate streaming', 'Keep one streaming service at a time and rotate monthly instead of paying for several at once.', 'tv'], ['Switch to annual billing', 'Many services discount 10–20% for paying yearly, worth it for the ones you’ll definitely keep.', 'calendar'], ['Share a family plan', 'Family or duo tiers often cost less per person than separate individual plans.', 'users']].map(([t, d, ic]) => React.createElement("div", {

  }), t), React.createElement("p", {
    className: "text-xs text-muted mt-1 leading-relaxed"
  }, d)))), unused > 0 && React.createElement("div", {

  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "info",
    size: 13
  }), "About ", fmt.money(unused), "/mo is going to rarely- or never-used services, the first place to look.")));
}
function simulateDebts(debts, extra, strategy) {
  let list = debts.map(d => ({
    ...d
  }));
  let months = 0,
    interest = 0;
  const cap = 600;
  const order = () => strategy === 'avalanche' ? [...list].sort((a, b) => b.rate - a.rate) : [...list].sort((a, b) => a.balance - b.balance);
  while (list.some(d => d.balance > 0.5) && months < cap) {
    months++;
    let pool = extra;
    list.forEach(d => {
      if (d.balance <= 0) return;
      const i = d.balance * (d.rate / 100 / 12);
      interest += i;
      d.balance += i;
    });
    list.forEach(d => {
      if (d.balance <= 0) return;
      const pay = Math.min(d.balance, d.min);
      d.balance -= pay;
    });
    for (const d of order()) {
      if (pool <= 0) break;
      if (d.balance <= 0) continue;
      const pay = Math.min(d.balance, pool);
      d.balance -= pay;
      pool -= pay;
    }
  }
  return {
    months,
    interest: Math.round(interest)
  };
}

    className: "mt-4 rounded-xl bg-gold/8 text-sm text-charcoal/80 px-4 py-3 flex items-start gap-2"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "spark",
    size: 16,
    className: "text-goldd mt-0.5"
  }), debtRatio > 0.5 ? 'Your debts are over half your assets. Prioritise paying down high-interest balances to lift your net worth faster.' : 'Healthy balance sheet. Keep directing surplus into investments to compound your net worth.'))));
}

function Pricing() {
  const app = useApp();
  const canJoin = app.apiMode === 'server' && app.user && !app.user.demo;
  const [waitlisted, setWaitlisted] = useState({});
  const [waitBusy, setWaitBusy] = useState('');
  const [waitErr, setWaitErr] = useState('');
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!canJoin) return;
    let dead = false;
    API.get('/api/me/waitlist').then(r => {
      if (!dead) setWaitlisted(Object.fromEntries((r.plans || []).map(p => [p, true])));
    }).catch(() => {});
    return () => {
      dead = true;
    };
  }, [canJoin]);
  const toggleWait = plan => {
    if (!canJoin) {
      app.nav('/signup');
      return;
    }
    setWaitBusy(plan);
    setWaitErr('');
    API.put('/api/me/waitlist', {
      plan,
      on: !waitlisted[plan]
    }).then(r => setWaitlisted(Object.fromEntries((r.plans || []).map(p => [p, true])))).catch(e => setWaitErr(e.message || 'That did not save. Try again.')).finally(() => setWaitBusy(''));
  };
  const tiers = [{
    name: 'Free',
    price: 'Free',
    sub: 'Available today',
    tone: false,
    cta: 'Current plan',
    feats: ['30-day expense review', 'Financial health score', 'Budget & savings tools', 'Emergency fund calculator', 'Subscription leak detector', 'Community', 'Lumi, your money assistant'],
    note: 'Everything you need to start understanding your money.'
  }, {
    name: 'Pro',
    price: 'Coming soon',
    sub: 'For serious optimisers',
    tone: true,
    cta: 'Notify me',

function DataControls() {
  const app = useApp();
  const server = app.apiMode === 'server' && app.user && !app.user.demo;
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState('');
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');
  const [confirmDel, setConfirmDel] = useState(false);
  const [pw, setPw] = useState('');
  const doExport = async () => {
    setBusy('export');
    setErr('');
    setMsg('');
    try {
      await app.exportData();
      setMsg('Your export has downloaded.');
    } catch (x) {
      setErr(x.message);
    } finally {
      setBusy('');
    }
  };
  const doReset = () => {
    if (!window.confirm('Clear your figures and start your monthly review again? Your account stays.')) return;
    app.resetAll();
    app.nav('/review');
  };
  const doDelete = async e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy('delete');
    setErr('');
    try {
      await app.deleteAccount(pw);
    } catch (x) {
      setErr(x.message);
      setBusy('');
    }
  };
  if (!app.user) return null;
  return React.createElement("div", null, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3"
  }, React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: doExport,
    disabled: !!busy,
    className: "btn btn-ghost px-4 py-3 text-sm justify-start"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "download",
    size: 16
  }), busy === 'export' ? 'Preparing…' : 'Export my data'), React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: doReset,
    disabled: !!busy,
    className: "btn btn-ghost px-4 py-3 text-sm justify-start"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "refresh",
    size: 16
  }), "Reset my month"), React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: () => {
      setConfirmDel(true);
      setErr('');
    },
    disabled: !!busy,
    className: "btn px-4 py-3 text-sm justify-start border border-berry/40 text-berry hover:bg-berry/5"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "x",
    size: 16
  }), "Delete my account")), msg && React.createElement("p", {
    role: "status",
    className: "text-xs text-saged mt-3"
  }, msg), confirmDel && React.createElement("form", {
    onSubmit: doDelete,
    className: "mt-4 rounded-2xl p-4",
    style: {
      background: 'rgba(251,133,150,.08)',
      boxShadow: 'inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(251,133,150,.3)'
    }
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-sm font-semibold text-charcoal"
  }, "Delete your account for good?"), React.createElement("p", {
    className: "text-xs text-muted mt-1"
  }, server ? 'Your account, figures, posts, replies and connections are deleted immediately. This cannot be undone.' : 'Everything Lumera holds in this browser for this profile is deleted. This cannot be undone.'), server && React.createElement("label", {
    className: "block mt-3"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-xs text-charcoal/85 mb-1 block"
  }, "Enter your password to confirm"), React.createElement("input", {
    type: "password",
    name: "current-password",
    autoComplete: "current-password",
    value: pw,
    onChange: e => setPw(e.target.value),
    className: "w-full rounded-xl border border-line bg-cream px-3 py-2.5 text-sm focus:border-gold focus:outline-none"
  })), React.createElement(FormError, {
    msg: err
  }), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex gap-2 mt-3"
  }, React.createElement("button", {
    type: "submit",
    disabled: busy === 'delete' || server && !pw,
    className: "btn px-4 py-2.5 text-sm border border-berry/50 text-berry hover:bg-berry/10"
  }, busy === 'delete' ? 'Deleting…' : 'Delete permanently'), React.createElement("button", {
    type: "button",
    onClick: () => {
      setConfirmDel(false);
      setPw('');
    },
    className: "btn btn-ghost px-4 py-2.5 text-sm"
  }, "Cancel"))), !confirmDel && err && React.createElement(FormError, {
    msg: err
  }));
}

const LANGWORD = {
  en: '',
  ar: 'شرح بالعربي',
  hi: 'हिंदी में',
  fr: 'expliqué en français',
  es: 'explicado en español'

function topicKey(t) {
  t = (t || '').toLowerCase();
  if (/budget/.test(t)) return 'budget';
  if (/emergency/.test(t)) return 'emergency';
  if (/etf/.test(t)) return 'etf';
  if (/index/.test(t)) return 'index';
  if (/compound/.test(t)) return 'compound';
  if (/diversif/.test(t)) return 'diversification';
  if (/risk/.test(t)) return 'risk';
  if (/debt/.test(t)) return 'debt';
  if (/invest|allocat|dividend|rebalanc|tax/.test(t)) return 'invest';
  return null;
}
function vidUrl(key, lang) {
  const v = VIDEOS[key] || {};
  if ((lang === 'en' || !LANGWORD[lang]) && v.en) return v.en;
  const q = encodeURIComponent(((v.q || key || 'personal finance') + ' ' + (LANGWORD[lang] || '')).trim());
  return `https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=${q}`;
}
function Term({
  children,
  k
}) {
  const key = k || (typeof children === 'string' ? children : '');
  const def = GLOSSARY[key];
  if (!def) return React.createElement("span", null, children);
  return React.createElement(Hint, {
    text: def
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "underline decoration-dotted decoration-goldd/60 underline-offset-2 cursor-help"
  }, children));
}

function Field({
  label,
  type = 'text',
  value,
  onChange,
  placeholder,
  icon,

  name,

}) {

  return React.createElement("label", {
    htmlFor: id,
    className: "block mb-3"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-sm text-charcoal/85 mb-1.5 block"
  }, label), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "relative flex items-center"
  }, icon && React.createElement("span", {
    className: "absolute left-3 text-faint",
    "aria-hidden": "true"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: icon,
    size: 16
  })), React.createElement("input", {
    id: id,
    name: name,
    type: type,
    value: value,
    onChange: e => onChange(e.target.value),
    placeholder: placeholder,
    autoComplete: autoComplete,
    className: cx('w-full rounded-xl border border-line bg-cream py-3 focus:border-gold focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-gold/10', icon ? 'pl-10 pr-3' : 'px-3')
  })), hint && React.createElement("span", {
    className: "block text-[11px] text-faint mt-1"
  }, hint));
}
function FormError({
  msg
}) {
  return msg ? React.createElement("div", {
    role: "alert",
    className: "rounded-lg bg-berry/10 text-berry text-xs px-3 py-2 mb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "info",
    size: 13
  }), msg) : null;
}
const EMAIL_OK = v => /^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]{2,}$/.test(String(v).trim());
function Signup() {
  const app = useApp();
  const server = app.apiMode === 'server';
  const [n, setN] = useState('');
  const [e, setE] = useState('');
  const [pw, setPw] = useState('');
  const [agree, setAgree] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const submit = async ev => {
    ev && ev.preventDefault();
    if (!n.trim()) return setErr('Please enter your name.');
    if (!EMAIL_OK(e)) return setErr('Please enter a valid email address.');
    if (server && pw.length < 10) return setErr('Use a password of at least 10 characters.');
    if (!agree) return setErr('Please confirm you have read the terms and privacy policy.');
    setErr('');
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await app.signup(n.trim(), e.trim(), pw);
    } catch (x) {
      setErr(x.message);
      if (x.code === 'exists') setTimeout(() => app.nav('/login'), 1600);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };
  return React.createElement(AuthShell, {
    title: "Create your account",
    sub: server ? 'Free. No card and no bank login.' : 'Free. No card, no bank login, and your figures stay in this browser.',
    foot: React.createElement(React.Fragment, null, "Already have an account? ", React.createElement("button", {
      onClick: () => app.nav('/login'),
      className: "text-goldd font-semibold"
    }, "Log in"))
  }, React.createElement("form", {
    onSubmit: submit,
    noValidate: true
  }, React.createElement(Field, {
    label: "Name",
    value: n,
    onChange: v => {
      setN(v);
      setErr('');
    },
    placeholder: "Your name",
    icon: "user",
    name: "name",
    autoComplete: "name"
  }), React.createElement(Field, {
    label: "Email",
    type: "email",
    value: e,
    onChange: v => {
      setE(v);
      setErr('');
    },
    placeholder: "you@email.com",
    icon: "mail",
    name: "email",
    autoComplete: "email"
  }), server && React.createElement(Field, {
    label: "Password",
    type: "password",
    value: pw,
    onChange: v => {
      setPw(v);
      setErr('');
    },
    placeholder: "At least 10 characters",
    icon: "lock",
    name: "new-password",
    autoComplete: "new-password",
    hint: "A passphrase of a few words is easiest to remember."
  }), !server && React.createElement("div", {
    className: "rounded-xl2 border border-line bg-cream/50 p-3 mb-3"
  }, React.createElement("p", {
    className: "text-[11.5px] text-muted leading-relaxed"
  }, "This profile is stored in this browser only, with no password, so anyone using this device can open it. Clearing your browser data deletes it for good.")), React.createElement("label", {
    className: "flex items-start gap-2.5 mb-3 cursor-pointer"
  }, React.createElement("input", {
    type: "checkbox",
    checked: agree,
    onChange: ev => {
      setAgree(ev.target.checked);
      setErr('');
    },
    className: "mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 accent-current"
  }), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-[12px] text-charcoal/80 leading-relaxed"
  }, "I am ", MIN_AGE, "+ and I have read the ", React.createElement("button", {
    type: "button",
    onClick: () => app.nav('/terms'),
    className: "underline text-goldd"
  }, "Terms"), " and ", React.createElement("button", {
    type: "button",
    onClick: () => app.nav('/privacy'),
    className: "underline text-goldd"
  }, "Privacy Policy"), ".")), React.createElement(FormError, {
    msg: err
  }), React.createElement("button", {
    type: "submit",
    disabled: busy,
    className: "btn btn-gold w-full mt-1 px-5 py-3 text-sm"
  }, busy ? 'Creating your account…' : 'Create account', !busy && React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "arrowR",
    size: 16
  }))), React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: () => app.demo(),
    className: "w-full btn btn-ghost py-3 text-sm mt-3"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "play",
    size: 15
  }), "Explore a demo account"));
}

function Forgot() {
  const app = useApp();
  const server = app.apiMode === 'server';
  const [e, setE] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');
  const mail = !!SERVER_INFO.mail;
  const support = SERVER_INFO.supportEmail;
  const submit = async ev => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    if (!EMAIL_OK(e)) return setErr('Please enter a valid email address.');
    setBusy(true);
    setErr('');
    try {
      await API.post('/api/auth/forgot', {
        email: e.trim()
      });
      setSent(true);
    } catch (x) {
      setErr(x.message);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };
  const contact = support ? React.createElement("a", {
    href: 'mailto:' + support + '?subject=Password%20reset',
    className: "text-goldd font-semibold underline"
  }, support) : React.createElement("b", null, "the Lumera team");
  return React.createElement(AuthShell, {
    title: "Forgot your password?",
    sub: mail ? 'We will email you a link to choose a new one.' : 'Get a one-time link to choose a new password.',
    foot: React.createElement("button", {
      onClick: () => app.nav('/login'),
      className: "text-goldd font-semibold"
    }, "\u2190 Back to log in")
  }, !server ? React.createElement("div", {
    className: "rounded-xl2 border border-line bg-cream/50 p-4 text-sm text-muted leading-relaxed"
  }, "This offline copy keeps profiles in your browser, so there is no password to reset.") : !mail ? React.createElement("div", {
    className: "rounded-xl2 border border-line bg-cream/50 p-4 text-sm text-charcoal/85 leading-relaxed"
  }, "Reset emails are not switched on yet. Contact ", contact, " from the address on your account and they will send you a one-time link. It works once and expires after an hour.") : sent ? React.createElement("div", {
    role: "status",
    className: "rounded-xl2 border border-sage/40 bg-sage/10 p-4 text-sm text-charcoal/90 leading-relaxed flex items-start gap-2"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "mail",
    size: 16,
    className: "mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-saged"
  }), React.createElement("span", null, "If an account uses ", React.createElement("b", null, e.trim()), ", a reset link is on its way. It works once and expires in an hour. Check your spam folder if it has not arrived in a few minutes.")) : React.createElement("form", {
    onSubmit: submit,
    noValidate: true
  }, React.createElement(Field, {
    label: "Email",
    type: "email",
    value: e,
    onChange: v => {
      setE(v);
      setErr('');
    },
    placeholder: "you@email.com",
    icon: "mail",
    name: "email",
    autoComplete: "username"
  }), React.createElement(FormError, {
    msg: err
  }), React.createElement("button", {
    type: "submit",
    disabled: busy,
    className: "btn btn-primary w-full px-5 py-3 text-sm"
  }, busy ? 'Sending…' : 'Email me a reset link')));
}
function ResetPassword() {
  const app = useApp();
  const token = useMemo(() => {
    const q = app.route.split('?')[1] || '';
    return new URLSearchParams(q).get('token') || '';
  }, [app.route]);
  const [pw, setPw] = useState('');
  const [pw2, setPw2] = useState('');
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const submit = async ev => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    if (pw.length < 10) return setErr('Use a password of at least 10 characters.');
    if (pw !== pw2) return setErr('The two passwords do not match.');
    setBusy(true);
    setErr('');
    try {
      await API.post('/api/auth/reset', {
        token,
        password: pw
      });
      setDone(true);
    } catch (x) {
      setErr(x.message);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };
  return React.createElement(AuthShell, {
    title: "Choose a new password",
    sub: "This link works once.",
    foot: React.createElement("button", {
      onClick: () => app.nav('/login'),
      className: "text-goldd font-semibold"
    }, "\u2190 Back to log in")
  }, app.apiMode !== 'server' || !token ? React.createElement("div", {
    className: "rounded-xl2 border border-line bg-cream/50 p-4 text-sm text-muted"
  }, "This reset link is incomplete. ", React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: () => app.nav('/forgot'),
    className: "text-goldd font-semibold underline"
  }, "Ask for a new one"), ".") : done ? React.createElement("div", {
    role: "status",
    className: "rounded-xl2 border border-sage/40 bg-sage/10 p-4 text-sm text-saged flex items-start gap-2"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "check",
    size: 16,
    className: "mt-0.5 shrink-0"
  }), "Your password has been changed. You can log in with it now.") : React.createElement("form", {
    onSubmit: submit,
    noValidate: true
  }, React.createElement(Field, {
    label: "New password",
    type: "password",
    value: pw,
    onChange: v => {
      setPw(v);
      setErr('');
    },
    icon: "lock",
    name: "new-password",
    autoComplete: "new-password"
  }), React.createElement(Field, {
    label: "Repeat it",
    type: "password",
    value: pw2,
    onChange: v => {
      setPw2(v);
      setErr('');
    },
    icon: "lock",
    name: "confirm-password",
    autoComplete: "new-password"
  }), React.createElement(FormError, {
    msg: err
  }), React.createElement("button", {
    type: "submit",
    disabled: busy,
    className: "btn btn-primary w-full px-5 py-3 text-sm"
  }, busy ? 'Saving…' : 'Save new password')));
}

  const [tick, setTick] = useState(0);

  if (!ok) return React.createElement("div", {

  const data = LA.read();

  const accounts = (() => {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(__LS.getItem('lumera_accounts')) || {};
    } catch (e) {
      return {};
    }
  })();
  const DAY = 864e5;
  const startToday = new Date();

  const activeToday = sessions.filter(s => s.start >= startToday.getTime()).length;
  const durations = sessions.map(s => Math.max(0, (s.end || s.start) - s.start));
  const avgMs = durations.length ? sum(durations) / durations.length : 0;
  const fmtDur = ms => `${Math.floor(ms / 60000)}m ${Math.round(ms % 60000 / 1000)}s`;
  const labelOf = p => ({
    '/dashboard': 'Dashboard',

    '/globe': 'Global Markets',
    '/world': 'World Monitor',
    '/learn': 'Learn',
    '/resources': 'Knowledge Hub',
    '/twin': 'Twin',
    '/emergency': 'Emergency',
    '/settings': 'Settings',
    '/': 'Landing'
  })[p] || p || '-';
  const viewCounts = {};
  views.forEach(v => {
    const k = labelOf(v.path);
    viewCounts[k] = (viewCounts[k] || 0) + 1;
  });
  const feats = Object.entries(viewCounts).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 8);
  const maxFeat = Math.max(1, ...feats.map(f => f[1]));
  const days = [];
  for (let i = 9; i >= 0; i--) {
    const d0 = new Date();
    d0.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    d0.setDate(d0.getDate() - i);
    const a = d0.getTime();
    days.push(sessions.filter(s => s.start >= a && s.start < a + DAY).length);
  }
  const breakdown = key => {
    const m = {};
    sessions.forEach(s => {
      const v = s[key] || '-';
      m[v] = (m[v] || 0) + 1;
    });
    const tot = sessions.length || 1;
    return Object.entries(m).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).map(([k, v]) => [k, Math.round(v / tot * 100)]);
  };
  const langB = breakdown('lang');
  const curB = breakdown('cur');
  const recent = events.slice(-14).reverse();
  const langName = c => ({
    en: 'English',
    ar: 'Arabic',
    ur: 'Urdu',
    hi: 'Hindi',
    fr: 'French',
    es: 'Spanish',
    de: 'German'
  })[c] || c;
  const kpis = [['Total sessions', sessions.length], ['Accounts', accountCount], ['Active today', activeToday], ['Page views', views.length], ['Avg session', fmtDur(avgMs)], ['Guest sessions', guests]];
  const exportJSON = () => {
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify({
      sessions,
      events,
      accounts: Object.keys(accounts)
    }, null, 2)], {
      type: 'application/json'
    });
    const u = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = u;
    a.download = 'lumera-analytics.json';
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(u);
  };
  const clearData = () => {
    if (window.confirm('Clear all locally-tracked analytics?')) {
      __LS.removeItem('lumera_analytics');
      setTick(t => t + 1);
    }
  };
  return React.createElement(AppShell, null, React.createElement(PageHead, {
    eyebrow: "Developer analytics \xB7 admin",
    title: "Live product metrics.",
    desc: "Real usage tracked from this browser, updating live. For aggregated data across all users and devices, connect PostHog / GA4, see INTEGRATION.md Step 3.",
    action: React.createElement("div", {
      className: "flex gap-2"
    }, React.createElement(Btn, {
      variant: "ghost",
      icon: "download",
      onClick: exportJSON
    }, "Export"), React.createElement(Btn, {
      variant: "ghost",
      onClick: clearData
    }, "Clear"))
  }), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "mb-4 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-sage",
    style: {
      animation: 'pulse-ring 1.6s infinite'
    }
  }), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-saged font-medium"
  }, "Live"), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-faint"
  }, "\xB7 auto-refreshing every 3s \xB7 ", new Date().toLocaleTimeString())), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3 mb-4"
  }, kpis.map(([l, v]) => React.createElement(Card, {
    key: l,
    hover: false,
    className: "!p-4"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-xs text-muted"
  }, l), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "font-serif text-2xl text-charcoal tnum mt-0.5"
  }, v)))), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-4"
  }, React.createElement(Card, {
    className: "lg:col-span-2"
  }, React.createElement(Eyebrow, {
    className: "mb-2"
  }, "Sessions \xB7 last 10 days"), sum(days) > 0 ? React.createElement(LineChart, {
    data: days,
    color: COLORS.gold
  }) : React.createElement(Empty, {
    icon: "gauge",
    title: "No data yet",
    desc: "Browse a few sections, your real metrics appear here live."
  })), React.createElement(Card, null, React.createElement(Eyebrow, {
    className: "mb-3"
  }, "Feature usage"), feats.length ? React.createElement("div", {
    className: "space-y-2.5"
  }, feats.map(([l, v]) => React.createElement(HBar, {
    key: l,
    l: l,
    v: Math.round(v / maxFeat * 100),
    color: COLORS.goldd,
    suffix: ""
  }))) : React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-sm text-faint"
  }, "No views yet."))), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4"
  }, React.createElement(Card, null, React.createElement(Eyebrow, {
    className: "mb-3"
  }, "By language"), langB.length ? React.createElement("div", {

  }, langB.map(([k, v]) => React.createElement(HBar, {
    key: k,
    l: langName(k),
    v: v,
    color: COLORS.sky
  }))) : React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-sm text-faint"
  }, "-")), React.createElement(Card, null, React.createElement(Eyebrow, {
    className: "mb-3"
  }, "By currency"), curB.length ? React.createElement("div", {

  }, curB.map(([k, v]) => React.createElement(HBar, {
    key: k,

  }))) : React.createElement("div", {

  }, "-")), React.createElement(Card, null, React.createElement(Eyebrow, {
    className: "mb-3"
  }, "Recent activity"), React.createElement("div", {

  }, recent.length ? recent.map((e, i) => React.createElement("div", {

  })), React.createElement("span", {

  }, e.type, e.path ? ` · ${labelOf(e.path)}` : '', e.lang ? ` · ${e.lang}` : '', e.cur ? ` · ${e.cur}` : ''))) : React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-faint"
  }, "No events yet.")))), React.createElement("p", {
    className: "text-[11px] text-faint mt-4 leading-relaxed"
  }, "Counted in this browser only: pages opened here, nothing from other people or devices. Account, community and report figures for every member are on the admin portal\u2019s Overview when the Lumera server is running."));

function DailyCheckIn() {
  const app = useApp();
  const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const already = app.profile.lastCheckin === today;
  const [claimed, setClaimed] = useState(false);
  const [snoozed, setSnoozed] = useState(() => {
    try {
      return __LS.getItem('lumera_streak_snooze') === today;
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  });
  const [leaving, setLeaving] = useState(false);
  const dismiss = () => {
    setLeaving(true);
    try {
      __LS.setItem('lumera_streak_snooze', today);
    } catch (e) {}
    setTimeout(() => setSnoozed(true), 260);
  };
  const [, bumpQ] = useReducer(x => x + 1, 0);
  useEffect(() => popupQueue.sub(bumpQ), []);
  if (already || snoozed || popupQueue.active === 'guide') return null;
  const streak = app.profile.streak || 0;
  const shown = claimed ? streak : streak + 1;
  const tier = nextTier(claimed ? streak : streak);
  const toGo = Math.max(0, tier.at - shown);
  const claim = () => {
    app.checkIn();
    if (app.awardXp) app.awardXp(10);
    setClaimed(true);
    try {
      __LS.setItem('lumera_streak_snooze', today);
    } catch (e) {}
    setTimeout(() => dismiss(), 2600);
  };
  return React.createElement("div", {
    className: cx('mb-4', leaving ? 'anim-fadeOut' : 'anim-fadeUp'),
    role: "status"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "streak-chip flex items-center gap-2.5 pl-3.5 pr-1.5 py-1.5"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-lg leading-none",
    "aria-hidden": "true"
  }, claimed ? '🎉' : '🔥'), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "min-w-0 flex-1 leading-tight"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-[13px] font-semibold text-white tnum whitespace-nowrap"
  }, shown, "-day streak", claimed ? ' secured' : ''), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-[11px] streak-sub truncate"
  }, toGo === 0 ? `${tier.label} unlocked` : `${toGo} to ${tier.label} · +${tier.xp} XP`)), !claimed && React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: claim,
    className: "btn btn-gold streak-claim px-3.5 text-[12.5px] shrink-0"
  }, "Claim +10 XP"), React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: dismiss,
    className: "streak-x grid place-items-center rounded-full shrink-0",
    "aria-label": "Dismiss streak reminder"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "x",
    size: 14
  }))));
}
function WhatsNewPopup() {
  const app = useApp();
  const items = (() => {
    try {
      const u = JSON.parse(__LS.getItem('lumera_updates'));
      return Array.isArray(u) && u.length ? u : UPDATES_SEED;
    } catch (e) {
      return UPDATES_SEED;
    }
  })();
  const stamp = items.length ? String(items[0].title || '') + String(items[0].date || '') : 'none';
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      if (!__LS.getItem('lumera_guide_tut_done')) {
        __LS.setItem('lumera_seen_update', stamp);
        return;
      }
      if (__LS.getItem('lumera_seen_update') !== stamp) setOpen(true);
    } catch (e) {}
  }, [stamp]);
  const myTurn = usePopupSlot('whatsnew', open && items.length > 0);
  const close = () => {
    try {
      __LS.setItem('lumera_seen_update', stamp);
    } catch (e) {}
    setOpen(false);
  };
  if (!myTurn) return null;
  return React.createElement("div", {
    className: "fixed inset-0 z-[160] grid place-items-center p-4"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "absolute inset-0 bg-charcoal/50",
    onClick: close
  }), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "relative w-full max-w-lg lux-card !p-6 anim-scaleIn max-h-[80vh] overflow-y-auto"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-start justify-between"
  }, React.createElement("div", null, React.createElement(Eyebrow, null, "What\u2019s new"), React.createElement("h3", {
    className: "font-serif text-2xl text-charcoal mt-1"
  }, "Fresh in Lumera")), React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: close,
    className: "grid place-items-center h-8 w-8 rounded-lg hover:bg-sand"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "x"
  }))), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "space-y-3 mt-4"
  }, items.slice(0, 4).map((u, i) => {
    const live = /live|now|shipped/i.test(u.tag || '');
    return React.createElement("div", {
      key: i,
      className: "flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl2 border border-line p-3"
    }, React.createElement("span", {
      className: cx('grid place-items-center h-9 w-9 rounded-xl shrink-0', live ? 'bg-sage/15 text-saged' : 'bg-gold/12 text-goldd')
    }, React.createElement(Icon, {
      name: live ? 'check' : 'spark',
      size: 16
    })), React.createElement("div", null, React.createElement("div", {
      className: "flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap"
    }, React.createElement("span", {
      className: "font-medium text-charcoal"
    }, u.title), React.createElement(Pill, {
      tone: live ? 'sage' : 'gold'
    }, u.tag)), React.createElement("p", {
      className: "text-sm text-muted mt-0.5 leading-relaxed"
    }, u.body)));
  })), React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: close,
    className: "btn btn-primary w-full mt-5 py-2.5 text-sm"
  }, "Got it")));
}
function Updates() {
  const [, bump] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const bc = new BroadcastChannel('lumera_updates');
      bc.onmessage = () => bump(x => x + 1);
      return () => bc.close();
    } catch (e) {}
  }, []);
  const items = (() => {
    try {
      const u = JSON.parse(__LS.getItem('lumera_updates'));
      return Array.isArray(u) && u.length ? u : UPDATES_SEED;
    } catch (e) {
      return UPDATES_SEED;
    }
  })();
  const live = t => /live|now|shipped/i.test(t || '');
  return React.createElement(AppShell, null, React.createElement(PageHead, {
    eyebrow: "What\u2019s new",
    title: "Updates & roadmap.",
    desc: "What we\u2019ve just shipped and what\u2019s coming next for Lumera."
  }), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "space-y-3"
  }, items.map((u, i) => React.createElement(Card, {
    key: i,
    className: "flex items-start gap-4"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: cx('grid place-items-center h-10 w-10 rounded-xl shrink-0', live(u.tag) ? 'bg-sage/15 text-saged' : 'bg-gold/12 text-goldd')
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: live(u.tag) ? 'check' : 'spark',
    size: 18
  })), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex-1 min-w-0"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap"
  }, React.createElement("h3", {
    className: "font-serif text-lg text-charcoal"
  }, u.title), React.createElement(Pill, {
    tone: live(u.tag) ? 'sage' : 'gold'
  }, u.tag), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-[11px] text-faint"
  }, u.date)), React.createElement("p", {
    className: "text-sm text-muted mt-1 leading-relaxed"
  }, u.body))))), React.createElement("p", {
    className: "text-[11px] text-faint mt-3"
  }, "Published from the admin portal and shown here automatically."));
}

  },

Use it before taxable investing.'], ['Low-cost index funds', 'A globally diversified, low-fee index portfolio is the simplest reliable engine for long-term growth.'], ['Emergency fund first', 'Keep 3–6 months of essentials in cash so you never have to sell investments at the wrong time.']]
  }

function Retirement() {
  const app = useApp();
  const fmt = app.fmt;
  const m = app.metrics;
  const baseAge = (() => {
    const mt = (app.profile.ageBracket || '').match(/\d+/);
    return mt ? clamp(Number(mt[0]) + 3, 18, 70) : 30;
  })();
  const [age, setAge] = useState(baseAge);
  const [retire, setRetire] = useState(Math.max(baseAge + 5, 65));
  const [pot, setPot] = useState(Math.round(app.balances.investmentsBal || 0));
  const [contrib, setContrib] = useState(Math.max(200, Math.round((m.realistic || 0) * 0.5 + (m.savingsTotal || 0) * 0.4)));
  const [ret, setRet] = useState(6);
  const [infl, setInfl] = useState(2.5);
  const [income, setIncome] = useState(Math.max(1500, Math.round((m.income || 6000) * 0.7)));
  const years = Math.max(1, retire - age);
  const series = fvYearly(contrib, years, ret / 100, pot);
  const nest = series[series.length - 1];
  const realFactor = Math.pow(1 + infl / 100, years);
  const nestReal = nest / realFactor;
  const sustainableAnnual = nest * 0.04;
  const targetAtRet = income * 12 * realFactor;
  const neededPot = targetAtRet / 0.04;
  const fundedPct = clamp(sustainableAnnual / (targetAtRet || 1) * 100, 0, 200);
  const r = ret / 100 / 12,
    N = years * 12,
    growthFactor = Math.pow(1 + r, N);
  const annuity = r > 0 ? (growthFactor - 1) / r : N;
  const requiredContrib = Math.max(0, (neededPot - pot * growthFactor) / (annuity || 1));
  const onTrack = fundedPct >= 100;
  const acct = RET_ACCOUNTS[app.profile.region] || RET_ACCOUNTS.default;
  const chartData = series.filter((_, i) => i % Math.max(1, Math.ceil(years / 40)) === 0 || i === series.length - 1);
  return React.createElement(AppShell, null, React.createElement(PageHead, {
    eyebrow: "Retirement planning centre",
    title: "Will your future self be free?",
    desc: "Project your retirement pot, see it in today\u2019s money, and find out exactly what to change to close any gap. Educational, not a forecast.",
    action: React.createElement(Pill, {
      tone: onTrack ? 'sage' : 'gold'
    }, onTrack ? 'On track' : 'Needs attention')
  }), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-4"
  }, React.createElement(Card, {
    className: "lg:col-span-1 flex flex-col items-center text-center"
  }, React.createElement(ScoreRing, {
    value: Math.min(100, fundedPct),
    size: 150,
    stroke: 13,
    label: "funded",
    color: onTrack ? COLORS.sage : COLORS.gold
  }), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "mt-3"
  }, React.createElement(Eyebrow, {
    className: "mb-1"
  }, "Projected pot at ", retire), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "font-serif text-3xl text-charcoal tnum"
  }, React.createElement(AnimatedNumber, {
    value: Math.round(nest),
    money: true
  })), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-xs text-muted mt-1"
  }, "\u2248 ", React.createElement("b", {
    className: "text-charcoal/80"
  }, fmt.money(Math.round(nestReal))), " in today\u2019s money")), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "mt-3 w-full grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-left"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "rounded-xl border border-line bg-cream/60 p-3"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-[11px] text-faint"
  }, "Sustainable income"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "tnum text-sm font-semibold text-charcoal"
  }, fmt.money(Math.round(sustainableAnnual / 12)), "/mo"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-[10px] text-faint"
  }, "4% rule \xB7 today \u2248 ", fmt.money(Math.round(sustainableAnnual / 12 / realFactor)), "/mo")), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "rounded-xl border border-line bg-cream/60 p-3"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-[11px] text-faint"
  }, "Years to grow"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "tnum text-sm font-semibold text-charcoal"
  }, years, " yrs"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-[10px] text-faint"
  }, "age ", age, " \u2192 ", retire)))), React.createElement(Card, {
    className: "lg:col-span-2"
  }, React.createElement(Eyebrow, {
    className: "mb-3"
  }, "Your retirement plan"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-x-6 gap-y-3"
  }, React.createElement(LuxSlider, {
    label: "Current age",
    value: age,
    min: 18,
    max: 70,
    step: 1,
    onChange: v => {
      setAge(v);
      if (retire <= v) setRetire(v + 1);
    },
    fmt: v => v + ' yrs'
  }), React.createElement(LuxSlider, {
    label: "Retirement age",
    value: retire,
    min: age + 1,
    max: 80,
    step: 1,
    onChange: setRetire,
    fmt: v => v + ' yrs'
  }), React.createElement(NumberField, {
    id: "pot",
    label: "Saved so far (pension/investments)",
    value: pot,

  }), React.createElement(NumberField, {
    id: "contrib",

    value: contrib,
    onChange: (k, v) => setContrib(v)
  }), React.createElement(LuxSlider, {
    label: "Expected annual return",

    min: 1,

    onChange: setRet,

    className: "mb-4"

    text: "Assumes your monthly contribution continues and grows at your chosen return. Real markets vary year to year."
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "info",
    size: 16,
    className: "text-faint"
  }))), React.createElement(LineChart, {
    data: chartData,
    color: onTrack ? COLORS.sage : COLORS.gold
  }), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex justify-between text-[11px] text-faint mt-1"
  }, React.createElement("span", null, "Age ", age), React.createElement("span", null, "Age ", Math.round((age + retire) / 2)), React.createElement("span", null, "Age ", retire))), (() => {
    const fv = (months, monthly, start) => {
      const rr = ret / 100 / 12;
      const g = Math.pow(1 + rr, months);
      return start * g + (rr > 0 ? monthly * ((g - 1) / rr) : monthly * months);
    };
    const marks = [];
    for (let a = Math.ceil(age / 10) * 10; a < retire; a += 10) marks.push(a);
    marks.push(retire);
    let coastAge = null;
    for (let a = age; a <= retire; a++) {
      const potThen = fv((a - age) * 12, contrib, pot);
      if (potThen * Math.pow(1 + ret / 100, retire - a) >= neededPot) {
        coastAge = a;
        break;
      }
    }
    const levers = [{
      l: 'Add 100 a month',
      v: fv(years * 12, contrib + 100, pot) - nest,
      note: 'The cheapest lever most people have.'
    }, {
      l: 'Work 2 more years',
      v: fv((years + 2) * 12, contrib, pot) - nest,
      note: 'Two extra years of both contributions and compounding.'
    }, {
      l: 'One better percent',
      v: (() => {
        const rr = (ret + 1) / 100 / 12,
          g = Math.pow(1 + rr, years * 12);
        return pot * g + (rr > 0 ? contrib * ((g - 1) / rr) : 0) - nest;
      })(),
      note: 'Often just a lower-fee fund.'
    }];
    const drawdown = [3, 4, 5].map(rate => {
      let bal = nest,
        yrs = 0,
        take = nest * rate / 100;
      while (bal > 0 && yrs < 60) {
        bal = bal * (1 + ret / 100) - take;
        take *= 1 + infl / 100;
        yrs++;
      }
      return [rate, yrs >= 60 ? '60+' : yrs];
    });
    return React.createElement(Fragment, null, React.createElement("div", {
      className: "grid lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-4"
    }, React.createElement(Card, {
      hover: false,
      className: "lg:col-span-2"
    }, React.createElement(Eyebrow, {
      className: "mb-3"
    }, "Milestones on the way"), React.createElement("div", {
      className: "space-y-2.5"
    }, marks.map(a => {
      const v = fv((a - age) * 12, contrib, pot);
      const pctOf = clamp(v / (neededPot || 1) * 100, 0, 100);
      return React.createElement("div", {
        key: a,
        className: "flex items-center gap-3"
      }, React.createElement("span", {
        className: "grid place-items-center h-9 w-9 rounded-xl text-[11px] font-bold shrink-0 tnum",
        style: {
          background: 'rgba(109,40,217,.12)',
          color: '#7C3AED'
        }
      }, a), React.createElement("div", {
        className: "flex-1 min-w-0"
      }, React.createElement("div", {
        className: "flex items-baseline justify-between gap-2"
      }, React.createElement("span", {
        className: "text-[12px] text-muted"
      }, "Age ", a, a === retire ? ' · retirement' : ''), React.createElement("span", {
        className: "tnum text-sm font-semibold text-charcoal"
      }, fmt.money(Math.round(v)))), React.createElement("div", {
        className: "h-1.5 rounded-full bg-sand mt-1 overflow-hidden"
      }, React.createElement("div", {
        className: "h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-700",
        style: {
          width: Math.max(2, pctOf) + '%',
          background: pctOf >= 100 ? '#16A34A' : '#7C3AED'
        }
      }))));
    })), coastAge && coastAge < retire && React.createElement("div", {
      className: "mt-4 rounded-xl2 px-3.5 py-3 text-[13px] leading-relaxed flex items-start gap-2",
      style: {
        background: 'rgba(22,163,74,.10)',
        border: '1px solid rgba(22,163,74,.28)'
      }
    }, React.createElement(Icon, {
      name: "spark",
      size: 14,
      className: "text-saged mt-0.5 shrink-0"
    }), React.createElement("span", {
      className: "text-charcoal/85"
    }, "At this rate you reach ", React.createElement("b", null, "coast point at ", coastAge), ". From then you could stop contributing entirely and still land on your target, because growth alone carries the rest."))), React.createElement(Card, {
      hover: false
    }, React.createElement(Eyebrow, {
      className: "mb-1"
    }, "How long it lasts"), React.createElement("p", {
      className: "text-xs text-muted mb-3"
    }, "Drawing this share from day one, rising with inflation each year, with the rest still invested."), React.createElement("div", {
      className: "space-y-2"
    }, drawdown.map(([rate, yrs]) => {
      const tone = rate <= 3 ? '#16A34A' : rate === 4 ? '#D97706' : '#DC2626';
      return React.createElement("div", {
        key: rate,
        className: "rounded-xl2 border border-line p-3"

    })))), React.createElement(Card, {
      hover: false,
      className: "mb-4"
    }, React.createElement(Eyebrow, {
      className: "mb-1"
    }, "What each change is actually worth"), React.createElement("p", {

    }, "Measured against your current plan, at retirement."), React.createElement("div", {
      className: "grid sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3"
    }, levers.map(x => React.createElement("div", {
      key: x.l,
      className: "rounded-xl2 border border-line p-4"
    }, React.createElement("div", {
      className: "text-sm font-semibold text-charcoal"
    }, x.l), React.createElement("div", {
      className: "font-serif text-2xl tnum mt-1",
      style: {
        color: '#16A34A'
      }
    }, "+", fmt.money(Math.round(Math.max(0, x.v)))), React.createElement("div", {
      className: "text-[11px] text-faint mt-1 leading-snug"
    }, x.note))))));
  })(), React.createElement(Card, {
    hover: false,
    className: "mb-4",
    style: {
      background: 'linear-gradient(135deg,#6D28D9,#4F46E5)',
      border: 'none',
      color: '#fff'
    }
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-start gap-3"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "grid place-items-center h-10 w-10 rounded-xl shrink-0",
    style: {
      background: 'rgba(255,255,255,.18)',
      color: '#fff'
    }
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "spark",
    size: 18
  })), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex-1"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "font-serif text-lg"
  }, onTrack ? 'You’re on track for the lifestyle you set.' : 'There’s a gap, but it’s closable.'), React.createElement("p", {
    className: "text-sm mt-1 leading-relaxed",
    style: {
      color: 'rgba(255,255,255,.85)'
    }
  }, onTrack ? `At ${fmt.money(contrib)}/mo your pot reaches about ${fmt.money(Math.round(nest))} by ${retire}, supporting roughly ${fmt.money(Math.round(sustainableAnnual / 12))}/mo, more than your ${fmt.money(income)}/mo target (in tomorrow’s money). Consider retiring earlier or raising your target.` : `Your target needs a pot of about ${fmt.money(Math.round(neededPot))}. To get there, raise contributions to about ${fmt.money(Math.round(requiredContrib))}/mo, or delay retirement, or trim the target. Small increases now compound enormously.`), !onTrack && requiredContrib > contrib && React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: () => setContrib(Math.round(requiredContrib)),
    className: "btn btn-gold mt-3 px-3 py-2 text-xs"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {

  }), "Set contribution to ", fmt.money(Math.round(requiredContrib)), "/mo")))), React.createElement(Card, null, React.createElement(Eyebrow, {
    className: "mb-1"
  }, "Tax-efficient retirement accounts \xB7 ", acct.label), React.createElement("p", {

  }, acct.items.map(([n, d]) => React.createElement("div", {

  }, [['Investor.gov, Retirement', 'https://www.investor.gov/additional-resources/retirement-toolkit'], ['Bogleheads, Retirement', 'https://www.bogleheads.org/wiki/Retirement'], ['OECD, Pensions', 'https://www.oecd.org/en/topics/pensions.html']].map(([n, u]) => React.createElement("a", {

  })))), React.createElement("div", {

  }))));
}

function hashStr(s) {
  let h = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) h = h * 31 + s.charCodeAt(i) >>> 0;
  return h;
}
function MiniSpark({
  seed,
  up,
  color = '#6E8B6A',
  h = 36
}) {
  const W = 140,
    n = 22;
  const pts = [];
  let v = 50;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const r = hashStr(seed + '_' + i) % 100 / 100 - 0.5;
    v += r * 9 + (up ? 0.7 : -0.7);
    pts.push(v);
  }
  const min = Math.min(...pts),
    max = Math.max(...pts),
    rng = max - min || 1;
  const X = i => i / (n - 1) * W,
    Y = p => h - 3 - (p - min) / rng * (h - 6);
  const d = pts.map((p, i) => `${i ? 'L' : 'M'}${X(i).toFixed(1)},${Y(p).toFixed(1)}`).join(' ');
  return React.createElement("svg", {
    viewBox: `0 0 ${W} ${h}`,
    width: "100%",
    height: h,
    preserveAspectRatio: "none",
    style: {
      display: 'block'
    }
  }, React.createElement("path", {
    d: `${d} L${W},${h} L0,${h} Z`,
    fill: color,
    opacity: ".12"
  }), React.createElement("path", {
    d: d,
    fill: "none",
    stroke: color,
    strokeWidth: "2",
    strokeLinecap: "round",
    strokeLinejoin: "round"
  }));
}

    }
  }), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "mt-3 rounded-xl2 bg-sand/60 p-3 text-sm text-charcoal/85 leading-relaxed"
  }, "That is ", React.createElement("b", {
    className: "tnum"
  }, pct.toExponential(2), "%"), " of the company. Tiny, and that is the point: you are a real owner, entitled to your slice of the profits, without needing to run anything."));
}
function BookDemo() {
  const [tick, setTick] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setInterval(() => setTick(x => x + 1), 1400);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, []);
  const jitter = (n, i) => n + (hashStr('b' + tick + i) % 7 - 3) / 100;
  const bids = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(i => ({
    p: jitter(228.38 - i * 0.02, i),
    q: 120 + hashStr('q' + tick + i) % 9 * 40
  }));
  const asks = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(i => ({
    p: jitter(228.44 + i * 0.02, i + 9),
    q: 120 + hashStr('a' + tick + i) % 9 * 40
  }));
  const spread = asks[0].p - bids[0].p;
  return React.createElement("div", null, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid grid-cols-2 gap-3"
  }, [['Buyers (bids)', bids, '#16A34A'], ['Sellers (asks)', asks, '#DC2626']].map(([label, rows, col]) => React.createElement("div", {
    key: label
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-faint mb-1.5"
  }, label), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "space-y-1"
  }, rows.map((r, i) => React.createElement("div", {
    key: i,
    className: "relative rounded-md overflow-hidden"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "absolute inset-y-0 left-0 transition-all duration-700",
    style: {
      width: Math.min(100, r.q / 6) + '%',
      background: col,
      opacity: .16
    }
  }), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "relative flex justify-between px-2 py-1 text-[11.5px] tnum"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    style: {
      color: col
    }
  }, r.p.toFixed(2)), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-faint"
  }, r.q)))))))), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "mt-3 rounded-xl2 bg-sand/60 p-3 text-sm text-charcoal/85 leading-relaxed"
  }, "Nobody sets the price. Buyers bid up, sellers ask down, and a trade happens where they meet. The gap between the best bid and best ask is the ", React.createElement("b", null, "spread"), ", right now", React.createElement("b", {
    className: "tnum"
  }, " $", spread.toFixed(2)), ". Tighter spread = easier to trade."));
}
const BASKET = [['Apple', 3400], ['Microsoft', 3100], ['NVIDIA', 2900], ['Amazon', 1900], ['Alphabet', 1800], ['Meta', 1300]];
function IndexDemo() {
  const [inx, setInx] = useState(BASKET.map(() => true));
  const total = BASKET.reduce((a, b, i) => a + (inx[i] ? b[1] : 0), 0);
  const full = BASKET.reduce((a, b) => a + b[1], 0);
  return React.createElement("div", null, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex flex-wrap gap-2"
  }, BASKET.map(([n, cap], i) => React.createElement("button", {
    key: n,
    onClick: () => setInx(v => v.map((x, j) => j === i ? !x : x)),
    className: cx('chip', inx[i] && 'on')
  }, n, " ", React.createElement("span", {
    className: "tnum opacity-70"
  }, "$", (cap / 1000).toFixed(1), "T")))), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "mt-4 flex items-end justify-between"
  }, React.createElement("div", null, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-faint"
  }, "Basket value"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "font-serif text-3xl text-charcoal tnum"
  }, "$", (total / 1000).toFixed(1), "T")), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-right text-xs text-muted tnum"
  }, Math.round(total / full * 100), "% of the full basket")), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "h-3 rounded-full bg-sand mt-2 overflow-hidden"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-500 shimmer-bar",
    style: {
      width: Math.max(2, total / full * 100) + '%',
      background: 'linear-gradient(90deg,#3B82F6,#8B5CF6)'
    }
  })), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "mt-3 rounded-xl2 bg-sand/60 p-3 text-sm text-charcoal/85 leading-relaxed"
  }, "Drop the biggest names and the whole index barely resembles itself. That is why \"the market was up 1%\" usually means ", React.createElement("b", null, "a handful of giant companies"), " were up, not every company."));
}

function CycleDemo() {
  const [mood, setMood] = useState('bull');
  const bull = [0, 8, 5, 16, 12, 26, 22, 38, 34, 50, 58];
  const bear = [58, 50, 54, 40, 44, 30, 33, 20, 24, 10, 6];
  const pts = (mood === 'bull' ? bull : bear).map((v, i) => `${i * 30},${70 - v}`).join(' ');
  const col = mood === 'bull' ? '#16A34A' : '#DC2626';
  return React.createElement("div", null, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex gap-2 mb-3"
  }, [['bull', '🐂 Bull market'], ['bear', '🐻 Bear market']].map(([k, l]) => React.createElement("button", {
    key: k,
    onClick: () => setMood(k),
    className: cx('chip', mood === k && 'on')
  }, l))), React.createElement("svg", {
    viewBox: "0 0 300 80",
    className: "w-full h-28"
  }, React.createElement("polyline", {
    points: pts,
    fill: "none",
    stroke: col,
    strokeWidth: "3",
    strokeLinecap: "round",
    strokeLinejoin: "round"
  }), React.createElement("polyline", {
    points: `${pts} 300,80 0,80`,
    fill: col,
    opacity: ".12",
    stroke: "none"
  })), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "mt-1 rounded-xl2 bg-sand/60 p-3 text-sm text-charcoal/85 leading-relaxed"
  }, mood === 'bull' ? 'A sustained rise. Optimism feeds on itself and it feels like it will never stop, which is exactly when people overpay.' : 'A sustained fall of roughly 20% or more. It feels permanent, and it never is. Every bear market in history has been followed by a recovery.', ' ', "Both are normal. A long-term investor lives through many of each."));
}
function MoveDemo() {

  const short = [30, 44, 26, 52, 18, 48, 24, 56, 20, 42, 32];
  const long = [8, 12, 18, 22, 28, 31, 38, 44, 49, 56, 62];
  const pts = (horizon === 'short' ? short : long).map((v, i) => `${i * 30},${70 - v}`).join(' ');
  const col = horizon === 'short' ? '#D97706' : '#16A34A';
  return React.createElement("div", null, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex gap-2 mb-3"

    key: k,
    onClick: () => setHorizon(k),
    className: cx('chip', horizon === k && 'on')
  }, l))), React.createElement("svg", {
    viewBox: "0 0 300 80",
    className: "w-full h-28"
  }, React.createElement("polyline", {
    points: pts,

    stroke: col,
    strokeWidth: "3",
    strokeLinecap: "round",
    strokeLinejoin: "round"
  })), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "mt-1 rounded-xl2 bg-sand/60 p-3 text-sm text-charcoal/85 leading-relaxed"
  }, horizon === 'short' ? 'Over days, prices move on news, interest rates, geopolitics and mood. Much of it is noise, and none of it is predictable.' : 'Over years, prices follow earnings and cash flow. The line smooths out. This is the whole argument for time in the market over timing it.'));
}
