function StockMarketsEdu() {
  const app = useApp();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState('own');
  const [learned, setLearned] = useState(() => {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(__LS.getItem(MKT_KEY)) || {};
    } catch (e) {
      return {};
    }
  });
  const mark = id => {
    const next = {
      ...learned,
      [id]: !learned[id]
    };
    setLearned(next);
    try {
      __LS.setItem(MKT_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
    } catch (e) {}
    if (!learned[id] && app.awardXp) app.awardXp(5, true);
  };
  const doneN = MKT_STOPS.filter(s => learned[s.id]).length;
  const pct = Math.round(doneN / MKT_STOPS.length * 100);
  const chapters = [...new Set(MKT_STOPS.map(s => s.ch))];
  return React.createElement(AppShell, null, React.createElement(PageHead, {
    eyebrow: "Markets education",
    title: "How the stock market actually works.",
    desc: "Nine short stops, most of them things you can poke at rather than read. Work through them in any order."
  }), React.createElement(Card, {
    hover: false,
    className: "mb-5"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-center gap-4 flex-wrap"
  }, React.createElement(ScoreRing, {
    value: pct,
    size: 76,
    stroke: 8,
    label: "done",
    color: "#3B82F6"
  }), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex-1 min-w-[200px]"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "font-serif text-xl text-charcoal"
  }, doneN, " of ", MKT_STOPS.length, " stops"), React.createElement("p", {
    className: "text-sm text-muted mt-0.5"
  }, pct === 100 ? 'You have the whole map. Nothing on the markets pages should read as jargon now.' : 'Tick a stop when it clicks. Five XP each.')), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex flex-wrap gap-1.5"
  }, MKT_STOPS.map(st => React.createElement("button", {
    key: st.id,
    onClick: () => setOpen(st.id),
    title: st.title,
    className: "h-8 w-8 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold tnum transition-all",
    style: learned[st.id] ? {
      background: '#3B82F6',
      color: '#fff'
    } : open === st.id ? {
      background: 'rgb(var(--c-sand))',
      color: 'rgb(var(--c-charcoal))',
      outline: '2px solid #3B82F6'
    } : {
      background: 'rgb(var(--c-sand))',
      color: 'rgb(var(--c-faint))'
    }
  }, st.n))))), chapters.map((ch, ci) => React.createElement("div", {
    key: ch,
    className: "mb-5"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-center gap-3 mb-3"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "grid place-items-center h-7 w-7 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold text-white",
    style: {
      background: ['#3B82F6', '#8B5CF6', '#16A34A'][ci]
    }
  }, ci + 1), React.createElement("h2", {
    className: "font-serif text-xl text-charcoal"
  }, ch), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "h-px flex-1 bg-line"
  })), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "space-y-3"
  }, MKT_STOPS.filter(s => s.ch === ch).map(st => {
    const isOpen = open === st.id;
    const hue = ['#3B82F6', '#8B5CF6', '#16A34A'][ci];
    return React.createElement("div", {
      key: st.id,
      className: "lux-card !p-0 overflow-hidden transition-all",
      style: {
        borderColor: isOpen ? hue + '66' : undefined
      }
    }, React.createElement("button", {
      onClick: () => setOpen(isOpen ? null : st.id),
      className: "w-full flex items-center gap-3 p-4 text-left hover:bg-sand/40 transition"
    }, React.createElement("span", {
      className: "grid place-items-center h-11 w-11 rounded-xl2 text-xl shrink-0",
      style: {
        background: learned[st.id] ? hue : hue + '14',
        color: learned[st.id] ? '#fff' : hue
      }

const ABOUT_KEY = 'lumera_about';
function loadAbout() {
  try {
    const a = JSON.parse(__LS.getItem(ABOUT_KEY));
    if (a && typeof a === 'object') return a;
  } catch (e) {}
  return {};
}
function useAbout() {
  const [about, setAbout] = useState(loadAbout);
  useEffect(() => {
    const h = e => {
      if (!e || e.key === ABOUT_KEY) setAbout(loadAbout());
    };
    window.addEventListener('storage', h);
    let bc;
    try {
      bc = new BroadcastChannel(ABOUT_KEY);
      bc.onmessage = () => setAbout(loadAbout());
    } catch (e) {}
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('storage', h);
      try {
        bc && bc.close();
      } catch (e) {}
    };
  }, []);
  return about;
}

function WorldGlobe({
  cities,
  selected,
  onSelect,
  lit,
  regionOf
}) {
  const R = 150,
    cx = 160,
    cy = 160;
  const [rot, setRot] = useState(70);
  const [tiltDeg, setTiltDeg] = useState(18);
  const drag = useRef(null);
  const auto = useRef(true);
  const raf = useRef(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const step = () => {
      if (auto.current) setRot(r => (r + 0.18) % 360);
      raf.current = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    };
    raf.current = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf.current);
  }, []);
  const tilt = tiltDeg * Math.PI / 180;
  const project = (lat, lon) => {
    const l = (lon - rot) * Math.PI / 180,
      p = lat * Math.PI / 180;
    const cosc = Math.sin(tilt) * Math.sin(p) + Math.cos(tilt) * Math.cos(p) * Math.cos(l);
    const x = Math.cos(p) * Math.sin(l);
    const y = Math.cos(tilt) * Math.sin(p) - Math.sin(tilt) * Math.cos(p) * Math.cos(l);
    return {
      x: cx + R * x,
      y: cy - R * y,
      vis: cosc > 0
    };
  };
  const grat = [];
  const pushSegs = pts => {
    let seg = [];
    pts.forEach(q => {
      if (q.vis) seg.push(`${q.x.toFixed(1)},${q.y.toFixed(1)}`);else {
        if (seg.length > 1) grat.push(seg.join(' '));
        seg = [];
      }
    });
    if (seg.length > 1) grat.push(seg.join(' '));
  };
  for (let lon = -180; lon < 180; lon += 30) {
    const pts = [];
    for (let lat = -90; lat <= 90; lat += 6) pts.push(project(lat, lon));
    pushSegs(pts);
  }
  for (let lat = -60; lat <= 60; lat += 30) {
    const pts = [];
    for (let lon = -180; lon <= 180; lon += 6) pts.push(project(lat, lon));
    pushSegs(pts);
  }
  const land = [];
  LANDMASSES.forEach(ring => {
    let seg = [];
    ring.forEach(([lon, lat]) => {
      const q = project(lat, lon);
      if (q.vis) seg.push(`${q.x.toFixed(1)},${q.y.toFixed(1)}`);else {
        if (seg.length > 2) land.push(seg.join(' '));
        seg = [];
      }
    });
    if (seg.length > 2) land.push(seg.join(' '));
  });
  const pt = e => ({
    x: e.clientX ?? e.touches?.[0]?.clientX,
    y: e.clientY ?? e.touches?.[0]?.clientY
  });
  const down = e => {
    auto.current = false;
    const p = pt(e);
    drag.current = {
      x: p.x,
      y: p.y,
      r: rot,
      t: tiltDeg
    };
  };
  const move = e => {
    if (!drag.current) return;
    const p = pt(e);
    setRot((drag.current.r - (p.x - drag.current.x) * 0.5 + 360) % 360);
    setTiltDeg(clamp(drag.current.t + (p.y - drag.current.y) * 0.4, -75, 75));
  };
  const up = () => {
    drag.current = null;
  };
  useEffect(() => {
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', move);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', up);
    window.addEventListener('touchmove', move);
    window.addEventListener('touchend', up);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', move);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', up);
      window.removeEventListener('touchmove', move);
      window.removeEventListener('touchend', up);
    };
  });
  return React.createElement("div", {
    className: "relative select-none",
    style: {
      touchAction: 'none'
    }
  }, React.createElement("svg", {
    viewBox: "0 0 320 320",
    width: "100%",
    style: {
      maxWidth: 400,
      margin: '0 auto',
      display: 'block',
      cursor: 'grab'
    },
    onMouseDown: down,
    onTouchStart: down
  }, React.createElement("defs", null, React.createElement("radialGradient", {
    id: "ocean",
    cx: "36%",
    cy: "30%",
    r: "78%"
  }, React.createElement("stop", {
    offset: "0%",
    stopColor: "#1E3A8A"
  }), React.createElement("stop", {
    offset: "55%",
    stopColor: "#12275E"
  }), React.createElement("stop", {
    offset: "100%",
    stopColor: "#060B1C"
  })), React.createElement("radialGradient", {
    id: "atmo",
    cx: "50%",
    cy: "50%",
    r: "50%"
  }, React.createElement("stop", {
    offset: "82%",
    stopColor: "rgba(56,189,248,0)"
  }), React.createElement("stop", {
    offset: "100%",
    stopColor: "rgba(56,189,248,.45)"
  }))), React.createElement("circle", {
    cx: cx,
    cy: cy,
    r: R + 9,
    fill: "url(#atmo)"
  }), React.createElement("circle", {
    cx: cx,
    cy: cy,
    r: R,
    fill: "url(#ocean)"
  }), grat.map((d, i) => React.createElement("polyline", {
    key: 'g' + i,
    points: d,
    fill: "none",
    stroke: "#7DD3FC",
    strokeWidth: ".6",
    opacity: ".22"
  })), land.map((d, i) => React.createElement("polyline", {
    key: 'l' + i,
    points: d,
    fill: "none",
    stroke: "#4ADE80",
    strokeWidth: "1.6",
    strokeLinejoin: "round",
    strokeLinecap: "round",
    opacity: ".85"
  })), React.createElement("circle", {
    cx: cx,
    cy: cy,
    r: R,
    fill: "none",
    stroke: "#93C5FD",
    strokeWidth: "1",
    opacity: ".35"
  }), cities.map(c => {
    const q = project(c.lat, c.lon);
    if (!q.vis) return null;
    const on = selected === c.city;
    const openNow = lit && lit[c.city];
    const hue = REGION_HUE[regionOf && regionOf(c) || c.region] || '#FBBF24';
    return React.createElement("g", {
      key: c.city,
      onClick: () => onSelect(c.city),
      style: {
        cursor: 'pointer'
      }
    }, openNow && React.createElement("circle", {
      cx: q.x,
      cy: q.y,
      r: on ? 13 : 9,
      fill: hue,
      opacity: ".22"
    }, React.createElement("animate", {
      attributeName: "r",
      values: `${on ? 9 : 6};${on ? 15 : 11};${on ? 9 : 6}`,
      dur: "2.4s",
      repeatCount: "indefinite"
    })), React.createElement("circle", {
      cx: q.x,
      cy: q.y,
      r: on ? 7 : openNow ? 5.5 : 4,
      fill: hue,
      stroke: "#fff",
      strokeWidth: on ? 2 : 1
    }), on && React.createElement("circle", {
      cx: q.x,
      cy: q.y,
      r: 12,
      fill: "none",
      stroke: "#fff",
      strokeWidth: "1.4",
      opacity: ".75"
    }), on && React.createElement("text", {
      x: q.x,
      y: q.y - 17,
      textAnchor: "middle",
      fontSize: "10",
      fill: "#fff",
      fontWeight: "700"
    }, c.city));
  })), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-center justify-center gap-3 mt-2"
  }, React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: () => {
      auto.current = !auto.current;
    },
    className: "text-[11px] text-faint hover:text-muted"
  }, "drag to spin and tilt"), React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: () => {
      setTiltDeg(18);
      setRot(70);
      auto.current = true;
    },
    className: "text-[11px] font-semibold text-gold"
  }, "reset view")));
}

const LEAF_G = '#16A34A';
function LeafQuiz() {
  const app = useApp();
  const bank = [['An emergency fund should ideally cover…', ['1 week of pay', '3–6 months of essentials', 'Your yearly rent', 'One big purchase'], 1, 'Aim for 3–6 months of essential costs, rent, food, bills, so a shock doesn’t become debt.'], ['The 50/30/20 rule puts 20% toward…', ['Wants', 'Needs', 'Savings & debt', 'Taxes'], 2, '50% needs, 30% wants, 20% to savings and extra debt payments.'], ['An ETF is best described as…', ['A single company’s stock', 'A savings account', 'A basket of many investments in one fund', 'A type of loan'], 2, 'One ETF spreads your money across many holdings, instant diversification, low cost.'], ['Compound interest means you earn returns on…', ['Only your deposits', 'Your deposits AND past returns', 'Only the bank’s money', 'Nothing until you retire'], 1, 'Your gains start earning their own gains, the earlier you start, the bigger the snowball.'], ['The debt “avalanche” method pays off first the balance with the…', ['Smallest amount', 'Highest interest rate', 'Longest name', 'Nearest due date'], 1, 'Highest-interest debt costs you the most, so killing it first saves the most money.'], ['Dollar-cost averaging means…', ['Buying everything at once', 'Investing a fixed amount on a schedule', 'Only buying when prices drop', 'Timing the market perfectly'], 1, 'Investing a set amount regularly smooths out the highs and lows over time.'], ['A good credit score mostly comes from…', ['Never using credit', 'Paying on time + low usage', 'Having lots of cards', 'Earning a high salary'], 1, 'On-time payments and keeping balances low are the two biggest score drivers.'], ['Inflation means that over time your cash…', ['Buys more', 'Buys less', 'Stays the same', 'Disappears'], 1, 'Prices rise, so money left as idle cash slowly loses buying power, one reason to invest.']];
  const [i, setI] = useState(0),
    [pick, setPick] = useState(null),
    [score, setScore] = useState(0),
    [done, setDone] = useState(false);
  const q = bank[i];
  const answered = pick !== null;
  const choose = n => {
    if (answered) return;
    setPick(n);
    if (n === q[2]) setScore(s => s + 1);
  };
  const next = () => {
    if (i + 1 >= bank.length) {
      setDone(true);
      if (app.awardXp) app.awardXp(20);
    } else {
      setI(i + 1);
      setPick(null);
    }
  };
  const pct = Math.round(score / bank.length * 100);
  const QHUE = ['#22C55E', '#0EA5E9', '#A855F7', '#F59E0B', '#EC4899', '#0D9488', '#6366F1', '#DC2626'];
  const hue = QHUE[i % QHUE.length];
  if (done) return React.createElement(AppShell, null, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl3 p-8 sm:p-12 text-center text-white",
    style: {
      background: 'linear-gradient(135deg,#15A34A 0%,#0D9488 50%,#0EA5E9 100%)',
      boxShadow: '0 24px 70px rgba(13,148,136,.45)'
    }
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "absolute -top-20 -right-10 h-60 w-60 rounded-full bg-white/20 blur-3xl floaty"
  }), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "relative"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-6xl mb-3"
  }, pct >= 80 ? '🌟' : pct >= 50 ? '🌱' : '📚'), React.createElement("h1", {
    className: "font-serif text-4xl sm:text-5xl"
  }, score, " / ", bank.length), React.createElement("p", {
    className: "text-lg mt-2",
    style: {
      color: 'rgba(255,255,255,.9)'
    }
  }, pct >= 80 ? 'Money-smart!' : pct >= 50 ? 'Solid, keep growing' : 'Great start, every pro began here.'), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "h-3 rounded-full mx-auto max-w-sm mt-6 overflow-hidden",
    style: {
      background: 'rgba(255,255,255,.25)'
    }
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "h-full rounded-full",
    style: {
      width: Math.max(4, pct) + '%',
      background: '#fff',
      boxShadow: '0 0 16px rgba(255,255,255,.7)'
    }
  })), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-3 mt-7"
  }, React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: () => {
      setI(0);
      setPick(null);
      setScore(0);
      setDone(false);
    },
    className: "btn px-6 py-3 text-sm",
    style: {
      background: '#fff',
      color: '#0D9488'
    }
  }, "Retake quiz ", React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "refresh",
    size: 14
  })), React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: () => app.nav('/leaf'),
    className: "btn px-6 py-3 text-sm",
    style: {
      background: 'rgba(255,255,255,.2)',
      color: '#fff'
    }
  }, "Back to Leaf ", React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "arrowR",
    size: 14
  }))))), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4 mt-4"
  }, [['Correct', score, '#16A34A'], ['Missed', bank.length - score, '#DC2626'], ['Score', pct + '%', '#0EA5E9']].map(([l, v, c]) => React.createElement(Card, {
    key: l,
    hover: false,
    className: "text-center"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-xs text-muted"
  }, l), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "font-serif text-3xl mt-1",
    style: {
      color: c
    }
  }, v)))));
  return React.createElement(AppShell, null, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex flex-col",
    style: {
      minHeight: 'calc(100vh - 150px)'
    }
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl3 mb-4 px-6 py-5 text-white shrink-0",
    style: {
      background: `linear-gradient(135deg,${hue},${hue}AA)`
    }
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "absolute -top-12 -right-6 h-36 w-36 rounded-full bg-white/20 blur-2xl"
  }), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "relative flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4"
  }, React.createElement("div", null, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[.24em]",
    style: {
      color: 'rgba(255,255,255,.85)'
    }
  }, "Leaf \xB7 Money quiz"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "font-serif text-2xl mt-0.5"
  }, "Question ", i + 1, " of ", bank.length)), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-center gap-4"
  }, React.createElement("div", {

const WORDS = [['APR', 'Budgeting', 'The yearly cost of borrowing, including interest and fees. The engine behind long-term wealth.'], ['Dividend', 'Investing', 'A share of a company’s profit paid to shareholders, usually quarterly.'], ['Bull market', 'Investing', 'A sustained period of rising prices and optimism.'], ['Bear market', 'Investing', 'A sustained fall of roughly 20% or more, with widespread pessimism.'], ['Credit score', 'Credit', 'A number (roughly 300 to 850) lenders use to judge how reliably you repay.'], ['Credit utilisation', 'Credit', 'How much of your available credit you’re using. The biggest driver of risk and return.'], ['Dollar-cost averaging', 'Investing', 'Investing a fixed amount on a schedule so you buy through highs and lows.']];
const SRS_KEY = 'lumera_srs';
const BOX_DAYS = [0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16];
function loadSrs() {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(__LS.getItem(SRS_KEY)) || {};
  } catch (e) {
    return {};
  }
}
function saveSrs(s) {
  try {
    __LS.setItem(SRS_KEY, JSON.stringify(s));
  } catch (e) {}
}
const todayNum = () => Math.floor(Date.now() / 864e5);
function dueWords(srs) {
  const t = todayNum();
  const seen = WORDS.filter(w => srs[w[0]]).filter(w => (srs[w[0]].due || 0) <= t);
  const fresh = WORDS.filter(w => !srs[w[0]]);
  return [...seen.sort((a, b) => (srs[a[0]].box || 1) - (srs[b[0]].box || 1)), ...fresh];
}
function gradeWord(srs, word, correct) {
  const cur = srs[word] || {
    box: 1,
    seen: 0,
    right: 0,
    wrong: 0
  };
  const box = correct ? Math.min(5, (cur.box || 1) + 1) : 1;
  return {
    ...srs,
    [word]: {
      box,
      due: todayNum() + BOX_DAYS[box],
      seen: (cur.seen || 0) + 1,
      right: (cur.right || 0) + (correct ? 1 : 0),
      wrong: (cur.wrong || 0) + (correct ? 0 : 1)
    }
  };
}
function WordOfDayPopup() {
  const app = useApp();
  const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [srs, setSrs] = useState(loadSrs);
  const [queue, setQueue] = useState([]);
  const [i, setI] = useState(0),
    [pick, setPick] = useState(null),
    [done, setDone] = useState(false),
    [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      if (__LS.getItem('lumera_wotd_day') === today) return;
    } catch (e) {}
    const q = dueWords(loadSrs()).slice(0, 3);
    if (!q.length) return;
    setQueue(q);
    setOpen(true);
  }, [today]);
  const myTurn = usePopupSlot('wotd', open);
  const w = queue[i];
  const options = useMemo(() => {
    if (!w) return [];
    const others = WORDS.filter(x => x[0] !== w[0]).sort((a, b) => hashStr(a[0] + w[0]) - hashStr(b[0] + w[0])).slice(0, 3);
    return [[w[2], true], ...others.map(o => [o[2], false])].sort((a, b) => hashStr(a[0]) - hashStr(b[0]));
  }, [w && w[0]]);
  const choose = n => {
    if (pick !== null || !w) return;
    setPick(n);
    const correct = options[n][1];
    if (correct) setScore(s => s + 1);
    const ns = gradeWord(srs, w[0], correct);
    setSrs(ns);
    saveSrs(ns);
  };
  const next = () => {
    if (i + 1 >= queue.length) {
      setDone(true);
      try {
        __LS.setItem('lumera_wotd_day', today);
      } catch (e) {}
      if (app.awardXp) app.awardXp(15, true);
    } else {
      setI(i + 1);
      setPick(null);
    }
  };
  const close = () => {
    try {
      __LS.setItem('lumera_wotd_day', today);
    } catch (e) {}
    setOpen(false);
  };
  if (!myTurn || !w) return null;
  const wrongOnes = queue.slice(0, i + 1).filter(x => (srs[x[0]] || {}).box === 1);
  return React.createElement("div", {
    className: "fixed inset-0 z-[175] grid place-items-center p-4"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "absolute inset-0",
    style: {
      background: 'rgba(6,20,12,.72)',
      backdropFilter: 'blur(6px)'
    },
    onClick: () => done && close()
  }), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "relative w-full max-w-lg lux-card !p-0 overflow-hidden anim-scaleIn"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "px-6 py-4 text-white",
    style: {
      background: `linear-gradient(135deg,${LEAF_G},#0D9488)`
    }
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-center justify-between"
  }, React.createElement("div", null, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[.22em]",
    style: {
      color: 'rgba(255,255,255,.85)'
    }
  }, "Leaf \xB7 Word of the day"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "font-serif text-2xl mt-0.5"
  }, done ? 'Nice work!' : 'Three words to know')), React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: close,
    className: "grid place-items-center h-8 w-8 rounded-lg",
    style: {
      background: 'rgba(255,255,255,.2)',
      color: '#fff'
    }
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "x",
    size: 15
  }))), !done && React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex gap-1.5 mt-3"
  }, queue.map((_, n) => React.createElement("span", {
    key: n,
    className: "h-1.5 flex-1 rounded-full",
    style: {
      background: n < i ? '#fff' : n === i ? 'rgba(255,255,255,.65)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.28)'
    }
  })))), done ? React.createElement("div", {
    className: "p-6 text-center"
  }, React.createElement("div", {

  }, score === queue.length ? '🌟' : score > 0 ? '🌱' : '📚'), React.createElement("div", {

  }, wrongOnes.length ? `We’ll bring ${wrongOnes.length === 1 ? 'that word' : 'those words'} back sooner so ${wrongOnes.length === 1 ? 'it' : 'they'} stick. function LeafWordOfDay() {
  const app = useApp();

  const [i, setI] = useState(0),
    [pick, setPick] = useState(null),
    [done, setDone] = useState(false);
  const w = queue[i];
  const options = useMemo(() => {
    if (!w) return [];
    const others = WORDS.filter(x => x[0] !== w[0]).sort((a, b) => hashStr(a[0] + w[0]) - hashStr(b[0] + w[0])).slice(0, 2);
    return [[w[2], true], ...others.map(o => [o[2], false])].sort((a, b) => hashStr(a[0]) - hashStr(b[0]));
  }, [w && w[0]]);
  const choose = n => {
    if (pick !== null || !w) return;
    setPick(n);
    const correct = options[n][1];
    const ns = gradeWord(srs, w[0], correct);
    setSrs(ns);
    saveSrs(ns);
  };

    if (i + 1 >= queue.length) {
      setDone(true);
      if (app.awardXp) app.awardXp(15);

      setI(i + 1);

  const mastered = WORDS.filter(x => (srs[x[0]] || {}).box >= 5).length;

function LeafHabits() {
  const KEY = 'lumera_leaf_habits';
  const habits = [['track', '📒', 'Log today’s spending', 'A 30-second habit that reveals where money really goes.'], ['noimpulse', '🛑', 'No impulse buys today', 'Add a 24-hour wait to anything unplanned over $30.'], ['save', '🪙', 'Move something to savings', 'Even $1 keeps the muscle strong.'], ['learn', '📚', 'Learn one money idea', 'A lesson, article or quiz counts.'], ['cook', '🍳', 'Eat in instead of out', 'Small swaps, big monthly difference.'], ['check', '👀', 'Check one subscription', 'Cancel anything you forgot you had.']];
  const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const [state, setState] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const s = JSON.parse(__LS.getItem(KEY)) || {};
      return s;
    } catch (e) {
      return {};
    }
  });
  const day = state[today] || {};
  const toggle = id => {
    setState(s => {
      const d = {
        ...(s[today] || {})
      };
      d[id] = !d[id];
      const ns = {
        ...s,
        [today]: d
      };
      try {
        __LS.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(ns));
      } catch (e) {}
      return ns;
    });
  };
  const doneN = habits.filter(h => day[h[0]]).length;
  let streak = 0;
  for (let k = 0; k < 60; k++) {
    const d = new Date(Date.now() - k * 864e5).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const v = state[d];
    if (v && Object.values(v).some(Boolean)) streak++;else if (k > 0) break;
  }
  const week = Array.from({
    length: 7
  }, (_, k) => {
    const d = new Date(Date.now() - (6 - k) * 864e5).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const v = state[d];
    return {
      d,
      on: !!(v && Object.values(v).some(Boolean))
    };
  });
  return React.createElement(AppShell, null, React.createElement(PageHead, {
    eyebrow: "Leaf \xB7 Money habits",
    title: "Small habits, compounding results.",
    desc: "Tick off healthy money habits each day and grow your streak. Saved in this browser."
  }), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-4"
  }, React.createElement(Card, {
    hover: false,
    className: "flex items-center gap-4"
  }, React.createElement(ScoreRing, {
    value: Math.round(doneN / habits.length * 100),
    size: 96,
    stroke: 9,
    label: "today",
    color: LEAF_G
  }), React.createElement("div", null, React.createElement(Eyebrow, null, "Today"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "font-serif text-2xl text-charcoal"
  }, doneN, "/", habits.length), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-xs text-muted"
  }, "habits done"))), React.createElement(Card, {
    hover: false
  }, React.createElement(Eyebrow, {
    className: "mb-1"
  }, "Current streak"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "font-serif text-4xl",
    style: {
      color: LEAF_G
    }
  }, streak, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-lg text-muted"
  }, " day", streak === 1 ? '' : 's', " \uD83D\uDD25")), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-xs text-faint mt-1"
  }, "One habit a day keeps the streak alive.")), React.createElement(Card, {
    hover: false
  }, React.createElement(Eyebrow, {
    className: "mb-2"
  }, "Last 7 days"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex gap-1.5 items-end"
  }, week.map((w, k) => React.createElement("div", {
    key: k,
    className: "flex-1 text-center"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "h-10 rounded-lg flex items-end justify-center",
    style: {
      background: w.on ? LEAF_G : 'var(--c-sand,#eee)',
      opacity: w.on ? 1 : .4
    }
  }, w.on && React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-white text-xs mb-1"
  }, "\u2713")), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-[10px] text-faint mt-1"
  }, ['S', 'M', 'T', 'W', 'T', 'F', 'S'][new Date(w.d).getDay()])))))), React.createElement(Card, null, React.createElement(Eyebrow, {
    className: "mb-3"
  }, "Today\u2019s habits"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5"
  }, habits.map(([id, e, t, tip]) => {
    const on = !!day[id];
    return React.createElement("button", {
      key: id,
      onClick: () => toggle(id),
      className: cx('flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl2 border p-3 text-left transition', on ? 'border-sage/40 bg-sage/8' : 'border-line hover:border-[color:var(--lg)]'),
      style: {
        '--lg': LEAF_G
      }
    }, React.createElement("span", {
      className: "text-2xl shrink-0"
    }, e), React.createElement("span", {
      className: "min-w-0"
    }, React.createElement("span", {
      className: cx('block text-sm font-medium', on ? 'text-muted line-through' : 'text-charcoal')
    }, t), React.createElement("span", {
      className: "block text-xs text-faint mt-0.5"
    }, tip)), React.createElement("span", {
      className: cx('ml-auto grid place-items-center h-6 w-6 rounded-lg shrink-0', on ? 'bg-sage text-white' : 'bg-sand text-faint')
    }, on ? '✓' : '+'));
  }))));
}
function LeafChallenges() {
  const app = useApp();
  const fmt = app.fmt;
  const challenges = [['52-week save', '🪜', 'Save $1 in week 1, $2 in week 2… up to $52. Painless start, $1,378 by year end.', 1378, '52 weeks'], ['No-spend week', '🚫', 'Buy only essentials for 7 days. Notice every habit purchase you skip.', 0, '7 days'], ['Round-up jar', '🫙', 'Round every purchase up to the nearest pound; stash the change.', 300, 'Ongoing'], ['Pantry challenge', '🥫', 'Cook only from what you already own for a week. Zero grocery spend.', 60, '7 days'], ['Subscription audit', '📺', 'Cancel two subscriptions you forgot about this month.', 180, '1 hour'], ['$5 a day', '🖐️', 'Tuck away $5 every day. Small, steady, and $150 richer each month.', 150, '30 days']];
  const KEY = 'lumera_leaf_chal';
  const [joined, setJoined] = useState(() => {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(__LS.getItem(KEY)) || [];
    } catch (e) {
      return [];
    }
  });
  const toggle = t => {
    setJoined(j => {
      const nj = j.includes(t) ? j.filter(x => x !== t) : [...j, t];
      try {
        __LS.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(nj));
      } catch (e) {}
      return nj;
    });
  };
  return React.createElement(AppShell, null, React.createElement(PageHead, {
    eyebrow: "Leaf \xB7 Money challenges",
    title: "Turn saving into a game.",
    desc: "Pick a challenge, commit, and watch small wins stack up. Track how many you\u2019ve joined."
  }), React.createElement(Card, {
    className: "mb-4 flex items-center gap-3"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-3xl"
  }, "\uD83C\uDFAF"), React.createElement("div", null, React.createElement(Eyebrow, null, "Your challenges"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "font-serif text-xl text-charcoal"
  }, joined.length, " active")), joined.length > 0 && React.createElement("span", {
    className: "ml-auto text-sm",
    style: {
      color: LEAF_G
    }
  }, "Potential saved: ", React.createElement("b", null, fmt.money(challenges.filter(c => joined.includes(c[0])).reduce((a, c) => a + c[3], 0))), "/yr")), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4 stagger"
  }, challenges.map(([t, e, d, save, dur]) => {
    const on = joined.includes(t);
    return React.createElement(Card, {
      key: t,
      className: cx(on && 'ring-1 ring-sage/40')
    }, React.createElement("div", {
      className: "flex items-center justify-between"
    }, React.createElement("span", {
      className: "text-3xl"
    }, e), save > 0 && React.createElement(Pill, {
      tone: "gold"
    }, "~", fmt.money(save))), React.createElement("div", {
      className: "font-serif text-lg text-charcoal mt-2"
    }, t), React.createElement("p", {
      className: "text-sm text-muted mt-1 leading-relaxed"
    }, d), React.createElement("div", {
      className: "flex items-center justify-between mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-line"
    }, React.createElement("span", {
      className: "text-[11px] text-faint"
    }, "\u23F3 ", dur), React.createElement("button", {
      onClick: () => toggle(t),
      className: cx('text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 transition', on ? 'bg-sage/12 text-saged' : 'text-white'),
      style: on ? {} : {
        background: LEAF_G
      }
    }, on ? '✓ Joined' : 'Join')));
  })));
}

function TabbedModal({
  eyebrow,
  title,
  subtitle,
  hue = '#8B5CF6',
  badge,
  stats,
  tabs,
  onClose,
  footer
}) {
  const names = Object.keys(tabs);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState(names[0]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const h = e => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose();
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', h);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', h);
  }, [onClose]);
  return React.createElement("div", {
    className: "fixed inset-0 z-50 grid place-items-center p-4"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "absolute inset-0 bg-charcoal/55",
    style: {
      backdropFilter: 'blur(4px)'
    },
    onClick: onClose
  }), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "relative w-full max-w-3xl lux-card !p-0 max-h-[88vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden anim-scaleIn"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "relative px-6 pt-6 pb-5 shrink-0 overflow-hidden",
    style: {
      background: `linear-gradient(150deg, ${hue}, ${hue}BB)`
    }
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "absolute inset-0 opacity-[.13] pointer-events-none",
    style: {
      backgroundImage: 'radial-gradient(circle,#fff 1.3px,transparent 1.4px)',
      backgroundSize: '20px 20px'
    }
  }), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "relative flex items-start justify-between gap-4"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "min-w-0"
  }, eyebrow && React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-[10px] tracking-[.2em] uppercase",
    style: {
      color: 'rgba(255,255,255,.8)'
    }
  }, eyebrow), React.createElement("h3", {
    className: "font-serif text-3xl mt-1",
    style: {
      color: '#fff'
    }
  }, title), subtitle && React.createElement("p", {
    className: "text-sm mt-1 max-w-xl",
    style: {
      color: 'rgba(255,255,255,.85)'
    }
  }, subtitle)), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-start gap-2 shrink-0"
  }, badge && React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-full px-2.5 py-1",
    style: {
      background: 'rgba(255,255,255,.22)',
      color: '#fff'
    }
  }, badge), React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: onClose,
    className: "grid place-items-center h-8 w-8 rounded-lg",
    style: {
      background: 'rgba(255,255,255,.18)',
      color: '#fff'
    },
    "aria-label": "Close"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "x",
    size: 15
  })))), stats && React.createElement("div", {
    className: "relative grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 mt-4"
  }, stats.map(([l, v]) => React.createElement("div", {
    key: l,
    className: "rounded-xl px-3 py-2",
    style: {
      background: 'rgba(255,255,255,.16)',
      border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2)'
    }
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider",
    style: {
      color: 'rgba(255,255,255,.8)'
    }
  }, l), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-sm font-semibold leading-tight mt-0.5",
    style: {
      color: '#fff'
    }
  }, v))))), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex gap-1 px-4 pt-3 pb-2 border-b border-line overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar shrink-0"
  }, names.map(n => React.createElement("button", {
    key: n,
    onClick: () => setTab(n),
    className: "rounded-full px-3.5 py-1.5 text-[12.5px] font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition",
    style: tab === n ? {
      background: hue,
      color: '#fff'
    } : {
      color: 'rgb(var(--c-muted))'
    }
  }, n))), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6 space-y-5 anim-fadeUp",
    key: tab
  }, tabs[tab]), footer && React.createElement("div", {
    className: "px-6 py-4 border-t border-line shrink-0"
  }, footer)));
}
function PayLadder({
  rows,
  hue
}) {
  const nums = rows.map(([, v]) => {
    const m = String(v).match(/[\d.]+/g) || ['1'];
    return parseFloat(m[m.length - 1]) || 1;
  });
  const max = Math.max(...nums);
  return React.createElement("div", {
    className: "space-y-3"
  }, rows.map(([lvl, v], i) => React.createElement("div", {
    key: lvl
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3 mb-1"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-sm font-semibold text-charcoal"
  }, lvl), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-[12.5px] text-muted text-right"
  }, v)), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "h-2 rounded-full bg-sand overflow-hidden"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-700",
    style: {
      width: Math.max(12, nums[i] / max * 100) + '%',
      background: hue,
      opacity: .45 + i * 0.22
    }
  })))));
}
function RouteSteps({
  items,
  hue
}) {
  return React.createElement("ol", {
    className: "relative pl-7"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "absolute left-[10px] top-2 bottom-2 w-px",
    style: {
      background: hue,
      opacity: .28
    }
  }), items.map((t, i) => React.createElement("li", {
    key: i,
    className: "relative pb-4 last:pb-0"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "absolute -left-7 grid place-items-center h-5 w-5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold text-white tnum",
    style: {
      background: hue
    }
  }, i + 1), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-sm text-charcoal/85 leading-snug"
  }, t))));
}

function FinanceCareers() {
  const [q, setQ] = useState(''),
    [sel, setSel] = useState(null);
  const shown = CAREERS.filter(c => c.name.toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()) || c.blurb.toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()));
  return React.createElement(AppShell, null, React.createElement(PageHead, {
    eyebrow: "Career",
    title: "Where finance can take you.",
    desc: "Fourteen of the most common finance career paths, what people actually do day-to-day, what they earn, how to get in, and where to learn more. Use this to decide before you spec your degree, not after."
  }), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex justify-end mb-4"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "relative w-full sm:w-72"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "search",
    size: 15,
    className: "absolute left-3 top-3 text-faint"
  }), React.createElement("input", {
    value: q,
    onChange: e => setQ(e.target.value),
    placeholder: "Search careers\u2026",
    className: "w-full rounded-xl border border-line bg-cream pl-9 pr-3 py-2.5 focus:outline-none"
  }))), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4 stagger"
  }, shown.map((c, i) => {
    const hue = hueFor(i);
    return React.createElement(Card, {
      key: c.name,
      onClick: () => setSel(c),
      className: "flex flex-col cursor-pointer group",
      style: {
        borderTop: `3px solid ${hue}`
      }
    }, React.createElement("div", {
      className: "flex items-start justify-between"
    }, React.createElement("span", {
      className: "grid place-items-center h-12 w-12 rounded-xl text-2xl",
      style: {
        background: hue + '1A'
      }
    }, c.icon), React.createElement("span", {
      className: "text-[11px] font-semibold rounded-full px-2.5 py-1",
      style: {
        background: hue + '18',
        color: hue
      }
    }, c.tag)), React.createElement("div", {
      className: "font-serif text-xl text-charcoal mt-3 group-hover:text-goldd transition"
    }, c.name), React.createElement("p", {
      className: "text-sm text-muted mt-1 leading-relaxed flex-1"
    }, c.blurb), React.createElement("div", {
      className: "mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-line flex items-center gap-1 text-sm font-semibold",
      style: {
        color: hue
      }
    }, "Explore this path ", React.createElement(Icon, {
      name: "arrowR",
      size: 14,
      className: "group-hover:translate-x-1 transition"
    })));
  })), sel && (() => {
    const hue = hueFor(CAREERS.indexOf(sel));
    return React.createElement(TabbedModal, {
      eyebrow: "Finance career",
      title: sel.name,
      subtitle: sel.blurb,
      hue: hue,
      badge: sel.tag,
      stats: [['Entry', (sel.salary[0] || [])[1] ? String(sel.salary[0][1]).split('+')[0].trim() : '—'], ['Senior', (sel.salary[2] || sel.salary[sel.salary.length - 1] || [])[1] || '—'], ['Competition', sel.tag]],
      onClose: () => setSel(null),
      footer: React.createElement("div", {
        className: "flex items-center justify-between gap-3 flex-wrap"
      }, React.createElement("span", {
        className: "text-xs text-faint"
      }, "Ranges reflect US/UK financial centres, meaningfully lower elsewhere."), React.createElement("a", {
        href: "https://www.wallstreetoasis.com/",
        target: "_blank",
        rel: "noopener noreferrer",
        className: "btn btn-gold text-sm"
      }, "Explore the forums ", React.createElement(Icon, {
        name: "arrowR",
        size: 13,
        className: "-rotate-45"
      }))),
      tabs: {
        'The role': React.createElement(Fragment, null, React.createElement(MBlock, {
          title: "A day in the role"
        }, React.createElement(Ticks, {
          items: sel.day,
          color: hue
        })), React.createElement(MBlock, {
          title: "Skills that actually matter"
        }, React.createElement(Ticks, {
          items: sel.skills,
          color: hue
        }))),
        'Pay & progression': React.createElement(Fragment, null, React.createElement(MBlock, {
          title: "What it pays"
        }, React.createElement(PayLadder, {
          rows: sel.salary,
          hue: hue
        })), React.createElement(MBlock, {
          title: "How the ladder runs"
        }, React.createElement("div", {
          className: "rounded-xl2 p-4 text-sm text-charcoal/85 leading-relaxed",
          style: {
            background: hue + '12',
            border: `1px solid ${hue}2E`
          }
        }, sel.progression))),
        'Getting in': React.createElement(Fragment, null, React.createElement(MBlock, {
          title: "Entry routes"
        }, React.createElement(RouteSteps, {
          items: sel.routes,
          hue: hue
        })), React.createElement(MBlock, {
          title: "Internships to target"
        }, React.createElement(Ticks, {
          items: sel.interns,
          color: hue
        }))),
        'Study': React.createElement(Fragment, null, React.createElement("div", {
          className: "grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3"
        }, [['University targets', sel.unis, '🎓'], ['Subject requirements', sel.subjects, '📘'], ['Degree recommendations', sel.degrees, '🧭']].map(([t, v, e]) => React.createElement("div", {
          key: t,
          className: cx('rounded-xl2 border border-line p-4', t === 'Degree recommendations' && 'sm:col-span-2')
        }, React.createElement("div", {
          className: "flex items-center gap-2 mb-1.5"
        }, React.createElement("span", {
          className: "text-lg"
        }, e), React.createElement("span", {
          className: "text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider text-faint"
        }, t)), React.createElement("p", {
          className: "text-sm text-charcoal/85 leading-relaxed"
        }, v))))),
        'Resources': React.createElement(MBlock, {
          title: "Where to learn more"
        }, React.createElement(LinkRow, {
          items: sel.resources
        }))
      }
    });
  })());
}

function TopFinanceFirms() {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('All firms'),
    [q, setQ] = useState(''),
    [sel, setSel] = useState(null);
  const shown = FIRMS.filter(f => (tab === 'All firms' || f[2] === tab) && f[0].toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()));
  return React.createElement(AppShell, null, React.createElement(PageHead, {
    eyebrow: "Career",
    title: "Where finance gets done.",
    desc: "The firms that shape global capital markets. Every profile shows what they actually look for, how to get in, and what the interview process looks like, so you can target your prep with conviction."
  }), React.createElement(Card, {
    className: "mb-4"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3 sm:items-center"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex gap-2 flex-wrap flex-1"
  }, FIRM_TABS.map(t => React.createElement("button", {
    key: t,
    onClick: () => setTab(t),
    className: cx('chip', tab === t && 'on')
  }, t))), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "relative sm:w-56"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "search",
    size: 15,
    className: "absolute left-3 top-3 text-faint"
  }), React.createElement("input", {
    value: q,
    onChange: e => setQ(e.target.value),
    placeholder: "Search firms\u2026",
    className: "w-full rounded-xl border border-line bg-cream pl-9 pr-3 py-2.5 focus:outline-none"
  })))), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4 stagger"
  }, shown.map((f, i) => {
    const hue = hueFor(i);
    return React.createElement(Card, {
      key: f[0],
      onClick: () => setSel(f),
      className: "flex flex-col cursor-pointer group",

        borderTop: `3px solid ${hue}`
      }
    }, React.createElement("div", {

          title: "What makes this firm worth targeting"

        }))
      }
    });
  })());
}

        }, note)))),

        })))
      }
    });

  }, React.createElement(Disclaimer, {
    compact: true
  })));
}

function LabCylinder({
  pct,
  hue = '#8B5CF6',
  label = 'CV strength'
}) {
  const h = 200,
    w = 96,
    innerTop = 18,
    innerH = h - innerTop - 14;
  const fill = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, pct));
  const liquidH = fill / 100 * innerH;
  const y = innerTop + innerH - liquidH;
  return React.createElement("div", {
    className: "relative select-none",
    style: {
      width: w,
      height: h + 26
    }
  }, React.createElement("svg", {
    viewBox: `0 0 ${w} ${h}`,
    width: w,
    height: h,
    className: "overflow-visible"
  }, React.createElement("defs", null, React.createElement("clipPath", {
    id: "cylClip"
  }, React.createElement("rect", {
    x: "16",
    y: innerTop,
    width: w - 32,
    height: innerH,
    rx: "6"
  })), React.createElement("linearGradient", {
    id: "cylLiquid",
    x1: "0",
    y1: "0",
    x2: "0",
    y2: "1"
  }, React.createElement("stop", {
    offset: "0",
    stopColor: hue,
    stopOpacity: ".95"
  }), React.createElement("stop", {
    offset: "1",
    stopColor: hue,
    stopOpacity: ".65"
  })), React.createElement("linearGradient", {
    id: "cylGlass",
    x1: "0",
    y1: "0",
    x2: "1",
    y2: "0"
  }, React.createElement("stop", {
    offset: "0",
    stopColor: "#fff",
    stopOpacity: ".28"
  }), React.createElement("stop", {
    offset: ".45",
    stopColor: "#fff",
    stopOpacity: ".04"
  }), React.createElement("stop", {
    offset: "1",
    stopColor: "#fff",
    stopOpacity: ".22"
  }))), React.createElement("rect", {
    x: "14",
    y: innerTop - 4,
    width: w - 28,
    height: innerH + 8,
    rx: "8",
    fill: "rgba(255,255,255,.05)",
    stroke: "currentColor",
    className: "text-line",
    strokeWidth: "2"
  }), React.createElement("g", {
    clipPath: "url(#cylClip)"
  }, React.createElement("rect", {
    x: "16",
    y: y,
    width: w - 32,
    height: liquidH + 6,
    fill: "url(#cylLiquid)",
    style: {
      transition: 'y .8s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), height .8s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)'
    }
  }), fill > 0 && React.createElement("path", {
    className: "lab-wave",
    d: `M0 ${y} q 16 -6 32 0 t 32 0 t 32 0 t 32 0 t 32 0 V ${h} H0 Z`,
    fill: hue,
    opacity: ".55",
    style: {
      transition: 'd .8s'
    }
  }), fill > 4 && [0, 1, 2].map(i => React.createElement("circle", {
    key: i,
    className: "lab-bubble",
    cx: 30 + i * 18,
    cy: innerTop + innerH - 6,
    r: 3 - i * 0.5,
    fill: "#fff",
    opacity: ".7",
    style: {
      animationDelay: i * 0.7 + 's'
    }
  }))), [25, 50, 75].map(m => {
    const my = innerTop + innerH - m / 100 * innerH;
    return React.createElement("g", {
      key: m
    }, React.createElement("line", {
      x1: w - 30,
      x2: w - 16,
      y1: my,
      y2: my,
      stroke: "currentColor",
      className: "text-faint",
      strokeWidth: "1.5",
      opacity: ".7"
    }), React.createElement("text", {
      x: w - 34,
      y: my + 3.5,
      textAnchor: "end",
      fontSize: "8",
      fill: "currentColor",
      className: "text-faint"
    }, m));
  }), React.createElement("rect", {
    x: "14",
    y: innerTop - 4,
    width: w - 28,
    height: innerH + 8,
    rx: "8",
    fill: "url(#cylGlass)",
    pointerEvents: "none"
  }), React.createElement("path", {
    d: `M14 ${innerTop - 4} q 0 -12 12 -12 h ${w - 52} q 12 0 12 12`,
    fill: "none",
    stroke: "currentColor",
    className: "text-line",
    strokeWidth: "2"
  }), React.createElement("ellipse", {
    cx: w / 2,
    cy: h - 4,
    rx: w / 2 - 10,
    ry: "5",
    fill: hue,
    opacity: ".14"
  })), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "absolute inset-x-0 text-center",
    style: {
      top: h * 0.42
    }
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "font-serif text-2xl text-charcoal leading-none"
  }, Math.round(fill), "%"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider text-faint mt-0.5"
  }, label)));
}
function LabBottle({
  item,
  on,
  onToggle,
  idx
}) {
  const hue = item.hue;
  const floatCls = ['lab-float', 'lab-float-2', 'lab-float-3'][idx % 3];
  return React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: onToggle,
    className: cx('relative rounded-xl2 border p-4 text-left transition-all duration-300 group', on ? 'shadow-soft' : 'hover:-translate-y-0.5'),
    style: on ? {
      borderColor: hue,
      background: hue + '12'
    } : {
      borderColor: 'rgb(var(--c-line))'
    }
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-start gap-3"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: cx('shrink-0', !on && floatCls),
    style: {
      lineHeight: 0
    }
  }, React.createElement("svg", {
    width: "42",
    height: "48",
    viewBox: "0 0 42 48"
  }, React.createElement("defs", null, React.createElement("clipPath", {
    id: 'fl' + idx
  }, React.createElement("path", {
    d: "M17 4 h8 v13 l11 22 a5 5 0 0 1 -4 8 H10 a5 5 0 0 1 -4 -8 l11 -22 Z"
  }))), React.createElement("path", {
    d: "M17 4 h8 v13 l11 22 a5 5 0 0 1 -4 8 H10 a5 5 0 0 1 -4 -8 l11 -22 Z",
    fill: on ? hue + '33' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.05)',
    stroke: on ? hue : 'currentColor',
    className: on ? '' : 'text-line',
    strokeWidth: "2"
  }), React.createElement("g", {
    clipPath: `url(#fl${idx})`
  }, React.createElement("rect", {
    x: "0",
    y: on ? 26 : 47,
    width: "42",
    height: "22",
    fill: hue,
    opacity: ".85",
    style: {
      transition: 'y .6s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)'
    }
  }), on && React.createElement("circle", {
    className: "lab-bubble",
    cx: "18",
    cy: "44",
    r: "2",
    fill: "#fff",
    opacity: ".8"
  })), React.createElement("rect", {
    x: "15",
    y: "2",
    width: "12",
    height: "4",
    rx: "2",
    fill: on ? hue : 'currentColor',
    className: on ? '' : 'text-line'
  }))), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "min-w-0 flex-1"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "flex items-center gap-2"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-sm font-semibold text-charcoal"
  }, item.t), on && React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5",
    style: {
      background: hue + '22',
      color: hue
    }
  }, "+", item.pts)), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "block text-xs text-muted mt-1 leading-relaxed"
  }, item.d)), React.createElement("span", {
    className: cx('grid place-items-center h-6 w-6 rounded-lg shrink-0 transition', on ? 'text-white' : 'text-faint'),
    style: on ? {
      background: hue
    } : {
      background: 'rgb(var(--c-sand))'
    }
  }, on ? React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "check",
    size: 13
  }) : React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-xs"
  }, "+"))));
}

}));
function CVLab() {
  const app = useApp();
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('CV Building');
  const [applied, setApplied] = useState(() => {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(__LS.getItem(LAB_KEY)) || {};
    } catch (e) {
      return {};
    }
  });
  const [flash, setFlash] = useState(null);
  const save = next => {
    setApplied(next);
    try {
      __LS.setItem(LAB_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
    } catch (e) {}
  };
  const toggle = id => {
    const next = {
      ...applied,
      [id]: !applied[id]
    };
    save(next);
    if (next[id]) {
      setFlash(id);
      setTimeout(() => setFlash(null), 900);
    }
  };
  const reagents = tab === 'LinkedIn Optimisation' ? LI_REAGENTS : CV_REAGENTS;
  const done = reagents.filter(r => applied[r.id]);
  const pct = reagents.length ? Math.round(done.length / reagents.length * 100) : 0;
  const hue = tab === 'LinkedIn Optimisation' ? '#0EA5E9' : '#8B5CF6';
  const verdict = pct >= 100 ? 'Interview-ready' : pct >= 75 ? 'Nearly there' : pct >= 40 ? 'Taking shape' : pct > 0 ? 'Just started' : 'Empty bench';
  return React.createElement(AppShell, null, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl3 mb-5 p-6 sm:p-8",
    style: {
      background: 'linear-gradient(150deg,#0F172A 0%,#1E1B4B 55%,#0B1120 100%)'
    }
  }, [0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map(i => React.createElement("span", {
    key: i,
    className: "lab-drift absolute rounded-full",
    style: {
      left: 8 + i * 19 + '%',
      top: 12 + i * 29 % 60 + '%',
      width: 6 + i * 3,
      height: 6 + i * 3,
      background: LAB_HUES[i % LAB_HUES.length],
      opacity: .28,
      filter: 'blur(6px)',
      animationDelay: i * 1.4 + 's'
    }
  })), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "relative flex flex-wrap items-center gap-8"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex-1 min-w-[240px]"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[.24em]",
    style: {
      color: 'rgba(255,255,255,.7)'
    }
  }, "Forge \xB7 The lab"), React.createElement("h1", {
    className: "font-serif text-3xl sm:text-4xl mt-1",
    style: {
      color: '#fff'
    }
  }, "Mix a CV recruiters notice."), React.createElement("p", {
    className: "text-sm mt-2 max-w-lg",
    style: {
      color: 'rgba(255,255,255,.8)'
    }
  }, "Every practice on the bench is a reagent. Add one and watch it pour into the cylinder, your CV strength is the level it reaches."), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-4"
  }, ['CV Building', 'LinkedIn Optimisation', 'Opportunities'].map(t => React.createElement("button", {
    key: t,
    onClick: () => setTab(t),
    className: "text-xs font-semibold rounded-full px-3.5 py-2 transition",
    style: tab === t ? {
      background: '#fff',
      color: '#0F172A'
    } : {
      background: 'rgba(255,255,255,.12)',
      color: 'rgba(255,255,255,.85)',
      border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18)'
    }
  }, t)))), tab !== 'Opportunities' && React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-end gap-5"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: cx(flash && 'lab-glow', 'rounded-2xl')
  }, React.createElement(LabCylinder, {
    pct: pct,
    hue: hue,
    label: tab === 'LinkedIn Optimisation' ? 'profile' : 'CV strength'
  })), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "pb-6"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider",
    style: {
      color: 'rgba(255,255,255,.6)'
    }

    className: "font-serif text-2xl",

    }

    className: "text-xs mt-1",

      color: 'rgba(255,255,255,.7)'
    }
  }, done.length, " of ", reagents.length, " reagents added"), pct > 0 && React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: () => save({}),
    className: "mt-3 text-[11px] font-semibold rounded-full px-3 py-1.5",
    style: {
      background: 'rgba(255,255,255,.14)',
      color: '#fff'
    }

function bandVerdict(score, band) {
  if (!band || score == null) return null;
  const [p25, p50, p75] = band;
  if (score >= p75) return ['Above the 75th', '#16A34A', 'Your score is at or above three quarters of admitted students.'];
  if (score >= p50) return ['Upper half', '#0EA5E9', 'Above the median of admitted students.'];
  if (score >= p25) return ['In range', '#D97706', 'Inside the published middle 50%. Competitive, not decisive.'];
  return ['Below the 25th', '#DC2626', 'Below where three quarters of admitted students sat. Not impossible, but the rest of your application has to carry more.'];
}

function parseSubject(raw) {
  const gradeM = raw.match(/\(([^)]+)\)/);
  const grade = gradeM ? gradeM[1] : null;
  const bare = raw.replace(/\([^)]*\)/, '').trim();
  const keys = Object.keys(SUBJECT_INFO);
  const lower = bare.toLowerCase();
  let key = keys.find(k => lower.includes(k.toLowerCase()));
  if (!key) {
    if (/further/.test(lower)) key = 'Further Mathematics';else if (/math|calculus/.test(lower)) key = 'Mathematics';else if (/econom/.test(lower)) key = 'Economics';else if (/physic/.test(lower)) key = 'Physics';else if (/chem/.test(lower)) key = 'Chemistry';else if (/comput|cs\b/.test(lower)) key = 'Computer Science';else if (/business/.test(lower)) key = 'Business';else if (/english/.test(lower)) key = 'English';else if (/histor/.test(lower)) key = 'History';else if (/epq|extended essay/.test(lower)) key = 'EPQ';else if (/stat/.test(lower)) key = 'Statistics';
  }
  return {
    raw,
    bare,
    grade,
    key,
    info: key ? SUBJECT_INFO[key] : null
  };
}
const SCORES_KEY = 'lumera_test_scores';
const SAT_PCTILE = [[1600, 99], [1550, 99], [1500, 98], [1450, 96], [1400, 93], [1350, 90], [1300, 86], [1250, 81], [1200, 74], [1150, 67], [1100, 58], [1050, 49], [1000, 40], [950, 31], [900, 23], [800, 11]];
const satPercentile = t => {
  const row = SAT_PCTILE.find(r => t >= r[0]);
  return row ? row[1] : 5;
};

      return {};
    }
  });
  const save = next => {
    setScores(next);
    try {
      __LS.setItem(SCORES_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
    } catch (e) {}
  };
  const set = (k, v) => save({
    ...scores,
    [k]: v
  });

    mt = Number(scores.satMath) || 0;

  const needOther = have => Math.max(200, Math.min(800, goal - have));

function SubjectSelection() {
  const [sys, setSys] = useState(SUBJECT_SYSTEMS[0]);

  const [field, setField] = useState('All');
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');

  const shown = SUBJECT_CAREERS.filter(c => (field === 'All' || c.field === field) && c.name.toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()));
  const boards = EXAM_BOARDS[sys] || [];
  const pickSystem = x => {
    setSys(x);
    setBoard((EXAM_BOARDS[x] || [''])[0]);
  };
  const TIERS = [['Tier 1', 'Oxbridge, LSE, Imperial, Ivy League'], ['Tier 2', 'Russell Group, top-30 US'], ['Tier 3', 'Solid, well-regarded courses']];
  return React.createElement(AppShell, null, React.createElement(PageHead, {
    eyebrow: "Subject selection guide",

    desc: "Which subjects each career actually values, the grade to aim for, what your exam board changes, and what to take instead if your school does not offer something."
  }), React.createElement(Card, {

const PREP_KEY = 'lumera_prep_tiers';
const PREP_HUES = ['#8B5CF6', '#0EA5E9', '#16A34A', '#D97706', '#DB2777'];
function CareerPrepHub() {
  const app = useApp();
  const [sel, setSel] = useState(null);
  const [tiers, setTiers] = useState(() => {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(__LS.getItem(PREP_KEY)) || {};
    } catch (e) {
      return {};
    }
  });
  const setTier = (skill, tierIdx) => {
    const cur = tiers[skill] || 0;
    const next = {
      ...tiers,
      [skill]: cur === tierIdx + 1 ? tierIdx : tierIdx + 1
    };
    setTiers(next);
    try {
      __LS.setItem(PREP_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
    } catch (e) {}
  };
  const levelOf = name => tiers[name] || 0;
  const totalPct = Math.round(PREP_SKILLS.reduce((a, s) => a + levelOf(s[0]), 0) / (PREP_SKILLS.length * 3) * 100);
  const RANK = totalPct >= 100 ? 'Interview-ready' : totalPct >= 67 ? 'Advanced' : totalPct >= 34 ? 'Intermediate' : totalPct > 0 ? 'Foundational' : 'Not started';
  const forged = PREP_SKILLS.filter(s => levelOf(s[0]) === 3).length;
  return React.createElement(AppShell, null, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl3 mb-5 p-6 sm:p-8",
    style: {
      background: 'linear-gradient(160deg,#2A2118 0%,#1A1410 55%,#0E0B08 100%)'
    }
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "absolute inset-0 opacity-[.16] pointer-events-none",
    style: {
      backgroundImage: 'radial-gradient(circle, #E8D9BE 1.5px, transparent 1.6px)',
      backgroundSize: '26px 26px'
    }
  }), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "absolute -top-24 -left-16 h-72 w-72 rounded-full pointer-events-none",
    style: {
      background: 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(251,191,36,.30), transparent 70%)',
      filter: 'blur(18px)'
    }
  }), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "relative"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[.24em]",
    style: {
      color: 'rgba(255,255,255,.65)'
    }
  }, "Forge \xB7 Career prep hub"), React.createElement("h1", {
    className: "font-serif text-3xl sm:text-4xl mt-1",
    style: {
      color: '#F7EFE0'
    }
  }, "Build your kit, one tool at a time."), React.createElement("p", {
    className: "text-sm mt-2 max-w-xl",
    style: {
      color: 'rgba(247,239,224,.75)'
    }
  }, "Five tools hang on this bench. Forge all three tiers of a tool and it is yours for good. A full belt is what walks into the interview."), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "mt-7 flex flex-wrap items-end justify-center gap-6 sm:gap-9"
  }, PREP_SKILLS.map((sk, si) => {
    const hue = PREP_HUES[si % PREP_HUES.length];
    const lvl = levelOf(sk[0]);
    const t = PREP_TOOLS[si % PREP_TOOLS.length];
    const f = lvl / 3;
    return React.createElement("button", {
      key: sk[0],
      onClick: () => setSel(sk),
      title: `${sk[0]} · tier ${lvl} of 3`,
      className: "group flex flex-col items-center gap-2 transition-transform hover:-translate-y-1"
    }, React.createElement("span", {
      className: "h-4 w-px",
      style: {
        background: 'rgba(247,239,224,.35)'
      }
    }), React.createElement("span", {
      className: cx('grid place-items-center rounded-xl2 p-2 transition-all duration-500', lvl === 3 && 'floaty'),
      style: {
        background: lvl ? `linear-gradient(160deg, ${hue}26, transparent)` : 'rgba(255,255,255,.03)',
        border: `1px solid ${lvl === 3 ? hue : 'rgba(247,239,224,.14)'}`,

const OPP_TABS = ['All', 'Internship', 'Competition', 'Program', 'Scholarship', 'Networking'];
async function fetchOpportunities() {
  const url = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.LUMERA_OPPS_ENDPOINT;
  if (!url) return null;
  const key = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.LUMERA_OPPS_KEY || '';
  const res = await fetch(url, {
    headers: key ? {
      'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + key
    } : {}
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Opportunities API returned ' + res.status);
  const data = await res.json();
  const rows = Array.isArray(data) ? data : data.opportunities || data.items || [];
  return rows.map(r => ({
    type: r.type || r.category || 'Internship',
    title: r.title || r.name || 'Untitled',
    org: r.org || r.company || r.employer || '',
    desc: r.desc || r.description || r.summary || '',
    applyBy: r.applyBy || r.deadline || r.application_deadline || '',
    starts: r.starts || r.start_date || r.startDate || '',
    ends: r.ends || r.end_date || r.endDate || '',
    url: r.url || r.link || '#'
  }));
}
const fmtDate = d => {
  if (!d) return null;
  const t = new Date(d);
  if (isNaN(t)) return null;
  return t.toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'short',
    year: 'numeric'
  });
};
const daysLeft = d => {
  if (!d) return null;
  const t = new Date(d);
  if (isNaN(t)) return null;
  return Math.ceil((t - Date.now()) / 864e5);
};
function Opportunities() {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('All');
  const [rows, setRows] = useState(OPPS);
  const [live, setLive] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');
  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    fetchOpportunities().then(r => {
      if (alive && r && r.length) {
        setRows(r);
        setLive(true);
      }
    }).catch(e => {
      if (alive) setErr(String(e.message || e));
    });
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, []);
  const shown = rows.filter(o => tab === 'All' || o.type === tab).slice().sort((a, b) => {
    const A = daysLeft(a.applyBy),
      B = daysLeft(b.applyBy);
    if (A == null) return 1;
    if (B == null) return -1;
    return A - B;
  });
  const TONE = {
    Internship: '#2563EB',
    Competition: '#DB2777',
    Program: '#0D9488',
    Scholarship: '#D97706',
    Networking: '#7C3AED'
  };
  return React.createElement(AppShell, null, React.createElement(PageHead, {
    eyebrow: "Opportunities",
    title: "Ways to get your foot in the door.",
    desc: "Internships, competitions, access programmes and scholarships that move the needle, sorted by how soon they close.",
    action: React.createElement(Pill, {
      tone: live ? 'sage' : 'neutral'
    }, live ? 'Live feed' : 'Curated list')
  }), (() => {
    const dls = rows.map(o => daysLeft(o.applyBy)).filter(d => d != null && d >= 0);
    const soon = dls.filter(d => d <= 30).length,
      quarter = dls.filter(d => d <= 90).length;
    const rolling = rows.filter(o => daysLeft(o.applyBy) == null).length;
    return React.createElement("div", {
      className: "grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3 mb-4"
    }, [['Closing in 30 days', soon, '#DC2626'], ['Within 3 months', quarter, '#D97706'], ['Rolling entry', rolling, '#16A34A'], ['Total listed', rows.length, '#7C3AED']].map(([l, v, c]) => React.createElement(Card, {
      key: l,

        color: c
      }
    }, v), React.createElement("div", {
      className: "text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-faint mt-0.5"
    }, l))));
  })(), React.createElement(Card, {
    className: "mb-4"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex gap-2 flex-wrap"
  }, OPP_TABS.map(t => React.createElement("button", {
    key: t,
    onClick: () => setTab(t),
    className: cx('chip', tab === t && 'on')
  }, t)))), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4 stagger"
  }, shown.map(o => {
    const hue = TONE[o.type] || '#7C3AED';
    const dl = daysLeft(o.applyBy);
    const urgent = dl != null && dl >= 0 && dl <= 30;
    return React.createElement(Card, {
      key: o.title,
      className: "flex flex-col",
      style: {
        borderTop: `3px solid ${hue}`
      }
    }, React.createElement("div", {

    }, React.createElement("span", {

      style: {
        background: hue + '18',
        color: hue
      }
    }, o.type), dl != null && (dl < 0 ? React.createElement("span", {
      className: "text-[11px] text-faint"
    }, "Closed") : React.createElement("span", {
      className: cx('text-[11px] font-semibold', urgent ? 'text-berry' : 'text-muted')

function ForgeCV() {

      size: 15
    }) : React.createElement("span", {
      className: "text-faint text-xs"
    }, "+")), React.createElement("span", null, React.createElement("span", {
      className: cx('block text-sm font-medium', on ? 'text-muted line-through' : 'text-charcoal')

function ForgeUniversity() {
  const app = useApp();
  const fmt = app.fmt;
  const [years, setYears] = useState(3),
    [tuition, setTuition] = useState(9250),
    [living, setLiving] = useState(12000),
    [scholar, setScholar] = useState(0);
  const total = (tuition + living) * years;
  const borrow = Math.max(0, total - scholar * years);
  const r = 0.06 / 12,
    m = 20 * 12;
  const monthly = borrow > 0 ? borrow * r / (1 - Math.pow(1 + r, -m)) : 0;
  const Num = (label, val, set) => React.createElement("div", null, React.createElement("label", {
    className: "text-sm text-charcoal/85 mb-1.5 block"
  }, label), React.createElement("input", {
    type: "number",
    value: val,
    onChange: e => set(Math.max(0, +e.target.value || 0)),
    className: "w-full rounded-xl border border-line bg-cream px-3 py-2.5 focus:border-gold focus:outline-none"
  }));
  return React.createElement(AppShell, null, React.createElement(PageHead, {
    eyebrow: "Forge \xB7 University planner",
    title: "Know the real cost, before you sign.",
    desc: "Estimate total cost of study, what you\u2019d borrow, and a rough monthly repayment. Educational only, real loan terms vary by country."
  }), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4"
  }, React.createElement(Card, null, React.createElement(Eyebrow, {
    className: "mb-4"
  }, "Your plan"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "space-y-3"
  }, React.createElement("div", null, React.createElement("label", {
    className: "text-sm text-charcoal/85 mb-1.5 block"
  }, "Years of study"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex gap-2"
  }, [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(y => React.createElement("button", {
    key: y,
    onClick: () => setYears(y),
    className: cx('chip flex-1', years === y && 'on')
  }, y)))), Num('Tuition per year', tuition, setTuition), Num('Living costs per year', living, setLiving), Num('Scholarships / grants per year', scholar, setScholar))), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "space-y-4"

const normTok = s => String(s).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9& ]/g, ' ').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
function nearMiss(a, b) {
  if (Math.abs(a.length - b.length) > 1) return false;
  let i = 0,
    j = 0,
    diff = 0;
  while (i < a.length && j < b.length) {
    if (a[i] === b[j]) {
      i++;
      j++;
      continue;
    }
    if (++diff > 1) return false;
    if (a.length > b.length) i++;else if (b.length > a.length) j++;else {
      i++;
      j++;
    }
  }
  return true;
}
function roleScore(role, group, query) {
  const tokens = normTok(query);
  if (!tokens.length) return 0;
  const hay = normTok(role + ' ' + group);
  const hit = t => {
    let best = 0;
    for (const h of hay) {
      if (h === t) best = Math.max(best, 4);else if (h.startsWith(t)) best = Math.max(best, 3);else if (t.length >= 3 && h.includes(t)) best = Math.max(best, 2);else if (t.length >= 4 && nearMiss(t, h)) best = Math.max(best, 1.5);
    }
    return best;
  };
  let score = 0;
  for (const t of tokens) {
    const alts = [t, ...(ROLE_SYNONYMS[t] ? normTok(ROLE_SYNONYMS[t]) : [])];
    const best = Math.max(...alts.map(hit));
    if (!best) return 0;
    score += best;
  }
  if (role.toLowerCase().startsWith(tokens[0])) score += 1;
  return score;
}

const COMMUNITY_HUES = ['#7C3AED', '#2563EB', '#0D9488', '#DB2777', '#D97706', '#16A34A', '#9333EA', '#0EA5E9'];
