function inkOn(hex) {
  const h = String(hex || '').replace('#', '');
  if (h.length !== 6) return '#fff';
  const L = [0, 2, 4].map(i => {
    const c = parseInt(h.slice(i, i + 2), 16) / 255;
    return c <= .03928 ? c / 12.92 : Math.pow((c + .055) / 1.055, 2.4);
  });
  const lum = .2126 * L[0] + .7152 * L[1] + .0722 * L[2];
  return 1.05 / (lum + .05) >= 4.5 ? '#fff' : '#14111F';
}
const initialsOf = name => name.split(' ').map(w => w[0]).join('').slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
const timeAgo = ts => {
  const s = Math.max(1, Math.round((Date.now() - ts) / 1000));
  if (s < 60) return 'just now';
  const m = Math.round(s / 60);
  if (m < 60) return m + 'm';
  const h = Math.round(m / 60);
  if (h < 24) return h + 'h';
  const d = Math.round(h / 24);
  if (d < 7) return d + 'd';
  return new Date(ts).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', {
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'short'
  });
};
const COMMUNITY_TAGS = ['Update', 'Milestone', 'Question', 'Looking to connect', 'Opportunity'];
function MemberAvatar({
  name,
  size = 40
}) {
  const h = avatarHue(name || '?');
  return React.createElement("span", {
    "aria-hidden": "true",
    className: "grid place-items-center rounded-full text-white font-semibold shrink-0",
    style: {
      width: size,
      height: size,
      background: `linear-gradient(135deg,${h},${h}AA)`,
      fontSize: size * 0.36
    }
  }, initialsOf(name || '?'));
}
function CommunityProfileForm({
  initial,
  onSaved,
  compact
}) {
  const app = useApp();
  const [f, setF] = useState({
    displayName: initial && initial.displayName || app.profile.name || app.user && app.user.name || '',
    headline: initial && initial.headline || '',
    linkedin: initial && initial.linkedin || '',
    listed: initial ? initial.listed : true
  });
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');
  const save = async e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setErr('');
    try {
      const r = await API.put('/api/community/profile', f);
      onSaved(r.profile);
    } catch (x) {
      setErr(x.message);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };
  const inp = 'w-full rounded-xl border border-line bg-cream px-3 py-2.5 text-sm focus:border-gold focus:outline-none';
  return React.createElement("form", {
    onSubmit: save,
    className: "space-y-3"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3"
  }, React.createElement("label", {
    className: "block"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-xs text-charcoal/85 mb-1 block"
  }, "Display name"), React.createElement("input", _extends({}, NO_AUTOFILL, {
    name: "lm-display",
    value: f.displayName,
    onChange: e => setF({
      ...f,
      displayName: e.target.value
    }),
    maxLength: 60,
    className: inp
  }))), React.createElement("label", {
    className: "block"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-xs text-charcoal/85 mb-1 block"
  }, "Headline ", React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-faint"
  }, "(optional)")), React.createElement("input", _extends({}, NO_AUTOFILL, {
    name: "lm-headline",
    value: f.headline,
    onChange: e => setF({
      ...f,
      headline: e.target.value
    }),
    maxLength: 120,
    placeholder: "e.g. Economics student, saving for a flat",
    className: inp
  })))), React.createElement("label", {
    className: "block"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-xs text-charcoal/85 mb-1 block"
  }, "LinkedIn profile ", React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-faint"
  }, "(optional)")), React.createElement("input", _extends({}, NO_AUTOFILL, {
    name: "lm-linkedin",
    value: f.linkedin,
    onChange: e => setF({
      ...f,
      linkedin: e.target.value
    }),
    placeholder: "https://www.linkedin.com/in/\u2026",
    className: inp
  }))), React.createElement("label", {
    className: "flex items-center gap-2.5 text-sm text-charcoal/85 cursor-pointer"
  }, React.createElement("input", {
    type: "checkbox",
    checked: f.listed,
    onChange: e => setF({
      ...f,
      listed: e.target.checked
    }),
    className: "h-4 w-4"
  }), "Show me in the member directory"), React.createElement(FormError, {
    msg: err
  }), React.createElement("button", {
    type: "submit",
    disabled: busy,
    className: "btn btn-gold px-5 py-2.5 text-sm"
  }, busy ? 'Saving…' : compact ? 'Save profile' : 'Join the community'));
}
function PostCard({
  post,
  onChange,
  onRemove
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [replies, setReplies] = useState(null);
  const [rErr, setRErr] = useState('');
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [reported, setReported] = useState(false);
  const like = async () => {
    const prev = post;
    onChange({
      ...post,
      liked: !post.liked,
      likes: post.likes + (post.liked ? -1 : 1)
    });
    try {
      const r = await API.post(`/api/community/posts/${post.id}/like`);
      onChange({
        ...prev,
        liked: r.liked,
        likes: r.likes
      });
    } catch (x) {
      onChange(prev);
    }
  };
  const loadReplies = async () => {
    setRErr('');
    try {
      const r = await API.get(`/api/community/posts/${post.id}/replies`);
      setReplies(r.replies);
    } catch (x) {
      setRErr(x.message);
    }
  };
  const toggle = () => {
    const n = !open;
    setOpen(n);
    if (n && replies == null) loadReplies();
  };
  const reply = async e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!draft.trim()) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setRErr('');
    try {
      const r = await API.post(`/api/community/posts/${post.id}/replies`, {
        body: draft.trim()
      });
      setReplies(x => [...(x || []), r.reply]);
      setDraft('');
      onChange({
        ...post,
        replies: post.replies + 1
      });
    } catch (x) {
      setRErr(x.message);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };
  const report = async () => {
    if (!window.confirm('Report this post to the moderators?')) return;
    try {
      await API.post('/api/community/report', {
        kind: 'post',
        id: post.id,
        reason: 'Reported by a member'
      });
      setReported(true);
    } catch (x) {
      alert(x.message);
    }
  };
  const remove = async () => {
    if (!window.confirm('Delete this post?')) return;
    try {
      await API.del(`/api/community/posts/${post.id}`);
      onRemove(post.id);
    } catch (x) {
      alert(x.message);
    }
  };
  const removeReply = async id => {
    try {
      await API.del(`/api/community/replies/${id}`);
      setReplies(x => x.filter(r => r.id !== id));
      onChange({
        ...post,
        replies: Math.max(0, post.replies - 1)
      });
    } catch (x) {
      setRErr(x.message);
    }
  };
  const hue = avatarHue(post.author.name);
  return React.createElement("article", {
    className: "lux-card !p-5",
    "aria-labelledby": 'p' + post.id
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex gap-3"
  }, React.createElement(MemberAvatar, {
    name: post.author.name
  }), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex-1 min-w-0"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    id: 'p' + post.id,
    className: "font-semibold text-charcoal text-sm"
  }, post.author.name), post.mine && React.createElement(Pill, {
    tone: "gold"
  }, "You"), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-xs text-faint"
  }, "\xB7 ", React.createElement("time", {
    dateTime: new Date(post.createdAt).toISOString()
  }, timeAgo(post.createdAt))), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "ml-auto text-[11px] font-semibold rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5",
    style: {
      background: hue + '22',
      color: hue,
      boxShadow: `inset 0 0 0 1px ${hue}44`
    }
  }, post.tag)), post.author.headline && React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-xs text-faint"
  }, post.author.headline), React.createElement("p", {
    translate: "no",
    className: "text-[14.5px] text-charcoal/90 mt-2 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"
  }, post.body), post.link && React.createElement("a", {
    href: post.link,
    target: "_blank",
    rel: "noopener noreferrer nofollow",
    className: "inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-sky mt-2"
  }, "View on LinkedIn ", React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "arrowR",
    size: 11,
    className: "-rotate-45"
  })), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-center gap-1 mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-line -ml-2"
  }, React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: like,
    "aria-pressed": post.liked,
    className: cx('rounded-full px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition hover:bg-white/5', post.liked ? 'text-berry' : 'text-muted')
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "heart",
    size: 14
  }), post.likes, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "sr-only"
  }, " likes")), React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: toggle,
    "aria-expanded": open,
    className: "rounded-full px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-muted flex items-center gap-1.5 hover:bg-white/5"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "chat",
    size: 14
  }), post.replies, " ", post.replies === 1 ? 'reply' : 'replies'), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "flex-1"
  }), post.mine ? React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: remove,
    className: "rounded-full px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-muted hover:text-berry hover:bg-white/5"
  }, "Delete") : React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: report,
    disabled: reported,
    className: "rounded-full px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-muted hover:text-charcoal hover:bg-white/5"
  }, reported ? 'Reported' : 'Report')), open && React.createElement("div", {
    className: "mt-3 space-y-3 anim-fadeUp"
  }, replies == null && !rErr && React.createElement("div", {
    className: "space-y-2",
    "aria-label": "Loading replies"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "skeleton h-10"
  }), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "skeleton h-10 w-2/3"
  })), replies && replies.length === 0 && React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-xs text-muted"
  }, "No replies yet."), replies && replies.map(r => React.createElement("div", {
    key: r.id,
    className: "flex gap-2.5"
  }, React.createElement(MemberAvatar, {
    name: r.author.name,
    size: 28
  }), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex-1 min-w-0 rounded-2xl px-3 py-2",
    style: {
      background: 'rgba(255,255,255,.05)'
    }
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-center gap-2"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-xs font-semibold text-charcoal"
  }, r.author.name), React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-[11px] text-faint"
  }, timeAgo(r.createdAt)), r.mine && React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: () => removeReply(r.id),
    className: "ml-auto text-[11px] text-muted hover:text-berry"
  }, "Delete")), React.createElement("p", {
    translate: "no",
    className: "text-[13px] text-charcoal/90 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"
  }, r.body)))), rErr && React.createElement("div", {
    role: "alert",
    className: "text-xs text-berry flex items-center gap-2"
  }, rErr, " ", React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: loadReplies,
    className: "underline"
  }, "Try again")), React.createElement("form", {
    onSubmit: reply,
    className: "flex gap-2"
  }, React.createElement("input", _extends({}, NO_AUTOFILL, {
    name: "lm-reply",
    value: draft,
    onChange: e => setDraft(e.target.value),
    maxLength: 1000,
    placeholder: "Write a reply",
    "aria-label": "Write a reply",
    className: "flex-1 rounded-full border border-line bg-cream px-3.5 py-2 text-sm focus:border-gold focus:outline-none"
  })), React.createElement("button", {
    type: "submit",
    disabled: busy || !draft.trim(),
    className: "btn btn-gold px-4 py-2 text-xs"
  }, busy ? '…' : 'Reply'))))));
}

function Community() {
  const app = useApp();
  const server = app.apiMode === 'server';
  const demo = !!(app.user && app.user.demo);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('Feed');
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState(undefined);
  const [stats, setStats] = useState(null);
  const [posts, setPosts] = useState(null);
  const [more, setMore] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');
  const [members, setMembers] = useState(null);
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  const [conns, setConns] = useState([]);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState({
    body: '',
    tag: 'Update',
    link: ''
  });
  const [posting, setPosting] = useState(false);
  const [postErr, setPostErr] = useState('');
  const feedTag = tab === 'Opportunities' ? 'Opportunity' : '';
  const loadFeed = useCallback(async before => {
    setErr('');
    try {
      const r = await API.get(`/api/community/feed?tag=${encodeURIComponent(feedTag)}${before ? `&before=${before}` : ''}`);
      setPosts(p => before ? [...(p || []), ...r.posts] : r.posts);
      setMore(r.more);
    } catch (x) {
      setErr(x.message);
      if (!before) setPosts(p => p || []);
    }
  }, [feedTag]);
  const loadSide = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setStats(await API.get('/api/community/stats'));
      setConns((await API.get('/api/community/connections')).connections);
    } catch (x) {}
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!server || demo) return;
    let dead = false;
    API.get('/api/community/profile').then(r => {
      if (!dead) setProfile(r.profile || null);
    }).catch(x => {
      if (!dead) {
        setProfile(null);
        setErr(x.message);
      }
    });
    loadSide();
    return () => {
      dead = true;
    };
  }, [server, demo]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!server || demo || tab === 'Members') return;
    setPosts(null);
    loadFeed();
  }, [tab, server, demo, loadFeed]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!server || demo || tab !== 'Members') return;
    setMembers(null);
    const t = setTimeout(() => {
      API.get('/api/community/members?q=' + encodeURIComponent(q)).then(r => setMembers(r.members)).catch(x => {
        setErr(x.message);
        setMembers([]);
      });
    }, 250);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [tab, q, server, demo]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (tab === 'Opportunities') setDraft(d => ({
      ...d,
      tag: 'Opportunity'
    }));
  }, [tab]);
  const submit = async e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!draft.body.trim()) return;
    setPosting(true);
    setPostErr('');
    try {
      const r = await API.post('/api/community/posts', {
        body: draft.body.trim(),
        tag: draft.tag,
        link: draft.link.trim()
      });
      setPosts(p => [r.post, ...(p || [])]);
      setDraft({
        body: '',
        tag: tab === 'Opportunities' ? 'Opportunity' : 'Update',
        link: ''
      });
      loadSide();
    } catch (x) {
      setPostErr(x.message);
    } finally {
      setPosting(false);
    }
  };
  const connect = async mem => {
    setMembers(ms => ms.map(x => x.id === mem.id ? {
      ...x,
      connected: !x.connected
    } : x));
    try {
      const r = await API.post(`/api/community/connections/${mem.id}`);
      setMembers(ms => ms.map(x => x.id === mem.id ? {
        ...x,
        connected: r.connected
      } : x));
      loadSide();
    } catch (x) {
      setMembers(ms => ms.map(x2 => x2.id === mem.id ? {
        ...x2,
        connected: mem.connected
      } : x2));
      setErr(x.message);
    }
  };
  if (demo) return React.createElement(DemoCommunity, null);
  if (!server) return React.createElement(AppShell, null, React.createElement(PageHead, {
    eyebrow: "Community",
    title: "Connect with the Lumera community.",
    desc: "Share what you are working on, find people on the same path, and swap opportunities."
  }), React.createElement(Card, {
    hover: false,
    className: "text-center py-12"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "mx-auto w-fit"
  }, React.createElement(Mascot, {
    kind: "lumera",
    color: "#9D7CFF",
    size: 72
  })), React.createElement("h2", {
    className: "font-display text-[2rem] text-charcoal mt-3"
  }, demo ? 'Create an account to join in' : 'The community is not available here'), React.createElement("p", {
    className: "text-sm text-muted mt-2 max-w-md mx-auto"
  }, demo ? 'Posts, replies and connections belong to real members, so the demo account cannot post.' : 'This copy of Lumera is running offline, and the community needs a connection to the Lumera service. Everything else works as normal.'), demo && React.createElement(Btn, {
    variant: "gold",
    className: "mt-5",
    iconR: "arrowR",
    to: "/signup"
  }, "Create an account")));
  return React.createElement(AppShell, null, React.createElement("section", {
    className: "rounded-[28px] p-5 sm:p-6 mb-5 text-white",
    style: {
      background: 'linear-gradient(120deg,#7C3AED 0%,#C026D3 45%,#F97316 100%)',
      boxShadow: '0 26px 60px -30px rgba(192,38,211,.9)'
    }
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3"
  }, React.createElement("h1", {
    className: "font-display text-[2.2rem] sm:text-[2.6rem] leading-none",
    style: {
      color: '#fff'
    }
  }, "Community"), profile && (profile.linkedin ? React.createElement("a", {

    style: {

      color: '#6D28D9'
    }
  }, "Your LinkedIn ", React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "arrowR",
    size: 12,
    className: "-rotate-45"
  })) : React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: () => setEditing(true),
    className: "ml-auto inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-3.5 py-2 text-[13px] font-bold",

function StreakRewards() {
  const app = useApp();
  const s = app.profile.streak || 0;
  const best = Math.max(app.profile.streakBest || 0, s);
  const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const checkedToday = app.profile.lastCheckin === today;
  const next = STREAK_TIERS.find(r => best < r.at);
  const prog = next ? clamp(s / next.at * 100, 0, 100) : 100;
  return React.createElement(Card, {
    hover: false,
    className: "text-center"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex flex-col items-center gap-3"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex flex-col items-center gap-2"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "grid place-items-center h-12 w-12 rounded-2xl bg-clay/15 text-clay"
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: "flame",
    size: 24
  })), React.createElement("div", null, React.createElement(Eyebrow, null, "Daily streak"), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "font-display text-[2rem] text-charcoal leading-none mt-0.5"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "tnum"
  }, s), " day", s === 1 ? '' : 's'), React.createElement("div", {
    className: "text-[11px] text-faint mt-0.5"
  }, "Best: ", best))), React.createElement("button", {
    onClick: () => app.checkIn && app.checkIn(),
    disabled: checkedToday,
    className: cx('btn px-4 py-2.5 text-sm', checkedToday ? 'btn-ghost opacity-60 cursor-default' : 'btn-gold')
  }, React.createElement(Icon, {
    name: checkedToday ? 'check' : 'flame',
    size: 15
  }), checkedToday ? 'Checked in today' : 'Check in today')), next && React.createElement("div", {
    className: "mt-4 max-w-xl mx-auto text-left"
  }, React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex items-center justify-between text-xs mb-1.5"
  }, React.createElement("span", {
    className: "text-muted"
  }, "Next milestone: ", React.createElement("b", {

const FLAG_KEY = 'lumera_flags';
function isBetaPreview() {
  try {
    const p = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    if (p.get('beta') === '1') {
      __SS.setItem('lumera_beta', '1');
      return true;
    }
    if (p.get('beta') === '0') {
      __SS.removeItem('lumera_beta');
      return false;
    }
    return __SS.getItem('lumera_beta') === '1';
  } catch (e) {
    return false;
  }
}
function loadFlags() {
  let saved = {};
  try {
    saved = JSON.parse(__LS.getItem(FLAG_KEY)) || {};
  } catch (e) {}
  const beta = isBetaPreview();
  const out = {};
  FEATURES.forEach(f => {
    const v = f.key in saved ? saved[f.key] : f.def;
    out[f.key] = v === 'beta' ? beta : !!v;
  });
  return out;
}
function flagForRoute(flags, path) {
  const f = FEATURES.find(x => x.routes.includes(path));
  return f ? !!flags[f.key] : true;
}

const API = {
  mode: 'unknown',
  detect() {
    if (this._p) return this._p;
    this._p = (async () => {
      const hosted = !!window.__LUMERA_HOSTED;
      if (!/^https?:$/.test(location.protocol)) {
        this.mode = 'local';
        return this.mode;
      }
      const tries = hosted ? 3 : 1;
      for (let i = 0; i < tries; i++) {
        try {
          const ctl = new AbortController();
          const t = setTimeout(() => ctl.abort(), hosted ? 8000 : 2500);
          const r = await fetch('/api/health', {
            signal: ctl.signal,
            credentials: 'same-origin',
            cache: 'no-store'
          });
          clearTimeout(t);
          const j = r.ok ? await r.json() : null;
          if (j && j.service === 'lumera') {
            this.mode = 'server';
            return this.mode;
          }
        } catch (e) {}
        if (i < tries - 1) await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 1200 * (i + 1)));
      }
      this.mode = hosted ? 'offline' : 'local';
      return this.mode;
    })();
    return this._p;
  },
  async req(method, path, body) {
    let r;
    try {
      r = await fetch(path, {
        method,
        credentials: 'same-origin',
        headers: {
          'X-Lumera': '1',
          ...(body !== undefined ? {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
          } : {})
        },
        body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body)
      });
    } catch (e) {
      const err = new Error('You appear to be offline. Check your connection and try again.');
      err.status = 0;
      err.offline = true;
      throw err;
    }
    let data = null;
    try {
      data = await r.json();
    } catch (e) {}
    if (!r.ok) {
      const err = new Error(data && data.error || 'Something went wrong. Please try again.');
      err.status = r.status;
      err.code = data && data.code;
      throw err;
    }
    return data;
  },
  get(p) {
    return this.req('GET', p);
  },
  post(p, b) {
    return this.req('POST', p, b || {});
  },
  put(p, b) {
    return this.req('PUT', p, b || {});
  },
  patch(p, b) {
    return this.req('PATCH', p, b || {});
  },
  del(p, b) {
    return this.req('DELETE', p, b);
  }
};

function shrinkImage(file, max = 640, quality = .8) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (!/^image\//.test(file.type)) return reject(new Error('Not an image'));
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    const img = new Image();
    img.onload = () => {
      const k = Math.min(1, max / Math.max(img.width, img.height));
      const c = document.createElement('canvas');
      c.width = Math.round(img.width * k);
      c.height = Math.round(img.height * k);
      c.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0, c.width, c.height);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      resolve(c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', quality));
    };
    img.onerror = () => {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      reject(new Error('Unreadable image'));
    };
    img.src = url;
  });
}

    const accts = loadAccounts();
    if (accts[email]) {
      const e = new Error('An account with this email already exists in this browser. Log in instead, or use a different email.');
      e.code = 'exists';
      throw e;
    }
    const u = {
      name: name || email.split('@')[0],
      email,
      isAdmin: false
    };
    setUser(u);
    setOnboarded(false);
    setProfile(freshProfile(u.name));
    setExpenses({
      ...BLANK_EXP
    });
    setBalances({
      ...BLANK_BAL
    });
    nav('/onboarding', {
      replace: true
    });
  };
  const login = async (email, password) => {
    if (apiMode === 'server') {
      const r = await API.post('/api/auth/login', {
        email,
        password
      });
      const st = (await API.get('/api/me/state')).state;
      clearSyncedLocal();
      applyState(st || {
        profile: freshProfile(r.user.name)
      });
      setUser(r.user);
      setSync('saved');
      welcomeBack(st);
      nav(st && st.onboarded ? '/dashboard' : '/onboarding', {
        replace: true
      });
      return;
    }
    email = email || 'you@email.com';
    const accts = loadAccounts();
    const acc = accts[email];
    if (acc) {
      const u = {
        name: acc.name || email.split('@')[0],
        email,
        isAdmin: false
      };
      setUser(u);
      loadInto(acc);
      if (acc.onboarded) {
        welcomeBack(acc);
        nav('/dashboard', {
          replace: true
        });
      } else nav('/onboarding', {
        replace: true
      });
    } else {
      const u = {
        name: email.split('@')[0],
        email,
        isAdmin: false
      };
      setUser(u);
      setOnboarded(false);
      setProfile(freshProfile(u.name));
      setExpenses({
        ...BLANK_EXP
      });
      setBalances({
        ...BLANK_BAL
      });
      nav('/onboarding', {
        replace: true
      });
    }
  };
  const demo = () => {
    setUser({
      name: 'Alex (example)',
      email: 'demo@lumera.app',
      isAdmin: false,
      demo: true
    });
    setOnboarded(false);
    setProfile({
      ...DEFAULT_PROFILE
    });
    setExpenses({
      ...DEFAULT_EXPENSES
    });
    setBalances({
      ...DEFAULT_BALANCES
    });
    nav('/onboarding', {
      replace: true
    });

  const demoSilent = () => {
    setUser({
      name: 'Alex (example)',
      email: 'demo@lumera.app',
      isAdmin: false,
      demo: true

    setProfile({
      ...DEFAULT_PROFILE
    });
    setExpenses({
      ...DEFAULT_EXPENSES
    });
    setBalances({
      ...DEFAULT_BALANCES

  const exportData = async () => {
    let data;
    if (apiMode === 'server' && user && !user.demo) {
      data = await API.get('/api/me/export');
    } else {
      data = {
        exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),

          name: user.name,
          email: user.email

        profile,
        expenses,
        balances,
        onboarded,
        lastUpdated

      Object.entries(SYNCED).forEach(([k, key]) => {

        if (v != null) data[k] = v;
      });
    }

      type: 'text/html'
    });
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download = 'lumera-report-' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) + '.html';
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    setTimeout(() => {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
      a.remove();
    }, 800);

  const deleteAccount = async password => {
    if (apiMode === 'server' && user && !user.demo) {
      await API.del('/api/me', {
        password
      });

      delete a[user.email];

        __LS.setItem(ACCT, JSON.stringify(a));
        __LS.removeItem(STORE);

    setOnboarded(false);
    setProfile({
      ...BLANK_PROFILE

      ...BLANK_EXP
    });
    setBalances({
      ...BLANK_BAL

    setShowLogout(false);

      API.post('/api/auth/logout').catch(() => {});
      clearSyncedLocal();
    }
    setUser(null);
    setOnboarded(false);
    setProfile({
      ...BLANK_PROFILE
    });
    setExpenses({
      ...BLANK_EXP
    });
    setBalances({
      ...BLANK_BAL
    });
    setSync('local');
    goSiteHome();

  const completeOnboarding = () => {
    setOnboarded(true);
    setLastUpdated(Date.now());
    setLastPrompt(Date.now());
  };
  const checkIn = () => {
    const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    if (profile.lastCheckin === today) return;
    const y = new Date(Date.now() - 864e5).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const ns = profile.lastCheckin === y ? (profile.streak || 0) + 1 : 1;
    setProfile(p => ({
      ...p,
      streak: ns,
      lastCheckin: today,
      streakBest: Math.max(p.streakBest || 0, ns)
    }));
    const hit = STREAK_TIERS.find(t => t.at === ns);
    if (hit) awardXp(hit.xp);
  };
  useEffect(() => {
    const L = LANGS.find(l => l.code === lang) || LANGS[0];
    document.documentElement.dir = L.dir;
    document.documentElement.lang = lang;
  }, [lang]);
  const setTheme = useCallback(pref => {
    setThemeState(pref);
    try {
      __LS.setItem('lumera_theme', pref);
    } catch (e) {}
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    const apply = () => {
      const dark = theme === 'dark' || theme === 'system' && matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
      document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', dark ? 'dark' : 'light');
      document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme-pref', theme);
      const tc = document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]');
      if (tc) tc.setAttribute('content', dark ? '#14110D' : '#F6F2EB');
    };
    apply();
    if (theme === 'system') {
      const mq = matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
      mq.addEventListener('change', apply);
      return () => mq.removeEventListener('change', apply);
    }
  }, [theme]);
  const setMode = useCallback(m => {
    setModeState(m);
    try {
      __LS.setItem('lumera_mode', m);
    } catch (e) {}
  }, []);

    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-mode', mode === 'spark' ? 'spark' : 'classic');
  }, [mode]);
  useEffect(() => {

  const [layout, setLayoutState] = useState(loadLayout);
  setMovedRoutes(layout);
  const setFlag = useCallback((key, on) => {

      const nf = {
        ...f,
        [key]: on
      };
      try {
        __LS.setItem(FLAG_KEY, JSON.stringify(nf));
      } catch (e) {}
      return nf;
    });
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {

      if (e.key === FLAG_KEY) setFlagsState(loadFlags());
      if (e.key === LAYOUT_KEY) setLayoutState(loadLayout());
    };
    window.addEventListener('storage', h);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('storage', h);
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    let ch = null;
    try {
      ch = new BroadcastChannel(LAYOUT_KEY);
      ch.onmessage = () => setLayoutState(loadLayout());
    } catch (e) {}
    return () => {
      try {
        ch && ch.close();
      } catch (e) {}
    };
  }, []);
  const awardXp = useCallback((n, silent) => {
    setXp(x => {
      const v = x + (n || 0);
      saveSynced('lumera_spark_xp', v);
      return v;
    });
    if (!silent) setQuestBurst(b => b + 1);
  }, []);
  const completeQuest = useCallback((id, silent) => {
    setQuests(qs => {
      const next = qs.map(q => {
        if (q.id === id && !q.done) {
          awardXp(q.xp, silent);
          return {
            ...q,
            done: true
          };
        }
        return q;
      });
      try {
        __LS.setItem('lumera_spark_quests', JSON.stringify({
          day: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
          list: next
        }));
      } catch (e) {}
      return next;
    });
  }, [awardXp]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const path = route.split('?')[0];
    const q = quests.find(x => !x.done && x.to === path);
    if (q) completeQuest(q.id, true);
  }, [route, quests, completeQuest]);
  useEffect(() => {
    LA.start({
      lang,
      cur: profile.currency,
      user: user ? user.email : 'guest'
    });
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    LA.event('view', {
      path: route.split('?')[0],
      user: user ? user.email : 'guest'
    });
  }, [route]);
  useEffect(() => {
    LA.event('lang', {
      lang
    });
  }, [lang]);
  useEffect(() => {
    _mtPrivate.terms = [profile.name, user && user.name, user && user.email].filter(x => x && String(x).trim().length >= 2).map(x => String(x).trim().toLowerCase());
  }, [profile.name, user]);
  useEffect(() => {
    LA.event('currency', {
      cur: profile.currency
    });
  }, [profile.currency]);
  useEffect(() => {
    _curLang = lang;
    ensureTrObserver(() => _curLang);
    const id = setTimeout(() => translateDOM(lang), 60);
    return () => clearTimeout(id);
  }, [lang, route]);
  useEffect(() => {
    let dead = false;
    API.detect().then(async mode => {
      if (dead) return;
      setApiMode(mode);
      if (mode === 'server') {
        try {
          const me = await API.get('/api/auth/session');
          if (!me.user) throw new Error('signed out');
          const st = (await API.get('/api/me/state')).state;
          if (dead) return;
          applyState(st || {
            profile: freshProfile(me.user.name)
          });
          setUser(me.user);
          setSync('saved');
          welcomeBack(st);
        } catch (e) {
          if (!dead && !(user && user.demo)) {
            setUser(null);
            setOnboarded(false);
            setProfile({
              ...BLANK_PROFILE
            });
            setExpenses({
              ...BLANK_EXP
            });
            setBalances({
              ...BLANK_BAL
            });
            clearSyncedLocal();
          }
        }
        try {
          const cfg = await API.get('/api/config');
          if (cfg && cfg.server) SERVER_INFO = cfg.server;
          if (cfg) {
            try {
              if (cfg.flags) __LS.setItem(FLAG_KEY, JSON.stringify(cfg.flags));else __LS.removeItem(FLAG_KEY);
            } catch (e) {}
            setFlagsState(loadFlags());
          }
          if (cfg) {
            try {
              if (cfg.layout) __LS.setItem(LAYOUT_KEY, JSON.stringify(cfg.layout));else __LS.removeItem(LAYOUT_KEY);
            } catch (e) {}
            setLayoutState(loadLayout());
          }
          [['updates', 'lumera_updates'], ['news', 'lumera_news'], ['about', 'lumera_about']].forEach(([k, key]) => {
            if (!cfg) return;
            try {
              if (cfg[k] != null) __LS.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(cfg[k]));else __LS.removeItem(key);
              window.dispatchEvent(new StorageEvent('storage', {
                key
              }));
            } catch (e) {}
          });
        } catch (e) {}
      }
      if (!dead) setBooting(false);
    });
    return () => {
      dead = true;
    };
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (booting) return;
    try {
      let pv = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('preview') === 'demo';
      try {
        pv = pv || !!(window.parent !== window && window.parent.__LUMERA_DEMO);
      } catch (e) {}
      if (pv && !user) {
        try {
          __LS.setItem('lumera_guide_tut_done', '1');
          __LS.setItem('lumera_guide_lumera', '1');
        } catch (e) {}
        demoSilent();
        setTimeout(() => replaceRoute(PREVIEW_ROUTE), 0);
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }, [booting]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (booting) return;
    const el = document.getElementById('loader');
    if (el) {
      el.style.opacity = '0';
      setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 600);
    }
  }, [booting]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const h = () => setDirtyTick(t => t + 1);
    window.addEventListener('lumera:dirty', h);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('lumera:dirty', h);
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (booting || apiMode !== 'server' || !user || user.demo) return;
    setSync('saving');
    const t = setTimeout(() => {
      const state = {
        profile,
        expenses,
        balances,
        onboarded,
        lastUpdated,
        lastPrompt,
        lang
      };
      Object.entries(SYNCED).forEach(([k, key]) => {
        const v = lsRead(key);
        if (v != null) state[k] = v;
      });
      API.put('/api/me/state', {
        state
      }).then(() => setSync('saved')).catch(e => {
        if (e.status === 401) {
          setUser(null);
          setSync('local');
          nav('/login');
          return;
        }
        setSync(e.offline ? 'offline' : 'error');
        setTimeout(() => setDirtyTick(x => x + 1), 15000);
      });
    }, 900);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [profile, expenses, balances, onboarded, lastUpdated, lastPrompt, lang, dirtyTick, user, apiMode, booting]);
  useEffect(() => {
    setMobileMenu(false);
  }, [route]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (booting) return;
    try {
      if (apiMode === 'server' && !(user && user.demo)) {
        __LS.setItem(STORE, JSON.stringify({
          lang
        }));
        return;
      }
      __LS.setItem(STORE, JSON.stringify({
        user,
        onboarded,
        profile,
        expenses,
        balances,
        lang,
        lastUpdated,
        lastPrompt
      }));
      if (user && !user.demo) {
        const a = loadAccounts();
        a[user.email] = {
          name: user.name,
          onboarded,
          profile,
          expenses,
          balances,
          lastUpdated,
          lastPrompt
        };
        __LS.setItem(ACCT, JSON.stringify(a));
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }, [user, onboarded, profile, expenses, balances, lang, lastUpdated, lastPrompt, apiMode, booting]);
  let path = route.split('?')[0];
  if (!ROUTES[path]) path = '/';
  const PUBLIC = ['/', '/login', '/signup', '/forgot', '/reset', '/pricing', '/privacy', '/terms'];
  const PREBOARD = ['/onboarding', '/review', '/settings'];
  const NEEDS_FIGURES = ['/dashboard', '/budget', '/goals', '/emergency', '/subscriptions', '/networth', '/simulator', '/twin', '/analytics', '/benchmarks', '/recommendations'];
  let redirect = null;
  if (!user && !PUBLIC.includes(path)) redirect = '/login';else if (user && !onboarded && NEEDS_FIGURES.includes(path)) redirect = '/onboarding';else if (!flagForRoute(flags, path)) redirect = '/dashboard';else if (!routeAllowed(layout, path)) redirect = user ? '/dashboard' : '/login';
  if (!booting && redirect && redirect !== route) {
    replaceRoute(redirect);
  }
  const product = mode === 'spark' ? SITE !== 'lumera' ? SITE : productOf(path) : 'lumera';
  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-product', product);
  }, [product]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const path = route.split('?')[0];
    const ch = PRODUCT_CHALLENGE[product];

      try {
        if (!__LS.getItem(key)) {
          __LS.setItem(key, '1');
          awardXp(ch[2], true);
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }, [route, product]);
  const value = {
    route,
    nav,
    user,
    signup,
    login,
    demo,
    logout: askLogout,
    askLogout,
    completeOnboarding,
    checkIn,
    onboarded,
    apiMode,
    sync,
    lastUpdated,
    profile,
    updateProfile,

    balances,
    setBalances,
    lang,

    mode,

    skin,

  if (booting) return null;
  if (apiMode === 'offline') return React.createElement(ServerUnavailable, null);
  const gate = !redirect && user ? gatedWorld(layout, path) : null;
  const Page = redirect ? () => null : gate ? () => React.createElement(WorldComingSoon, {
    k: gate
  }) : ROUTES[path] || RootRoute;
  return React.createElement(AppCtx.Provider, {
    value: value
  }, isBetaPreview() && React.createElement("div", {
    className: "fixed top-0 inset-x-0 z-[200] text-center text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[.2em] py-1 pointer-events-none",

    }

    fire: questBurst
  }), React.createElement("div", {

  }, React.createElement(Page, null)), user && !redirect && product === 'leaf' && React.createElement(WordOfDayPopup, null), user && !user.demo && !redirect && path === '/dashboard' && React.createElement(WhatsNewPopup, null), apiMode === 'server' && SERVER_INFO.feedback && !redirect && React.createElement(FeedbackButton, null), showLogout && React.createElement("div", {

  })), React.createElement("h3", {

    className: "fixed inset-0 z-[150] grid place-items-center p-4"

  }, "Continue to dashboard")))));
}
